events.name: MouseLeave

HapticEffect.summary: An object that provides waveform-based haptic feedback (vibrations and rumbles) on supported controllers and mobile devices.

properties.summary: Whether the haptic effect loops continuously.

properties.name: Position
properties.summary: Along with HapticEffect.Radius, specifies the impact position relative to the input device and, effectively, how broadly that impact effects nearby motors.

properties.name: Radius
properties.summary: Along with HapticEffect.Position, specifies the impact radius relative to the input device and, effectively, how broadly that impact effects nearby motors.

properties.name: Type
properties.summary: HapticEffectType describing the haptic type.

methods.name: Play
methods.summary: Plays the haptic effect.

methods.summary: Defines a custom waveform as a table and applies it to the haptic.

methods.name: Stop

events.name: Ended
events.summary: Fires when the HapticEffect has completed playback and stopped.

HapticService.summary: Provides haptic feedback to controllers and devices.

methods.name: GetMotor
methods.summary: Returns the current vibration value set to the specified InputObject.UserInputType and VibrationMotor.

methods.name: IsMotorSupported
methods.summary: Returns `true` if the specified motor is available to be used with the specified UserInputType.

methods.name: IsVibrationSupported
methods.summary: Returns `true` if the specified UserInputType supports haptic feedback.

methods.name: SetMotor
methods.summary: Sets the vibration intensity of the specified InputObject.UserInputType and VibrationMotor.

Hat.summary: A deprecated accessory container superseded by Accessory.

HeapProfilerService.summary: Generates and retrieves Luau heap memory profiles from the client and server Luau virtual machines for memory debugging.

methods.name: ClientRequestDataAsync
methods.summary: Yields until the Luau heap profile of the specified player's client is available, then returns it as a JSON string.

methods.name: ServerRequestDataAsync
methods.summary: Yields until the server's Luau heap profile is available, then returns it as a JSON string.

events.summary: Fires on the requesting machine with the compressed Luau heap profile produced for an earlier request.

Highlight.summary: A visual effect which you can use to call attention to a specific object within an experience.

properties.name: Adornee
properties.summary: The Instance that the Highlight is applied to.

properties.name: DepthMode
properties.summary: Controls how the Highlight effect displays with respect to other objects in the world.

properties.name: Enabled
properties.summary: Sets whether or not the highlight is enabled.

properties.name: FillColor
properties.summary: Sets the Color3 value of the highlight's interior.

properties.name: FillTransparency
properties.summary: Sets the transparency of the highlight's interior.

properties.name: OutlineColor
properties.summary: Sets the Color3 value of the highlight's outline.

properties.name: OutlineTransparency
properties.summary: Sets the transparency of the highlight's outline.

HingeConstraint.summary: Constrains its attachments to rotate about a single axis.

properties.name: ActuatorType
properties.summary: Sets whether the rotation of the HingeConstraint is actuated and, if so, what kind of actuation it uses.

properties.name: AngularResponsiveness
properties.summary: Specifies the sharpness of the servo motor in reaching the HingeConstraint.TargetAngle.

properties.name: AngularSpeed
properties.summary: The desired angular speed a HingeConstraint with HingeConstraint.ActuatorType set to ActuatorType will attempt to maintain while rotating towards its HingeConstraint.TargetAngle.

properties.name: AngularVelocity
properties.summary: The angular velocity a HingeConstraint with HingeConstraint.ActuatorType set to ActuatorType will attempt to achieve.

properties.name: CurrentAngle
properties.summary: The current angle of the HingeConstraint.

properties.name: LimitsEnabled
properties.summary: Sets whether the HingeConstraint will limit the range of rotation.

properties.name: LowerAngle
properties.summary: The minimum rotation angle the HingeConstraint will allow if HingeConstraint.LimitsEnabled is true.

properties.name: MotorMaxAcceleration
properties.summary: The maximum angular acceleration a HingeConstraint with HingeConstraint.ActuatorType set to ActuatorType can apply to achieve its HingeConstraint.AngularVelocity.

properties.name: MotorMaxTorque
properties.summary: The maximum torque a HingeConstraint with HingeConstraint.ActuatorType set to ActuatorType can apply when trying to reach its desired HingeConstraint.AngularVelocity.

properties.name: Radius
properties.summary: The visualized radius of the HingeConstraint.

properties.name: Restitution
properties.summary: How elastic Attachment connected by a HingeConstraint will be when they reach the end of the range when HingeConstraint.LimitsEnabled is true.

properties.name: ServoMaxTorque
properties.summary: The maximum torque a HingeConstraint with HingeConstraint.ActuatorType set to ActuatorType can apply when trying to reach its desired HingeConstraint.TargetAngle.

properties.name: TargetAngle
properties.summary: The target angle a HingeConstraint will attempt to rotate to if its HingeConstraint.ActuatorType is set to ActuatorType.

properties.name: UpperAngle
properties.summary: The maximum rotation angle the HingeConstraint will allow if HingeConstraint.LimitsEnabled is true.

Hint.summary: A Hint is an object that creates a small black bar at the very top of the screen with text.

Hopper.summary: Hopper is the original name of the StarterPack service.

HttpService.summary: Allows sending HTTP requests and provides various web-related and JSON methods.

properties.name: HttpEnabled
properties.summary: Indicates whether HTTP requests can be sent to external websites.

methods.name: CreateWebStreamClient
methods.summary: Creates a client that opens a persistent connection to stream data.

methods.name: GenerateGUID
methods.summary: Generates a UUID/GUID random string, optionally with curly braces.

methods.name: GetAsync
methods.summary: Sends an HTTP `GET` request.

methods.summary: Sends an HTTP request using any HTTP method given a dictionary of information.

Humanoid.summary: A special object that gives models the functionality of a character.

properties.name: AutoJumpEnabled
properties.summary: Sets whether the character will automatically jump when they hit an obstacle as a player on a mobile device.

properties.name: AutomaticScalingEnabled
properties.summary: When Enabled, AutomaticScalingEnabled causes the size of the character to change in response to the values in the humanoid's child scale values changing.

properties.name: AutoRotate
properties.summary: AutoRotate sets whether or not the Humanoid will automatically rotate to face in the direction they are moving in.

properties.name: BreakJointsOnDeath
properties.summary: Determines whether the humanoid's joints break when in the HumanoidStateType.Dead state.

properties.name: CameraOffset
properties.summary: An offset applied to the Camera's subject position when its CameraSubject is set to this Humanoid.

properties.name: CollisionType
properties.summary: Selects the HumanoidCollisionType for R15 and Rthro non-player characters.

properties.name: DisplayDistanceType
properties.summary: Controls the distance behavior of the humanoid's name and health display.

properties.name: DisplayName
properties.summary: Sets the text of a Humanoid, displayed above their head.

properties.name: EvaluateStateMachine
properties.summary: Used to disable the internal physics and state machine of the Humanoid.

properties.name: FloorMaterial
properties.summary: Describes the Material that the Humanoid is currently standing on.

properties.name: Health
properties.summary: Describes the current health of the Humanoid on the range [0, Humanoid.MaxHealth].

properties.name: HealthDisplayDistance
properties.summary: Used in conjunction with the Humanoid.DisplayDistanceType property to control the distance from which a humanoid's health bar can be seen.

properties.name: HealthDisplayType
properties.summary: Controls when the humanoid's health bar is allowed to be displayed.

properties.name: HipHeight
properties.summary: Determines the distance off the ground the Humanoid.RootPart should be.

properties.name: Jump
properties.summary: If `true`, the Humanoid jumps with an upwards force.

properties.name: JumpHeight
properties.summary: Provides control over the height that the Humanoid jumps to.

properties.name: JumpPower
properties.summary: Determines how much upwards force is applied to the Humanoid when jumping.

properties.name: LeftLeg
properties.summary: A reference to the humanoid's _Left Leg_ part.

properties.name: MaxHealth
properties.summary: The maximum value of a humanoid's Humanoid.Health.

properties.name: MaxSlopeAngle
properties.summary: The maximum slope angle that a humanoid can walk on without slipping.

properties.name: MoveDirection
properties.summary: Describes the direction that the Humanoid is walking in.

properties.name: NameDisplayDistance
properties.summary: Used in conjunction with the Humanoid.DisplayDistanceType property to control the distance from which a humanoid's name can be seen.

properties.name: NameOcclusion
properties.summary: Controls whether a humanoid's name and health bar can be seen behind walls or other objects.

properties.name: PlatformStand
properties.summary: Determines whether the Humanoid is currently in the HumanoidStateType.PlatformStanding state.

properties.name: RequiresNeck
properties.summary: Allows developers to disable the behavior where a player `Character|character` dies if the Neck Motor6D is removed or disconnected even momentarily.

properties.name: RightLeg
properties.summary: A reference to the humanoid's _Right Leg_ part.

properties.name: RigType
properties.summary: Describes whether this Humanoid is utilizing the legacy R6 character rig, or the new R15 character rig.

properties.name: RootPart
properties.summary: A reference to the humanoid's `HumanoidRootPart` object.

properties.name: SeatPart
properties.summary: A reference to the seat that a Humanoid is currently sitting in, if any.

properties.name: Sit
properties.summary: Describes whether the Humanoid is currently sitting.

properties.name: TargetPoint
properties.summary: Describes the 3D position where the Player controlling the Humanoid last clicked in the world while using a Tool.

properties.name: Torso
properties.summary: A reference to a humanoid's root driving part.

properties.name: UseJumpPower
properties.summary: Determines whether the Humanoid.JumpHeight (false) or Humanoid.JumpPower (true) property is used.

properties.name: WalkSpeed
properties.summary: Describes the humanoid's maximum movement speed in studs per second.

properties.name: WalkToPart
properties.summary: A reference to a part whose position is trying to be reached by a humanoid.

properties.name: WalkToPoint
properties.summary: The position that a humanoid is trying to reach, after a call to Humanoid:MoveTo() is made.

methods.name: AddAccessory
methods.summary: Attaches the specified Accessory to the humanoid's parent.

methods.name: AddCustomStatus
methods.summary: Adds a custom status to the Humanoid.

methods.name: AddStatus
methods.summary: Adds a BoolValue to the Humanoid's _Status_ object.

methods.name: ApplyDescription

methods.name: ApplyDescriptionAsync
methods.summary: Makes the character's look match that of the passed in HumanoidDescription.

methods.name: ApplyDescriptionReset
methods.summary: Makes the character's look match that of the passed in HumanoidDescription, even after external changes.

methods.name: ApplyDescriptionResetAsync
methods.summary: Makes the character's look match that of the passed in HumanoidDescription, even after external changes.

methods.summary: Assembles a tree of Motor6D joints by attaching together Attachment objects in a humanoid's character.

methods.name: ChangeState
methods.summary: Sets the Humanoid to enter the given HumanoidStateType.

methods.name: EquipTool
methods.summary: Makes the Humanoid equip the given Tool.

methods.name: GetAccessories
methods.summary: Returns an array of Accessory objects that the humanoid's parent is currently wearing.

methods.name: GetAppliedDescription
methods.summary: Returns a copy of the humanoid's cached HumanoidDescription which describes its current look.

methods.name: GetBodyPartR15
methods.summary: Pass a body part to this method (the body part should be a sibling of Humanoid, and a child of a Model) to get the BodyPartR15 of the Part.

methods.name: GetLimb
methods.summary: Returns the Limb enum that is associated with the given Part.

methods.name: GetMoveVelocity
methods.summary: Returns the current intended movement velocity of the Humanoid.

methods.name: GetPlayingAnimationTracks
methods.summary: Returns an array of all AnimationTrack that are currently being played on the Humanoid.

methods.name: GetRelativeVelocityAtFloor
methods.summary: Returns the humanoid's actual physical velocity relative to the surface it is standing on as a Vector3 in world-space orientation.

methods.name: GetState
methods.summary: Returns the humanoid's current HumanoidStateType.

methods.name: GetStateEnabled
methods.summary: Returns whether a HumanoidStateType is enabled for the Humanoid.

methods.name: GetStatuses
methods.summary: Returns a table of the Humanoid's statuses, and custom statuses.

methods.name: HasCustomStatus
methods.summary: Returns boolean based on if custom statuses exist.

methods.name: HasStatus
methods.summary: Returns a boolean based on if a status exists.

methods.name: LoadAnimation
methods.summary: Loads an Animation onto a Humanoid, returning an AnimationTrack that can be used for playback.

methods.name: Move
methods.summary: Causes the Humanoid to walk in the given direction.

methods.name: MoveTo
methods.summary: Causes the Humanoid to attempt to walk to the given location by setting the Humanoid.WalkToPoint and Humanoid.WalkToPart properties.

methods.name: PlayEmote
methods.summary: Plays emotes and returns if was successfully ran.

methods.name: PlayEmoteAsync
methods.summary: Plays emotes and returns if was successfully ran.

methods.name: RemoveAccessories
methods.summary: Removes all Accessory objects worn by the humanoid's parent.

methods.name: RemoveCustomStatus
methods.summary: Removes the defined custom status from the Status model in the Humanoid..

methods.name: RemoveStatus
methods.summary: Removes the defined status from the Status model in the Humanoid.

methods.name: ReplaceBodyPartR15
methods.summary: Dynamically replaces a Humanoid body part with a different part.

methods.name: SetStateEnabled
methods.summary: Sets whether a given HumanoidStateType is enabled for the Humanoid.

methods.name: TakeDamage
methods.summary: Lowers the Humanoid.Health of the Humanoid by the given _amount_ if it is not protected by a ForceField.

methods.name: UnequipTools
methods.summary: Unequips any Tool currently equipped by the Humanoid.

HumanoidController.summary: A Controller held within ControllerService that translates player input into movement for the user's character Humanoid.

HumanoidDescription.summary: Describes the appearance of a Humanoid character including body parts, accessories, colors, scales, animations, and emotes.

properties.name: AccessoryBlob
properties.summary: A JSON formatted array of Layered clothing where each table in the entry in the array describes an accessory's AssetId, AccessoryType, Order, and (optionally) Puffiness as key-value pairs.

properties.name: BackAccessory
properties.summary: A comma-separated list of asset IDs that will be added as Accessory to a Humanoid rig when Humanoid:ApplyDescriptionAsync(), usually those attached to its back (such as capes).

properties.name: BodyTypeScale
properties.summary: Determines the factor by which the shape of a Humanoid is interpolated from the standard R15 body shape (0) to a taller and more slender body type (1).

properties.name: ClimbAnimation
properties.summary: When this description is Humanoid:ApplyDescriptionAsync() to a Humanoid, this determines the Animation.AnimationId to play when its Humanoid:GetState() is HumanoidStateType.

properties.name: DepthScale
properties.summary: Determines by what factor the depth (back-to-front distance) of a Humanoid is scaled.

properties.name: Face
properties.summary: Determines the asset ID of the Face to be applied to the Humanoid.

properties.name: FaceAccessory
properties.summary: A comma-separated list of asset IDs that will be added as Accessory to a Humanoid rig when Humanoid:ApplyDescriptionAsync(), usually those attached to the front of its face (such as glasses).

properties.name: FallAnimation
properties.summary: When this description is Humanoid:ApplyDescriptionAsync() to a Humanoid, this determines the Animation.AnimationId to play when its Humanoid:GetState() is HumanoidStateType.

properties.name: FrontAccessory
properties.summary: A comma-separated list of asset IDs that will be added as Accessory to a Humanoid rig when Humanoid:ApplyDescriptionAsync(), usually those attached to front of its torso (such as medals or ties).

properties.name: GraphicTShirt
properties.summary: Determines the ShirtGraphic.Graphic used by a ShirtGraphic.

properties.name: HairAccessory
properties.summary: A comma-separated list of asset IDs that will be added as Accessory to a Humanoid rig when Humanoid:ApplyDescriptionAsync(), usually those attached to its head resembling hair.

properties.name: HatAccessory
properties.summary: A comma-separated list of asset IDs that will be added as Accessory to a Humanoid rig when Humanoid:ApplyDescriptionAsync(), usually those attached to its head.

properties.name: Head
properties.summary: Determines the asset ID of the Head to be applied to the Humanoid.

properties.name: HeadColor
properties.summary: Determines the BodyColors.HeadColor3 and BodyColors.HeadColor of a Humanoid when Humanoid:ApplyDescriptionAsync().

properties.name: HeadScale
properties.summary: Determines by what factor the **Head** object of a Humanoid is scaled, as well as any accessories attached to it.

properties.name: HeightScale
properties.summary: Determines by what factor the height (top-to-bottom distance) of a Humanoid is scaled, as well as all accessories not attached to its head.

properties.name: IdleAnimation
properties.summary: When this description is Humanoid:ApplyDescriptionAsync() to a Humanoid, this determines the Animation.AnimationId to play when its Humanoid:GetState() is HumanoidStateType at a speed near zero.

properties.name: JumpAnimation
properties.summary: When this description is Humanoid:ApplyDescriptionAsync() to a Humanoid, this determines the Animation.AnimationId to play when its Humanoid:GetState() is HumanoidStateType.

properties.name: LeftArm
properties.summary: Determines the asset ID of the LeftArm to be applied to the Humanoid.

properties.name: LeftArmColor
properties.summary: Determines the BodyColors.LeftArmColor3 and BodyColors.LeftArmColor of a Humanoid when applied.

properties.name: LeftLeg
properties.summary: Determines the asset ID of the LeftLeg to be applied to the Humanoid.

properties.name: LeftLegColor
properties.summary: Determines the BodyColors.LeftLegColor3 and BodyColors.LeftLegColor of a Humanoid when applied.

properties.name: MoodAnimation
properties.summary: When this description is Humanoid:ApplyDescriptionAsync() to a Humanoid, this determines the asset ID of the mood animation that gives the character's face its persistent expression.

properties.name: NeckAccessory
properties.summary: A comma-separated list of asset IDs that will be added as Accessory to a Humanoid rig when Humanoid:ApplyDescriptionAsync(), usually those attached to its neck (such as scarves or necklaces).

properties.name: Pants
properties.summary: Determines the Pants.PantsTemplate used by a Pants instance.

properties.name: ProportionScale
properties.summary: Determines how wide (0) or narrow (1) a Humanoid rig is.

properties.name: RightArm
properties.summary: Determines the asset ID of the RightArm to be applied to the Humanoid.

properties.name: RightArmColor
properties.summary: Determines the BodyColors.RightArmColor3 and BodyColors.RightArmColor of a Humanoid when applied.

properties.name: RightLeg
properties.summary: Determines the asset ID of the RightLeg to be applied to the Humanoid.

properties.name: RightLegColor
properties.summary: Determines the BodyColors.RightLegColor3 and BodyColors.RightLegColor of a Humanoid when applied.

properties.name: RunAnimation
properties.summary: When this description is Humanoid:ApplyDescriptionAsync() to a Humanoid, this determines the Animation.AnimationId to play when its Humanoid:GetState() is HumanoidStateType at a moderate speed.

properties.name: Shirt
properties.summary: Determines the Shirt.ShirtTemplate used by a Shirt instance.

properties.name: ShouldersAccessory
properties.summary: A comma-separated list of asset IDs that will be added as Accessory to a Humanoid rig when Humanoid:ApplyDescriptionAsync(), usually those attached to its shoulders (such as shoulder-mounted critters).

properties.name: StaticFacialAnimation
properties.summary: When `true`, disables facial animations on a Dynamic Head, displaying a static mood pose instead.

properties.name: SwimAnimation
properties.summary: When this description is Humanoid:ApplyDescriptionAsync() to a Humanoid, this determines the Animation.AnimationId to play when its Humanoid:GetState() is HumanoidStateType.

properties.name: Torso
properties.summary: Determines the asset ID of the Torso to be applied to the Humanoid.

properties.name: TorsoColor
properties.summary: Determines the BodyColors.TorsoColor3 and BodyColors.TorsoColor of a Humanoid when applied.

properties.name: UseAvatarSettings
properties.summary: When `true`, applying this description also applies the experience's Avatar Settings to the resulting model.

properties.name: WaistAccessory
properties.summary: A comma-separated list of asset IDs that will be added as Accessory to a Humanoid rig when Humanoid:ApplyDescriptionAsync(), usually those attached to its waist (such as belts).

properties.name: WalkAnimation
properties.summary: When this description is Humanoid:ApplyDescriptionAsync() to a Humanoid, this determines the Animation.AnimationId to play when its Humanoid:GetState() is HumanoidStateType at a low speed.

properties.name: WidthScale
properties.summary: Determines by what factor the width (left-to-right distance) of a Humanoid is scaled, as well as all accessories not attached to its head.

methods.name: AddEmote
methods.summary: Adds the emote to the description given a name and its asset ID.

methods.name: GetAccessories

IKControl.summary: Specifies a control to generate a procedural animation pose using Inverse Kinematics.

properties.name: ChainRoot
properties.summary: The last part that you are interested in moving your character.

properties.name: Enabled
properties.summary: Toggles the control on and off.

properties.name: EndEffector
properties.summary: The part that you are interested in moving to reach the IKControl.Target.

properties.name: EndEffectorOffset
properties.summary: An additional offset applied on top of the IKControl.EndEffector in its local space to change where it moves.

properties.name: Offset
properties.summary: An additional offset applied on top of the IKControl.Target to change where the IKControl.EndEffector moves.

properties.name: Pole
properties.summary: An optional instance that determines which way the chain bends.

properties.name: Priority
properties.summary: Specifies the order in which controls are solved.

properties.name: SmoothTime
properties.summary: Specifies the average number of seconds that it takes for the IKControl.EndEffector to smoothly reach the IKControl.Target.

properties.name: Target
properties.summary: The object that the IKControl.EndEffector reaches for or points at.

properties.name: Type
properties.summary: Specifies how the solver satisfies this control.

properties.name: Weight
properties.summary: Specifies the weight of the IK control target.

methods.name: GetChainCount
methods.summary: Returns the number of segments in the IK chain between the IKControl.ChainRoot and the IKControl.EndEffector.

methods.name: GetChainLength
methods.summary: Returns the total length, in studs, of the IK chain between the IKControl.ChainRoot and the IKControl.EndEffector.

methods.name: GetNodeLocalCFrame
methods.summary: Returns the CFrame of the chain node at the given index, relative to its parent node in the chain.

methods.name: GetNodeWorldCFrame
methods.summary: Returns the world-space CFrame of the chain node at the given index.

methods.name: GetRawFinalTarget
methods.summary: Returns the world-space target CFrame the solver aims for before IKControl.SmoothTime smoothing is applied.

methods.name: GetSmoothedFinalTarget
methods.summary: Returns the world-space target CFrame the solver aims for after IKControl.SmoothTime smoothing is applied.

properties.name: AvatarUnificationMode
properties.summary: Enables the R6 to R15 adapter, allowing R15 avatars to join R6 experiences.

properties.name: ClientAnimatorThrottling
properties.summary: Specifies the animation throttling mode for the local client.

properties.name: CurrentCamera
properties.summary: The Camera object being used by the local player.

properties.name: DistributedGameTime
properties.summary: The amount of time, in seconds, that the game has been running.

properties.name: EnableSLIMAvatars
properties.summary: Controls whether SLIM rendering is used for avatars in the experience.

properties.name: FallenPartsDestroyHeight
properties.summary: Determines the height at which falling BasePart and their ancestor Model are removed from Workspace.

properties.name: FallHeightEnabled
properties.summary: Controls whether parts that fall below Workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight are automatically destroyed.

properties.name: FilteringEnabled
properties.summary: Determines whether changes made from the client will replicate to the server or not.

properties.name: FluidForces
properties.summary: Determines whether the physics engine computes aerodynamic forces on BasePart whose BasePart.EnableFluidForces property is true.

properties.name: GlobalWind
properties.summary: Specifies the global wind vector for animated terrain grass, dynamic clouds, and particles.

properties.name: Gravity
properties.summary: Determines the acceleration due to gravity applied to falling BasePart.

properties.name: IKControlConstraintSupport
properties.summary: Enables support for constraints for IKControls.

properties.name: ImprovedAnimationConstraint
properties.summary: Controls whether improved behavior is enabled for AnimationConstraint.

properties.name: ImprovedPhysicsReplication
properties.summary: Controls whether the experience uses the improved physics replication path between the server and clients.

properties.name: InsertPoint
properties.summary: The world position at which new objects are placed when inserted from the toolbox.

properties.name: InterpolationThrottling
properties.summary: Deprecated setting that configured the interpolation throttling mode; it no longer takes effect.

properties.name: LayeredClothingCacheOptimizations
properties.summary: Controls whether layered clothing cache optimizations are enabled.

properties.name: LuauTypeCheckMode
properties.summary: Sets the Luau type checking mode for scripts in the experience.

properties.name: MeshPartHeadsAndAccessories
properties.summary: Sets whether character Heads and Accessories should be downloaded as MeshParts.

properties.name: MeshStreamingAndImprovedLods
properties.summary: Controls whether the experience uses the new mesh streaming and improved LOD system.

properties.name: ModelStreamingBehavior
properties.summary: Controls how Model are replicated in experiences when instance streaming is enabled.

properties.name: NextGenerationReplication
properties.summary: When `true`, enables an alternate replication system that alters and improves how properties are replicated under the hood.

properties.name: PathfindingUseImprovedSearch
properties.summary: Controls whether an improved search algorithm is used by PathfindingService.

properties.name: PhysicsSteppingMethod
properties.summary: Sets how the solver will advance the physics simulation forward in time.

properties.name: PlayerCharacterDestroyBehavior
properties.summary: Controls whether the engine automatically calls `Destroy()` on a player's character when it is replaced and on the `Player` object when the player leaves.

properties.name: PlayerScriptsUseInputActionSystem
properties.summary: Controls whether the built-in player scripts are updated to use the Input Action System.

properties.name: PredictiveStreamingMode
properties.summary: Controls whether the engine can make predictive streaming decisions.

properties.name: PrimalPhysicsSolver
properties.summary: Controls whether the experimental Primal Physics Solver is enabled.

properties.name: RejectCharacterDeletions
properties.summary: Controls whether the server rejects attempts by clients to delete player characters from the workspace.

properties.name: RenderingCacheOptimizations
properties.summary: Controls whether rendering cache optimizations are enabled.

properties.name: ReplicateInstanceDestroySetting
properties.summary: Controls how `Instance:Destroy()` calls are replicated from the server to clients.

properties.name: Retargeting
properties.summary: Controls whether animation retargeting is enabled for character animations.

properties.name: SandboxedInstanceMode
properties.summary: Controls whether sandboxed instance mode (script capabilities) is enabled.

properties.name: SignalBehavior
properties.summary: Configures when the engine resumes event handlers.

properties.name: StreamingEnabled
properties.summary: Whether content streaming is enabled for the place.

properties.name: StreamingIntegrityMode
properties.summary: Determines whether streaming integrity mode is active.

properties.name: StreamingMinRadius
properties.summary: Minimum distance that content will be streamed to players with high priority.

properties.name: StreamingTargetRadius
properties.summary: Maximum distance that content will be streamed to players.

properties.name: StreamOutBehavior
properties.summary: Configures how the engine decides when to stream content away from players.

properties.name: Terrain
properties.summary: A reference to the Terrain object parented to the Workspace.

properties.name: TouchesUseCollisionGroups
properties.summary: Determines whether BasePart in different groups set to not collide will ignore collisions and touch events.

properties.name: UseFixedSimulation
properties.summary: When `true`, enables RunService:BindToSimulation() which calls a function at a fixed frequency, updates physics stepping logic, and makes the RobloxGlobals.time() function return the fixed stepped frame time.

properties.name: UseNewLuauTypeSolver
properties.summary: Controls whether the new Luau type solver is used for type inference.

methods.name: ApplyRecommendedStreamingSettings
methods.summary: Applies Roblox's recommended instance streaming settings to the Workspace.

methods.name: BreakJoints
methods.summary: Goes through all BasePart given, breaking any joints connected to these parts.

methods.name: GetNumAwakeParts
methods.summary: Returns the number of BasePart that are deemed physically active, due to being recently under the influence of physics.

methods.name: GetPhysicsThrottling
methods.summary: Returns an integer, between 0 and 100, representing the percentage of real time that physics simulation is currently being throttled to.

methods.name: GetRealPhysicsFPS
methods.summary: Returns the number of frames per second that physics is currently being simulated at.

methods.name: GetServerTimeNow
methods.summary: Returns the server's Unix time in seconds.

methods.name: JoinToOutsiders
methods.summary: Creates joints between the specified BasePart and any touching parts depending on the parts' surfaces and the specified joint creation mode.

methods.name: MakeJoints
methods.summary: Goes through all BasePart given.

methods.name: PGSIsEnabled
methods.summary: Returns `true` if the game has the PGS Physics solver enabled.

methods.name: UnjoinFromOutsiders
methods.summary: Breaks all joints between the specified BasePart and other BasePart.

methods.name: ZoomToExtents
methods.summary: Positions and zooms the Workspace.CurrentCamera to show the extent of BasePart currently in the Workspace.

events.name: PersistentLoaded
events.summary: Fires when persistent models have been sent to the specified player.

WorldModel.summary: Extends limited physics to its children.

properties.name: UseWorkspaceCollisionGroups
properties.summary: Determines whether this `WorldModel` uses Workspace collision groups or its own independent collision groups for queries.

WorldRoot.summary: Base class for handling physics simulation and 3D spatial queries.

methods.name: ArePartsTouchingOthers
methods.summary: Returns true if any of the given BasePart are touching any other parts.

methods.name: Blockcast
methods.summary: Casts a block shape in a given direction and returns a RaycastResult if the shape hits a BasePart or Terrain cell.

methods.name: BulkMoveTo
methods.summary: Moves an array of BasePart to an array of CFrame.

methods.name: CollisionGroupsAreCollidable
methods.summary: Returns whether the two groups will collide in this world.

methods.name: CollisionGroupSetCollidable
methods.summary: Sets the collision status between two groups in this world.

methods.name: FindPartOnRay
methods.summary: Returns the first BasePart or Terrain cell intersecting with the given Ray.

methods.name: FindPartOnRayWithIgnoreList
methods.summary: Returns the first BasePart or Terrain cell intersecting with the given Ray that isn't in, nor is a descendant of an object in, the given ignore list.

methods.name: FindPartOnRayWithWhitelist
methods.summary: Returns the first BasePart or Terrain cell intersecting with the given Ray that is in, or is a descendant of an object in, the given inclusion list.

methods.name: FindPartsInRegion3
methods.summary: Returns an array of BasePart in the given Region3.

methods.name: FindPartsInRegion3WithIgnoreList
methods.summary: Returns an array of BasePart in the given Region3 that aren't in, or a descendant of an entry in, the given ignore list.

methods.name: FindPartsInRegion3WithWhiteList
methods.summary: Returns an array of BasePart in the given Region3 that are in, or descendant of an entry in, the given inclusion list.

methods.name: GetMaxCollisionGroups
methods.summary: Returns the maximum number of collision groups in this world.

methods.name: GetPartBoundsInBox
methods.summary: Returns an array of parts whose **bounding boxes** overlap a given box.

params.name: overlapParams
params.default: OverlapParams{MaxParts=0, Tolerance=0, BruteForceAllSlow=false, RespectCanCollide=false, CollisionGroup=Default, FilterDescendantsInstances={}}

methods.name: GetPartBoundsInRadius
methods.summary: Returns an array of parts whose **bounding boxes** overlap a given sphere.

params.name: overlapParams
params.default: OverlapParams{MaxParts=0, Tolerance=0, BruteForceAllSlow=false, RespectCanCollide=false, CollisionGroup=Default, FilterDescendantsInstances={}}

methods.name: GetPartsInPart
methods.summary: Returns an array of parts whose occupied space is shared with the given part.

params.name: overlapParams
params.default: OverlapParams{MaxParts=0, Tolerance=0, BruteForceAllSlow=false, RespectCanCollide=false, CollisionGroup=Default, FilterDescendantsInstances={}}

methods.name: GetRegisteredCollisionGroups
methods.summary: Returns a table with info on all of this world's collision groups.

methods.name: IKMoveTo
methods.summary: Moves the specified part to the specified location via inverse kinematics rather than moving it there directly, to ensure any joints, constraints, or collisions that part is participating in remain physically satisfied.

methods.name: IsCollisionGroupRegistered
methods.summary: Checks if a collision group is registered in this world.

methods.name: IsRegion3Empty
methods.summary: Returns a bool indicating whether there are no BasePart within the given Region3.

methods.name: IsRegion3EmptyWithIgnoreList
methods.summary: Returns a boolean indicating whether there are no BasePart within the given Region3, ignoring any BasePart that are descendants of the objects within the given ignore list.

methods.name: Raycast
methods.summary: Casts a ray using an origin, direction, and optional RaycastParams, then returns a RaycastResult if an eligible object or terrain intersects the ray.

methods.name: RegisterCollisionGroup
methods.summary: Registers a new collision group in this world with the given name.

methods.name: RenameCollisionGroup
methods.summary: Renames specified collision group in this world.

methods.name: Shapecast
methods.summary: Casts the shape of a given BasePart in a direction and returns a RaycastResult if the shape hits a BasePart or Terrain cell.

methods.name: Spherecast
methods.summary: Casts a spherical shape in a given direction and returns a RaycastResult if the shape hits a BasePart or Terrain cell.

methods.name: StepPhysics
methods.summary: Advances the simulation for parts in the world forward based on a specified time increment and an optional set of BasePart.

methods.name: UnregisterCollisionGroup
methods.summary: Unregisters the collision group for the given name in this world.

WrapDeformer.summary: Allows for the real-time deformation of a MeshPart.

methods.name: CreateEditableMeshAsync
methods.summary: Returns an EditableMesh (currently unskinned) equivalent to the deformed parent mesh.

methods.name: GetDeformedCFrameAsync
methods.summary: Returns a CFrame deformed comparably to the MeshPart.

methods.name: SetCageMeshContent
methods.summary: Sets the cage mesh used to deform against a sibling WrapTarget cage mesh.

WrapLayer.summary: The WrapLayer object defines a 3D accessory's inner and outer surfaces and other properties related to layering accessories.

properties.name: AutoSkin
properties.summary: Determines whether this WrapLayer automatically transfers skinning data from the underlying body mesh to the clothing mesh.

properties.name: BindOffset
properties.summary: CFrame is used to adjust a binding point for clothing item mesh.

properties.name: Color
properties.summary: Sets color used for the debug rendering.

properties.name: DebugMode
properties.summary: Allows switching between different debugging visualization modes for cage meshes.

properties.name: Enabled
properties.summary: Allows for disabling of the WrapLayer object as if it does not exist.

properties.name: Order
properties.summary: Controls the composition order for layered clothing.

properties.name: Puffiness
properties.summary: Controls how much underlying clothing items inflate the current clothing item.

properties.name: ReferenceMeshContent
properties.summary: The reference mesh that defines the Inner Cage of the WrapLayer, stored as a Content value.

properties.name: ReferenceMeshId
properties.summary: AssetID for reference mesh used to define Inner Cage of a 3D object.

properties.name: ReferenceOrigin
properties.summary: Reference mesh offset relative to parent MeshPart (in the parent MeshPart space) Note: this property is set up automatically by the FBX importer.

properties.name: ReferenceOriginWorld
properties.summary: Reference mesh offset relative to parent MeshPart (in the world space) Note: this property is set up automatically by the FBX importer.

properties.name: ShrinkFactor
properties.summary: Allows slight shrinking/expanding of the resulting render mesh, without affecting any other layers.

WrapTarget.summary: The WrapTarget object defines a target.

properties.name: Color
properties.summary: Sets color used for the debug rendering.

properties.name: DebugMode
properties.summary: Allows switching between different debugging visualization modes for cage meshes.

properties.name: Stiffness
properties.summary: Defines how much the body mesh can be compressed by clothing.

methods.name: CreateTextureInCageSpaceAsync
methods.summary: Creates a new EditableImage in cage UV space from a texture in the parent MeshPart's UV space.

methods.name: CreateTextureInTargetSpaceAsync
methods.summary: Creates a new EditableImage in the parent MeshPart's UV space from a texture in cage UV space.

WrapTextureTransfer.summary: WrapTextureTransfer allows a parent Decal to be wrapped around its parent MeshPart based on the cage of its WrapTarget.

properties.name: ReferenceCageMeshContent
properties.summary: An optional reference mesh used for pruning and validating the target cage.

properties.name: UVMaxBound
properties.summary: Determines the maximum bound of the UV space to include in the transfer.

properties.name: UVMinBound
properties.summary: Determines the minimum bound of the UV space to include in the transfer.

AccessModifierType.summary: Determines whether an AudioDeviceInput user ID access list acts as an allow-list or a deny-list.

items.name: Allow
items.summary: User IDs in the access list are permitted to hear the AudioDeviceInput - all other users are blocked.

items.name: Deny
items.summary: User IDs in the access list are blocked from hearing the AudioDeviceInput - all other users are permitted.

AccessoryType.summary: A subset of AssetTypes which are relevant to only accessories.

items.name: Unknown
items.summary: If the accessory type is not known.

items.name: Hat
items.summary: A hat accessory (may be a rigid or layered accessory).

items.name: Hair
items.summary: A hair accessory (may be a rigid or layered accessory).

items.name: Face
items.summary: A face accessory (may be a rigid or layered accessory).

items.name: Neck
items.summary: A neck Accessory (may be a rigid or layered accessory).

items.name: Shoulder
items.summary: A shoulder accessory (may be a rigid or layered accessory).

items.name: Front
items.summary: A front accessory (may be a rigid or layered accessory).

items.name: Back
items.summary: A back accessory (may be a rigid or layered accessory).

items.name: Waist
items.summary: A waist accessory (may be a rigid or layered accessory).

items.name: TShirt
items.summary: A layered clothing T-Shirt accessory.

items.name: Shirt
items.summary: A layered clothing shirt accessory.

items.name: Pants
items.summary: A layered clothing pants accessory.

items.name: Jacket
items.summary: A layered clothing jacket accessory.

items.name: Sweater
items.summary: A layered clothing sweater accessory.

items.name: Shorts
items.summary: A layered clothing shorts accessory.

items.name: LeftShoe
items.summary: A layered clothing left shoe accessory.

items.name: RightShoe
items.summary: A layered clothing right shoe accessory.

items.name: DressSkirt
items.summary: A layered clothing dress or skirt accessory.

items.name: Eyebrow
items.summary: A layered accessory for avatar eyebrows.

items.name: Eyelash
items.summary: A layered accessory for avatar eyelashes.

ActionOnStopSync.summary: Specifies how Roblox Studio handles local files when file sync stops.

items.name: AlwaysAsk
items.summary: Prompts before deleting local files when file sync stops.

items.name: KeepLocalFiles
items.summary: Keeps local files when file sync stops.

items.name: DeleteLocalFiles
items.summary: Deletes local files when file sync stops.

ActionType.summary: Describes the outcome of a game action, such as winning, losing, or drawing.

items.name: Nothing
items.summary: No specific game action occurred.

items.name: Pause
items.summary: The game or round was paused.

items.name: Lose
items.summary: The player lost the game or round.

items.name: Draw
items.summary: The game or round ended in a draw with no winner.

items.name: Win
items.summary: The player won the game or round.

ActivePayerStatus.summary: Describes a player's payer status bucket for the current experience.

items.name: Unknown
items.summary: Segment data is unavailable.

items.name: Never
items.summary: The player has not made a qualifying purchase in the experience.

items.name: Lapsed
items.summary: The player has previously spent in the experience but is not currently an active payer.

items.name: Casual50Percent
items.summary: The player is in the casual payer bucket for the experience.

items.name: Intermediate35Percent
items.summary: The player is in the intermediate payer bucket for the experience.

items.name: Top15Percent
items.summary: The player is in the top payer bucket for the experience.

ActuatorRelativeTo.summary: Determines the coordinate frame in which a mover constraint's directional properties are expressed.

items.name: Attachment0
items.summary: The directional property is interpreted in the local coordinate frame of Constraint.Attachment0, rotating with its parent part.

items.name: Attachment1
items.summary: The directional property is interpreted in the local coordinate frame of Constraint.Attachment1, rotating with its parent part.

items.name: World
items.summary: The directional property is interpreted in world-space coordinates, remaining constant regardless of part orientation.

ActuatorType.summary: The active physics component of the constraint.

items.name: None
items.summary: The motor and servo components are both disabled.

items.name: Motor
items.summary: The motor component is enabled.

items.name: Servo
items.summary: The servo component is enabled.

AdAvailabilityResult.summary: Indicates whether an ad is available or the reason it cannot be shown.

items.name: IsAvailable
items.summary: An ad is available to show the user.

items.name: DeviceIneligible
items.summary: The device is ineligible to receive ads.

items.name: ExperienceIneligible
items.summary: The experience is ineligible to receive ads.

items.name: InternalError
items.summary: An unspecified internal error occurred.

items.name: NoFill
items.summary: There are no ads available to fill your ad request.

items.name: PlayerIneligible
items.summary: The user is ineligible to receive ads during this session.

items.name: PublisherIneligible
items.summary: The publisher is ineligible to receive ads because they have not met the publisher eligibility requirements.

AdFormat.summary: Specifies the format of an ad used with AdService methods.

items.name: RewardedVideo
items.summary: A full-screen video ad that plays to completion and rewards the viewer, used as the `adFormat` argument for AdService methods.

AdShape.summary: Describes the form factor of an ad in an AdGui.

items.name: HorizontalRectangle
items.summary: The ad has an aspect ratio of 16:9 and a minimum size of 8 by 4.5 studs.

AdTeleportMethod.summary: Describes the method by which a player teleports during an immersive ad portal flow.

items.name: Undefined
items.summary: Default uninitialized sentinel value indicating that no teleport method has been determined yet.

items.name: PortalForward
items.summary: The player teleported forward to the advertiser's destination experience by walking into an AdPortal.

items.name: InGameMenuBackButton
items.summary: The player initiated a return teleport to the publisher's experience by pressing the back button in the in-game menu.

items.name: UIBackButton
items.summary: The player initiated a return teleport to the publisher's experience by pressing a back button rendered in the ad destination's UI overlay.

AdUIEventType.summary: Describes the type of user-interaction or system event that occurred on the immersive ad UI overlay of an AdGui.

items.name: AdLabelClicked
items.summary: The player clicked the "Sponsored" label on the ad overlay, which opens the ad disclosure prompt showing advertiser and payer information.

items.name: VolumeButtonClicked
items.summary: The player clicked the volume toggle button on the ad overlay, which mutes or unmutes the video ad audio.

items.name: FullscreenButtonClicked
items.summary: The player clicked the fullscreen toggle button, which smoothly zooms the camera to a centered view of the ad surface and enables audio.

items.name: PlayButtonClicked
items.summary: The player clicked the play button on the ad overlay.

items.name: PauseButtonClicked
items.summary: The player clicked the pause button while a video ad is playing in fullscreen mode, which pauses video playback.

items.name: CloseButtonClicked
items.summary: The player clicked the close button on the fullscreen video ad view, which exits fullscreen mode and returns to the normal camera position.

items.name: WhyThisAdClicked
items.summary: The player clicked the "Why this ad?" link, which displays the EUDSA (European Digital Services Act) disclosure prompt showing the advertiser and payer names for the current ad creative.

items.name: PlayEventTriggered
items.summary: A system-initiated play/resume event that clears the force-pause state and resumes video playback if the stream is open.

items.name: PauseEventTriggered
items.summary: A system-initiated pause event, used when the engine needs to force-pause the video (for example, when a dropdown menu opens over the ad).

AdUIType.summary: Describes the type of ad creative currently rendered by an AdGui.

items.name: None
items.summary: The AdGui has no ad creative loaded and is not rendering ad content.

items.name: Image
items.summary: The AdGui is rendering a static image ad creative.

items.name: Video
items.summary: The AdGui is rendering a video ad creative.

AdUnitStatus.summary: Exposes the status of an immersive ad.

items.name: Inactive
items.summary: The ad unit isn't currently serving an ad and it may be configured incorrectly.

items.name: Active
items.summary: The ad unit is currently serving an ad.

items.name: Automatic
items.summary: Automatically culls adornment based on distance.

items.name: Never
items.summary: Never culls adornment.

AdornShading.summary: Determines the shading material and render pass used to draw a handle adornment.

items.name: Default
items.summary: Draws the adornment unlit and occluded by scene geometry like an ordinary world object.

items.name: Shaded
items.summary: Draws the adornment lit by scene lighting and occluded by scene geometry.

items.name: XRay
items.summary: Draws the adornment unlit and visible through geometry that would otherwise occlude it.

items.name: XRayShaded
items.summary: Draws the adornment lit by scene lighting and visible through geometry that would otherwise occlude it.

items.name: AlwaysOnTop
items.summary: Draws the adornment unlit on top of all other geometry with no depth testing.

AgeCheckStatus.summary: Indicates whether a player has completed age verification.

items.name: Unchecked
items.summary: The player has not yet completed age verification.

items.name: Checked
items.summary: The player has successfully completed age verification.

AlignType.summary: An enum that specifies how the constraint will attempt to align the body associated with the constraint.

items.name: PrimaryAxisParallel
items.summary: Aligns the primary axis to be parallel to the axis given by Constraint.Attachment1.

items.name: PrimaryAxisPerpendicular
items.summary: Aligns the primary axis to be perpendicular to the axis given by Constraint.Attachment1.

items.name: PrimaryAxisLookAt
items.summary: Aligns the primary axis to look at the point given by Constraint.Attachment1 or the AlignOrientation.LookAtPosition.

items.name: AllAxes
items.summary: Aligns all of the axes of Constraint.Attachment0 to the axes given by Constraint.Attachment1 or to the target orientation provided by AlignOrientation.PrimaryAxis and AlignOrientation.SecondaryAxis.

AlphaMode.summary: Used by SurfaceAppearance.AlphaMode to determine how the alpha channel of the SurfaceAppearance.ColorMap of a SurfaceAppearance is used.

items.name: Overlay
items.summary: Overlays the SurfaceAppearance.ColorMap on top of the underlying part color based on the map's alpha channel.

items.name: Transparency
items.summary: Uses the SurfaceAppearance.ColorMap alpha channel to control the transparency of the surface.

items.name: TintMask
items.summary: Uses the SurfaceAppearance.ColorMap alpha channel to control the amount of SurfaceAppearance.Color tinting.

items.name: Opaque
items.summary: Ignores the SurfaceAppearance.ColorMap alpha channel and assumes an opacity value of 1 everywhere.

AnalyticsCustomFieldKeys.summary: Used to form a dictionary of custom fields to provide breakdowns in Roblox-provided charts.

items.name: CustomField01
items.summary: The first custom field key, used to provide a breakdown dimension in Roblox-provided analytics charts.

items.name: CustomField02
items.summary: The second custom field key, used to provide a breakdown dimension in Roblox-provided analytics charts.

items.name: CustomField03
items.summary: The third custom field key, used to provide a breakdown dimension in Roblox-provided analytics charts.

AnalyticsEconomyAction.summary: Describes the type of economic transaction in AnalyticsService:FireInGameEconomyEvent().

items.name: Default
items.summary: Default action.

items.name: Acquire
items.summary: Indicates the acquisition of an in game resource.

items.name: Spend
items.summary: Indicates the spending or loss of an in game resource.

AnalyticsEconomyFlowType.summary: Specifies the direction of currency flow in an economy event logged by AnalyticsService:LogEconomyEvent().

items.name: Sink
items.summary: Currency is being removed from the player's account.

items.name: Source
items.summary: Currency is being added to the player's account.

AnalyticsEconomyTransactionType.summary: Categorizes the context of an in-experience economic transaction for use with AnalyticsService:LogEconomyEvent().

items.name: IAP
items.summary: Represents a source of currency purchased via Robux, for example in-experience "gold" purchased for Robux.

items.name: Shop
items.summary: Purchases within a shop, for example in-experience "coins" used to buy an item within the experience.

items.name: Gameplay
items.summary: Currency earned or paid through gameplay, for example in-experience "gold" earned from winning a match.

items.name: ContextualPurchase
items.summary: Purchase with direct context to a reward, for example in-experience "gold" used to purchase an extra life.

items.name: TimedReward
items.summary: Time-based reward, for example in-experience "gold" rewarded for logging in daily.

items.name: Onboarding
items.summary: Transaction related to onboarding, for example in-experience "gold" rewarded for completing the tutorial.

AnalyticsLogLevel.summary: Specifies the severity level of an analytics log event passed to AnalyticsService:FireLogEvent().

items.name: Trace
items.summary: Trace is the noisiest level, rarely (if ever) enabled for a production app.

items.name: Debug
items.summary: Used for debugging.

items.name: Information
items.summary: Used for general informational messages that highlight progress or state changes during normal operation.

items.name: Warning
items.summary: Used for warning.

items.name: Error
items.summary: When functionality is unavailable or expectations broken.

items.name: Fatal
items.summary: The most critical level, Fatal events demand immediate attention.

AnalyticsProgressionStatus.summary: This enum is used as an argument in AnalyticsService:FirePlayerProgressionEvent() to describe the status of progression.

items.name: Default
items.summary: Default status.

items.name: Begin
items.summary: Indicates the beginning of progression.

items.name: Complete
items.summary: Indicates the progression completed.

items.name: Abandon
items.summary: Indicates the progression abandoned.

items.name: Fail
items.summary: Indicates the progression failed.

AnalyticsProgressionType.summary: Specifies the player's progression status in a level-progression event logged by AnalyticsService:LogProgressionEvent().

items.name: Custom
items.summary: A custom progression status for events outside the standard start/fail/complete lifecycle.

items.name: Start
items.summary: The player started the level attempt.

items.name: Fail
items.summary: The player failed the level attempt.

items.name: Complete
items.summary: The player completed the level successfully.

AnimationClipFromVideoStatus.summary: Indicates the current status or final outcome of a video-to-animation conversion started by AssetService:PromptImportAnimationClipFromVideoAsync().

items.name: Initializing
items.summary: The video-to-animation job is being set up on the server.

items.name: Pending
items.summary: The job has been queued on the server and is waiting for processing resources to become available.

items.name: Processing
items.summary: The server is actively analyzing the video and extracting motion-capture data to generate the animation clip.

items.name: ErrorGeneric
items.summary: The server-side video processing encountered an unspecified error.

items.name: Success
items.summary: The video was successfully converted into an AnimationClip, which is returned as the second element of the result tuple.

items.name: ErrorVideoTooLong
items.summary: Processing failed because the uploaded video exceeds the maximum allowed duration (15 seconds).

items.name: ErrorNoPersonDetected
items.summary: Processing failed because no person could be detected in the video; the video must show a person fully in frame, facing the camera.

items.name: ErrorVideoUnstable
items.summary: Processing failed because the video is too shaky for reliable motion capture; a more stable recording is required.

items.name: Timeout
items.summary: Processing could not be completed in time, typically due to high request volume on the video processing backend.

items.name: Cancelled
items.summary: The player declined the consent prompt or provided no input, so the video upload was not started.

items.name: ErrorMultiplePeople
items.summary: Processing failed because more than one person was detected in the video; the video must contain a single person fully in frame.

items.name: ErrorUploadingVideo
items.summary: The client-side video upload failed before the video reached the processing backend.

AnimationNodeBlendMode.summary: Specifies how an AnimationNodeType.OneShotNode combines its one-shot pose with its base pose.

items.name: Over
items.summary: Composites the one-shot pose on top of the base pose, replacing it by the current blend weight.

items.name: Add
items.summary: Adds the one-shot pose to the base pose as an additive layer scaled by the current blend weight.

items.name: Subtract
items.summary: Subtracts the one-shot pose from the base pose scaled by the current blend weight.

AnimationNodeType.summary: Specifies the type of an animation graph node, determining how it processes or combines animation data.

items.name: InvalidNode
items.summary: The default unassigned type indicating a node has not been configured.

items.name: AddNode
items.summary: An additive blend node that layers an additive pose on top of a base pose.

items.name: OverNode
items.summary: A layering node that composites an overlay pose on top of a base pose using per-joint masking.

items.name: Blend1DNode
items.summary: A blend node that interpolates between multiple inputs along a single numeric axis.

items.name: Blend2DNode
items.summary: A blend node that interpolates between multiple inputs using a two-dimensional position.

items.name: ClipNode
items.summary: A leaf node that plays back an animation clip asset.

items.name: GraphOutput
items.summary: The terminal output node of an animation graph that receives the final pose.

items.name: MaskNode
items.summary: A node that filters its input pose through a per-joint weight mask.

items.name: PrioritySelectNode
items.summary: A state node that plays the highest-priority input whose trigger condition is true.

items.name: RandomSequenceNode
items.summary: A sequence node that plays its inputs in a weighted random order.

items.name: SelectNode
items.summary: A state node that plays whichever input is chosen by a string selection parameter.

items.name: SequenceNode
items.summary: A node that plays its inputs one after another in order, optionally looping.

items.name: SpeedNode
items.summary: A node that scales the playback speed of its input.

items.name: SubtractNode
items.summary: A blend node that subtracts one pose from another to produce a difference pose.

items.name: OneShotNode
items.summary: A layering node that plays a one-shot pose over a looping base pose on trigger, blending it in and back out.

items.name: StateMachineNode
items.summary: A node that selects and transitions between animation states according to a state machine definition.

AnimationPriority.summary: The AnimationPriority Enum determines how concurrently-playing AnimationTracks contribute to the final animation.

items.name: Idle
items.summary: (6) - Recommended priority for character idle animations.

items.name: Movement
items.summary: (5) - Recommended priority for walk, run, swim, climb, and other locomotion animations.

items.name: Action
items.summary: (4) - Recommended priority for character actions that must override idle and locomotion animations.

items.name: Action2
items.summary: (3) - Action2 will override Action.

items.name: Action3
items.summary: (2) - Action3 will override Action2.

items.name: Action4
items.summary: (1) - Action4 is the highest priority available, overriding all other priority values.

items.name: Core
items.summary: (7) - Lowest priority, intended for use by Roblox default animations and catalog animation bundles.

items.name: Default
items.summary: Retargeting in default state, opt-in initially but subject to change.

items.name: Disabled
items.summary: Animation retargeting is off; animations play exactly as authored without adapting joint transforms to the character's body proportions.

items.name: Enabled
items.summary: Animation retargeting is always active; the Animator adapts animations to the character's body proportions regardless of the platform default.

items.name: Enabled

AudioChannelLayout.summary: Describes the channel layout of an audio stream.

items.name: Mono
items.summary: Monaural audio streams contain only one **Center** channel.

items.name: Stereo
items.summary: Stereophonic audio streams consist of two channels: **Left** and **Right**.

items.name: Quad
items.summary: Quadrophonic audio streams consist of four channels: **Left**, **Right**, **BackLeft**, and **BackRight**.

items.name: Surround_5
items.summary: Surround sound audio streams consist of five channels: **Left**, **Right**, **Center**, **BackLeft**, and **BackRight**.

items.name: Surround_5_1
items.summary: 5.1 surround sound consists of six channels: **Left**, **Right**, **Center**, **BackLeft**, **BackRight**, and a **Sub** (subsonic) low‑frequency channel.

items.name: Surround_7_1
items.summary: 7.1 surround sound consists of eight channels: **Left**, **Right**, **Center**, **SurroundLeft**, **SurroundRight**, **BackLeft**, **BackRight**, and a **Sub** (subsonic) low‑frequency channel.

items.name: Surround_7_1_4
items.summary: 7.1.4 surround sound consists of twelve channels: **Left**, **Right**, **Center**, **SurroundLeft**, **SurroundRight**, **BackLeft**, **BackRight**, **Sub**, **TopLeft**, **TopRight**, **TopBackLeft**, and **TopBackRight**.

AudioFilterType.summary: Filter types used for AudioFilter instances.

items.name: Peak
items.summary: Filter that boosts or reduces sound near a specified AudioFilter.Frequency.

items.name: LowShelf
items.summary: Filter that boosts or reduces sound below a specified AudioFilter.Frequency.

items.name: HighShelf
items.summary: Filter that boosts or reduces sound above a specified AudioFilter.Frequency.

items.name: Lowpass12dB
items.summary: Filter that cuts sound above a specified AudioFilter.Frequency, at a slope of -12dB/octave.

items.name: Lowpass24dB
items.summary: Filter that cuts sound above a specified AudioFilter.Frequency, at a slope of -24dB/octave.

items.name: Lowpass48dB
items.summary: Filter that cuts sound above a specified AudioFilter.Frequency, at a slope of -48dB/octave.

items.name: Highpass12dB
items.summary: Filter that cuts sound below a specified AudioFilter.Frequency, at a slope of -12dB/octave.

items.name: Highpass24dB
items.summary: Filter that cuts sound below a specified AudioFilter.Frequency, at a slope of -24dB/octave.

items.name: Highpass48dB
items.summary: Filter that cuts sound below a specified AudioFilter.Frequency, at a slope of -48dB/octave.

items.name: Bandpass
items.summary: Filter that only allows sound near a specified AudioFilter.Frequency to be heard.

items.name: Notch
items.summary: Filter that cuts sound near a specified AudioFilter.Frequency.

items.name: Lowpass6dB
items.summary: Filter that cuts sound above a specified AudioFilter.Frequency, at a slope of -6dB/octave.

AvatarSettingsAccessoryLimitMethod.summary: Determines how `AvatarAccessoryRules` enforces accessory size limits when an accessory exceeds the configured bounds.

items.name: Scale
items.summary: Scales down rigid accessories that exceed the configured bounds, or removes them if scaling would reduce them below minimum size thresholds.

items.name: Remove
items.summary: Destroys any rigid accessory whose bounding box exceeds the configured bounds.

items.name: PreviewScale
items.summary: Reports whether an accessory would be scaled or removed for exceeding the configured bounds without actually modifying it.

items.name: PreviewRemove
items.summary: Reports whether an accessory would be removed for exceeding the configured bounds without actually destroying it.

AvatarSettingsAccessoryMode.summary: Determines whether `AvatarAccessoryRules` enforces custom size limits on rigid accessories worn by player avatars.

items.name: PlayerChoice
items.summary: No custom size limits are applied to rigid accessories; the player's own accessory choices are displayed without modification.

items.name: CustomLimit
items.summary: The experience enforces custom size limits on rigid accessories using the LimitBounds and LimitMethod properties of `AvatarAccessoryRules`.

AvatarSettingsAnimationClipsMode.summary: Determines whether avatar animation clips are defined by the experience or if they are determined by `AnimationPacksMode`.

items.name: PlayerChoice
items.summary: The clips determined by the `AnimationPacksMode` are used, without experience-level overrides.

items.name: CustomClips
items.summary: The experience overrides individual animation clips using the per-clip enabled and ID properties on `AvatarAnimationRules` (for example, `CustomRunAnimationEnabled` and `CustomRunAnimationId`).

AvatarSettingsAnimationPacksMode.summary: Determines which base animation pack is applied to avatar characters, controlling whether players use their own equipped animations or the experience forces a standard R15 or R6 animation set.

items.name: PlayerChoice
items.summary: The player's own equipped animation pack is used.

items.name: StandardR15
items.summary: The experience forces the standard R15 animation pack on all characters, overriding player-equipped animations with a fixed set of R15 locomotion clips.

items.name: StandardR6
items.summary: The experience forces the standard R6 animation pack on all (R15) characters, overriding player-equipped animations with a fixed set of R6-style locomotion clips plus additional R6-style emote and tool animations.

AvatarSettingsAppearanceMode.summary: Determines how the avatar's body-part appearance is sourced in an experience that uses `AvatarBodyRules`.

items.name: PlayerChoice
items.summary: Players keep their own avatar body parts; the experience does not override any body-part assets.

items.name: CustomParts
items.summary: The experience overrides individual body parts (head, face, torso, arms, legs) using per-part asset IDs and enablement settings on `AvatarBodyRules`.

items.name: CustomBody
items.summary: The experience replaces the avatar's entire body as a single unit, using `CustomBodyType` and `CustomBodyBundleId`.

AvatarSettingsBuildMode.summary: Determines whether players can freely scale their avatar body or whether the experience enforces custom scale ranges.

items.name: PlayerChoice
items.summary: Players can scale their avatar body freely within the full platform-wide limits.

items.name: CustomBuild
items.summary: The experience enforces creator-defined min/max ranges for avatar body scales (height, width, head, body type, and proportions), overriding the platform defaults.

AvatarSettingsClothingMode.summary: Determines whether the experience applies a spatial bounding limit to layered clothing on player characters.

items.name: PlayerChoice
items.summary: No spatial limit is applied to layered clothing; the player's layered clothing accessories deform without a bounding constraint.

items.name: CustomLimit
items.summary: Applies a custom spatial limit to layered clothing based on `LimitBounds`.

AvatarSettingsCollisionMode.summary: Determines the collision geometry mode for avatars managed by `AvatarCollisionRules`.

items.name: Default
items.summary: Each body part uses its native collision geometry.

items.name: SingleCollider
items.summary: A single box-shaped collider part replaces all per-part collision.

items.name: Legacy
items.summary: Collision geometry is determined by `LegacyCollisionMode`, which selects either inner-box colliders or R6-style colliders.

AvatarSettingsCustomAccessoryMode.summary: Determines whether `AvatarAccessoryRules` replaces player accessories with experience-defined custom accessories.

items.name: PlayerChoice
items.summary: No custom accessory replacement is applied; the player's own accessory choices are displayed without modification.

items.name: CustomAccessories
items.summary: The experience replaces player accessories with custom accessories defined by the per-slot properties on `AvatarAccessoryRules`.

AvatarSettingsCustomBodyType.summary: Determines whether an experience's custom body override is identified by individual asset references or by a single bundle ID.

items.name: AvatarReference
items.summary: The custom body is assembled from individual per-part asset references on `AvatarBodyRules`.

items.name: BundleId
items.summary: The custom body is sourced from a single avatar bundle, identified by the `CustomBodyBundleId` property.

AvatarSettingsCustomClothingMode.summary: Determines whether an experience overrides a player's classic 2D or layered 3D clothing with creator-specified assets or preserves the player's own clothing choices.

items.name: PlayerChoice
items.summary: Players keep their own clothing selections.

items.name: CustomClothing
items.summary: The experience enforces creator-specified clothing assets from `AvatarClothingRules`, overriding each player's own equipped clothing.

AvatarSettingsHitAndTouchDetectionMode.summary: Determines whether hit detection and spatial queries use the individual body parts or the single collider when `AvatarCollisionRules.CollisionMode` is AvatarSettingsCollisionMode.SingleCollider.

items.name: UseParts
items.summary: Individual avatar body parts handle `Touched` events and spatial queries (`CanTouch` and `CanQuery` enabled on body parts) while the single collider part has `CanTouch` and `CanQuery` disabled.

items.name: UseCollider
items.summary: The single collider part handles `Touched` events and spatial queries (`CanTouch` and `CanQuery` enabled on the collider) while all individual body parts have `CanTouch` and `CanQuery` disabled.

AvatarSettingsJumpMode.summary: Determines whether the avatar jump setting for an experience is configured using jump height (studs) or jump power (force).

items.name: JumpHeight
items.summary: The avatar jump is configured using Humanoid.JumpHeight, which specifies the target jump height in studs.

items.name: JumpPower
items.summary: The avatar jump is configured using Humanoid.JumpPower, which applies an upward force to the character.

AvatarSettingsLegacyCollisionMode.summary: Determines which legacy collision geometry is applied to R15 avatars when AvatarSettingsCollisionMode is set to Legacy.

items.name: R6Colliders
items.summary: Creates six invisible box collider parts welded to R15 limbs to approximate classic R6 collision geometry.

items.name: InnerBoxColliders
items.summary: Overrides each R15 mesh part's collision physics with inner-box geometry derived from the standard R15 scaling model.

AvatarSettingsScaleMode.summary: Determines whether the experience enforces a custom height range on player characters or allows players to spawn at their natural avatar height.

items.name: PlayerChoice
items.summary: Characters spawn at their natural avatar height without any experience-level height override.

items.name: CustomScale
items.summary: The experience clamps the character's height to the range specified by `CustomHeight`, overriding the player's natural avatar height.

AvatarUnificationMode.summary: Controls whether the R6 to R15 adapter is active, allowing R15 avatars to join R6 experiences.

items.name: Default
items.summary: Resolves to the engine's current built-in default for avatar unification, which currently behaves the same as `Disabled`.

items.name: Disabled
items.summary: Disables the R6-to-R15 adapter; R6 avatars in an R6 experience load using the standard R6 rig with no adapter parts applied.

items.name: Enabled
items.summary: Enables the R6-to-R15 adapter; R6 avatars joining an R6 experience receive invisible R15 adapter MeshPart welded to their R6-named joints, preserving R6 scale while enabling R15 features such as layered clothing and animatable heads.

items.name: X
items.summary: The X axis.

items.name: Y
items.summary: The Y axis.

items.name: Z
items.summary: The Z axis.

BenefitType.summary: Indicates the type of virtual benefit granted to a user when they purchase a commerce product through CommerceService.

items.name: DeveloperProduct
items.summary: The benefit is a developer product whose receipt is delivered through MarketplaceService:BindReceiptHandler() upon purchase of a commerce product.

items.name: AvatarAsset
items.summary: The benefit is a single avatar asset granted to the user's inventory upon purchase of a commerce product.

items.name: AvatarBundle
items.summary: The benefit is an avatar bundle granted to the user's inventory upon purchase of a commerce product.

BodyPart.summary: The BodyPart Enum determines which BodyPart a CharacterMesh affects.

items.name: Head
items.summary: The head BodyPart.

items.name: Torso

items.name: RightArm

items.name: LeftLeg

items.name: RightLeg

BodyPartR15.summary: BodyPartR15 is an enum with entries for each of the 15 body parts of an R15 character (plus an entry for the HumanoidRootPart).

items.name: UpperTorso
items.summary: Reference to a Humanoid's UpperTorso.

items.name: LowerTorso
