items.summary: Reference to a Humanoid's LeftUpperLeg.

items.name: RightFoot
items.summary: Reference to a Humanoid's RightFoot.

items.name: RightLowerLeg
items.summary: Reference to a Humanoid's RightLowerLeg.

items.name: RightUpperLeg
items.summary: Reference to a Humanoid's RightUpperLeg.

items.name: LeftHand
items.summary: Reference to a Humanoid's LeftHand.

items.name: LeftLowerArm
items.summary: Reference to a Humanoid's LeftLowerArm.

items.name: LeftUpperArm
items.summary: Reference to a Humanoid's LeftUpperArm.

items.name: RightHand
items.summary: Reference to a Humanoid's RightHand.

items.name: RightLowerArm
items.summary: Reference to a Humanoid's RightLowerArm.

items.name: RightUpperArm
items.summary: Reference to a Humanoid's RightUpperArm.

items.name: RootPart
items.summary: Reference to a Humanoid's HumanoidRootPart.

items.name: Unknown
items.summary: Unknown R15 Humanoid body part.

BorderMode.summary: Used by GuiObject.BorderMode to determine where borders are placed.

items.name: Outline
items.summary: As GuiObject.BorderSizePixel increases, the border grows outward.

items.name: Middle
items.summary: As GuiObject.BorderSizePixel increases, the border grows evenly inward and outward.

items.name: Inset
items.summary: As GuiObject.BorderSizePixel increases, the border grows evenly inward only.

BorderStrokePosition.summary: Used by UIStroke.BorderStrokePosition to determine the stroke's position on its parent's border.

items.name: Outer
items.summary: The stroke renders on the outer border of the parent UI element.

items.name: Center
items.summary: The stroke renders on the center border of the parent UI element.

items.name: Inner
items.summary: The stroke renders on the inner border of the parent UI element.

items.name: Other
items.summary: Pausing for a reason not covered by other values, for example if the user hit "Pause" button.

items.name: Error
items.summary: Pausing on error hit in the code.

items.name: SpecialBreakpoint
items.summary: Pausing on an internal breakpoint set by debugger command: e.g.

items.name: UserBreakpoint
items.summary: Pausing on a user breakpoint.

BreakpointRemoveReason.summary: Reason that a breakpoint was removed.

items.name: Requested
items.summary: Breakpoint removal was requested by user or a command.

items.name: ScriptChanged
items.summary: Script that contained the breakpoint has changed.

items.name: ScriptRemoved
items.summary: Script that contained the breakpoint was removed.

BulkMoveMode.summary: Determines the set of property changed events that fire when parts are moved by WorldRoot:BulkMoveTo().

items.name: FireAllEvents
items.summary: Every property changed event fires for each moved part, including BasePart.CFrame, BasePart.Position, BasePart.Orientation, and BasePart.Rotation.

items.name: FireCFrameChanged
items.summary: Only the BasePart.CFrame property changed event fires for each moved part; BasePart.Position, BasePart.Orientation, and BasePart.Rotation changed events are suppressed.

BundleType.summary: The type of a bundle of assets.

items.name: BodyParts
items.summary: A bundle of body parts and accessories.

items.name: Animations
items.summary: A bundle of just animations.

items.name: Shoes
items.summary: A bundle of left shoe and right shoe.

items.name: DynamicHead
items.summary: A bundle consisting of dynamicHead and moodAnimation assets, optionally with eyebrowAccessory and eyelashAccessory.

items.name: DynamicHeadAvatar
items.summary: A bundle containing full body parts and a dynamic head with facial animation support.

Button.summary: One of the buttons used by Controller.

items.name: Dismount
items.summary: Represents the dismount action that can be bound on a Controller to detect when a player triggers the dismount input.

items.name: Jump
items.summary: Represents the jump action that can be bound on a Controller to detect when a player triggers the jump input.

ButtonStyle.summary: Used by GuiButton.Style to set a special hardcoded appearance.

items.name: Custom
items.summary: The button will respect the GuiObject.BorderColor3 and GuiObject.BackgroundColor3 properties.

items.name: RobloxButtonDefault
items.summary: A black background with a red border, and rounded corners.

items.name: RobloxButton
items.summary: A black background with a grey border, and rounded corners.

items.name: RobloxRoundButton
items.summary: A grey background with rounded corners, and a slight drop shadow.

items.name: RobloxRoundDefaultButton
items.summary: A blue background with rounded corners, and a slight drop shadow.

items.name: RobloxRoundDropdownButton
items.summary: A white background with a thin grey border, rounded corners, and a slight drop shadow.

CageType.summary: Specifies which cage surface — inner or outer — to read or write on a BaseWrap object.

items.name: Inner
items.summary: Selects the inner cage mesh, which defines the surface that conforms to the body or underlying layer beneath the accessory.

items.name: Outer
items.summary: Selects the outer cage mesh, which defines the surface that the next clothing layer above this accessory conforms to.

CameraMode.summary: Used to set Player.CameraMode to determine when first person and third person cameras should be used.

items.name: Classic
items.summary: Third person camera which can be zoomed into first person.

items.name: LockFirstPerson
items.summary: Exclusively first person camera.

CameraNavigationModel.summary: Determines the camera navigation paradigm used in the Roblox Studio editor viewport.

items.name: Roblox
items.summary: Classic Roblox Studio camera navigation model with linear zoom and focus-locked orbiting; the default value.

items.name: IndustryCompatible
items.summary: Camera navigation model that follows industry-standard 3D application conventions, with non-linear zoom and simultaneous WASD-plus-orbit movement.

CameraPanMode.summary: The CameraPanMode Enum represents the available pan modes for Camera:SetCameraPanMode().

items.name: Classic
items.summary: Enables swipe and pan on mobile devices, and disables edge bump camera controls.

items.name: EdgeBump
items.summary: Disables swipe to pan on mobile devices, and enables edge bump camera controls.

CameraSpeedAdjustBinding.summary: Controls which input gesture adjusts the Studio camera's fly speed while navigating.

items.name: None
items.summary: No input gesture is bound to camera speed adjustment; the scroll wheel always zooms.

items.name: RmbScroll
items.summary: Scrolling while holding the right mouse button adjusts the camera fly speed instead of zooming.

items.name: AltScroll
items.summary: Scrolling while holding Alt adjusts the camera fly speed instead of zooming.

CameraType.summary: Describes the camera behavior mode if using the default PlayerScripts.

items.name: Fixed
items.summary: Camera is stationary.

items.name: Attach
items.summary: Camera moves with the subject at a fixed offset and will rotate as the subject rotates.

items.name: Watch
items.summary: Camera is stationary but will rotate to keep the subject in the center of the screen.

items.name: Track
items.summary: Camera moves with the subject but does not rotate automatically.

items.name: Follow
items.summary: Camera moves with the subject and rotates to keep the subject in the center.

items.name: Custom
items.summary: Default mode used by Roblox core scripts.

items.name: Scriptable
items.summary: No default behavior.

items.name: Orbital
items.summary: The camera has a fixed Y position, but can be rotated around the player.

CaptureGalleryPermission.summary: Specifies the scope of permissions an experience requests for accessing the device's capture gallery.

items.name: ReadAndUpload
items.summary: Requests permission to read captures from and upload captures to the device's gallery.

CaptureType.summary: Indicates whether a capture is a screenshot or a video recording.

items.name: Screenshot
items.summary: The capture is a screenshot image.

items.name: Video
items.summary: The capture is a video recording.

CatalogCategoryFilter.summary: Filters Avatar Shop catalog search results by a predefined category such as Featured, Premium, or Recommended.

items.name: None
items.summary: No category filter is applied; returns items from all categories.

items.name: Featured
items.summary: Returns only items editorially featured in the Avatar Shop catalog.

items.name: Collectibles
items.summary: Deprecated.

items.name: CommunityCreations
items.summary: Returns only items created by community developers.

items.name: Premium
items.summary: Returns only items available to Roblox Premium subscribers.

items.name: Recommended
items.summary: Returns only items recommended by the catalog for the current user.

CatalogSortAggregation.summary: Specifies the time window over which catalog items are aggregated when sorting CatalogSearchParams results.

items.name: Past12Hours
items.summary: Aggregates catalog data from the past 12 hours when sorting search results.

items.name: PastDay
items.summary: Aggregates catalog data from the past day when sorting search results.

items.name: Past3Days
items.summary: Aggregates catalog data from the past 3 days when sorting search results.

items.name: PastWeek
items.summary: Aggregates catalog data from the past week when sorting search results.

items.name: PastMonth
items.summary: Aggregates catalog data from the past month when sorting search results.

items.name: AllTime
items.summary: Aggregates catalog data across all time when sorting search results.

CatalogSortType.summary: Specifies the sort order for catalog search results returned by AvatarEditorService:SearchCatalogAsync().

items.name: Relevance
items.summary: Sorts catalog results by relevance to the search keyword or other query parameters.

items.name: PriceHighToLow
items.summary: Sorts catalog results from the highest price to the lowest price.

items.name: PriceLowToHigh
items.summary: Sorts catalog results from the lowest price to the highest price.

items.name: MostFavorited
items.summary: Sorts catalog results by the number of times items have been favorited, with most-favorited items listed first.

items.name: RecentlyCreated
items.summary: Sorts catalog results by creation date, with the most recently created items listed first.

items.name: Bestselling
items.summary: Sorts catalog results by total sales, with best-selling items listed first.

CellBlock.summary: Deprecated enum specifying the geometric block shape of a legacy voxel terrain cell, used with the removed Terrain:SetCell() method.

items.name: Solid
items.summary: A legacy voxel cell that is completely filled, occupying the full cell volume.

items.name: VerticalWedge
items.summary: A legacy voxel cell shaped as a vertical wedge, occupying half of a full cell's volume.

items.name: CornerWedge
items.summary: A legacy voxel cell shaped as a corner wedge, occupying approximately one-third of a full cell's volume.

items.name: InverseCornerWedge
items.summary: A legacy voxel cell shaped as an inverse corner wedge, occupying approximately two-thirds of a full cell's volume.

items.name: HorizontalWedge
items.summary: A legacy voxel cell shaped as a horizontal wedge, occupying half of a full cell's volume.

CellMaterial.summary: Material values for individual cells in the deprecated legacy voxel-based Terrain engine.

items.name: Empty
items.summary: Represents an air (unfilled) cell in the legacy voxel terrain; converted to air in the modern terrain system.

items.name: Grass
items.summary: A green grassy cell material in the legacy voxel terrain, converted to Material.Grass in the modern terrain system.

items.name: Sand
items.summary: A sandy cell material in the legacy voxel terrain, converted to Material.Sand in the modern terrain system.

items.name: Brick
items.summary: A red brick cell material in the legacy voxel terrain, converted to Material.Brick in the modern terrain system.

items.name: Granite
items.summary: A speckled stone cell material in the legacy voxel terrain, converted to Material.Slate in the modern terrain system.

items.name: Asphalt
items.summary: A dark paved road cell material in the legacy voxel terrain, converted to Material.Asphalt in the modern terrain system.

items.name: Iron
items.summary: A dark metallic cell material in the legacy voxel terrain, converted to Material.Concrete in the modern terrain system.

items.name: Aluminum
items.summary: A metallic silver cell material in the legacy voxel terrain, converted to Material.Concrete in the modern terrain system.

items.name: Gold
items.summary: A golden metallic cell material in the legacy voxel terrain, converted to Material.Concrete in the modern terrain system.

items.name: WoodPlank
items.summary: A flat wooden plank cell material in the legacy voxel terrain, converted to Material.WoodPlanks in the modern terrain system.

items.name: WoodLog
items.summary: A round wooden log cell material in the legacy voxel terrain, converted to Material.WoodPlanks in the modern terrain system.

items.name: Gravel
items.summary: A loose-stone cell material in the legacy voxel terrain, converted to Material.Asphalt in the modern terrain system.

items.name: CinderBlock
items.summary: A rough masonry cell material in the legacy voxel terrain, converted to Material.Concrete in the modern terrain system.

items.name: MossyStone
items.summary: A weathered stone cell material in the legacy voxel terrain, converted to Material.Pavement in the modern terrain system.

items.name: Cement
items.summary: A gray cement cell material in the legacy voxel terrain, converted to Material.Concrete in the modern terrain system.

items.name: RedPlastic
items.summary: A red-tinted cell material in the legacy voxel terrain, converted to Material.Sandstone in the modern terrain system.

items.name: BluePlastic
items.summary: A blue-tinted cell material in the legacy voxel terrain, converted to Material.Ice in the modern terrain system.

items.name: Water
items.summary: A water-filled cell in the legacy voxel terrain, converted to Material.Water in the modern terrain system.

CellOrientation.summary: Specifies the corner orientation of a legacy terrain cell, used with the deprecated Terrain:SetCell() method.

items.name: NegZ
items.summary: Upper-left corner orientation when the cell is viewed from directly above.

items.name: X
items.summary: Upper-right corner orientation when the cell is viewed from directly above.

items.name: Z
items.summary: Lower-right corner orientation when the cell is viewed from directly above.

items.name: NegX
items.summary: Lower-left corner orientation when the cell is viewed from directly above.

CharacterControlMode.summary: Specifies which character controller implementation an experience uses.

items.name: Default
items.summary: Uses Roblox's default character controller selection.

items.name: Legacy
items.summary: Uses the legacy character controller.

items.name: NoCharacterController
items.summary: Does not load a character controller.

items.name: LuaCharacterController
items.summary: Uses the Luau character controller.

ChatCallbackType.summary: Identifies a hook point in the legacy Luau chat pipeline for use with Chat:RegisterChatCallback() and Chat:InvokeChatCallback().

items.name: OnCreatingChatWindow
items.summary: Client-only callback invoked before the chat window is constructed, allowing custom settings to be supplied.

items.name: OnClientSendingMessage
items.summary: Client-only callback reserved for when the client sends a message; not currently invoked.

items.name: OnClientFormattingMessage
items.summary: Client-only callback invoked before a message is displayed, allowing its display data to be modified.

items.name: OnServerReceivingMessage
items.summary: Server-only callback invoked when the server receives a message from a speaker, allowing the message to be modified or suppressed.

items.name: Blue
items.summary: The blue chat color; the default value passed to Chat:Chat() and `ChatLocal()`.

items.name: Green
items.summary: The green chat color, passed as the `color` argument to Chat:Chat() or `ChatLocal()`.

items.name: Red
items.summary: The red chat color, passed as the `color` argument to Chat:Chat() or `ChatLocal()`.

items.name: White
items.summary: The white chat color, passed as the `color` argument to Chat:Chat() or `ChatLocal()`.

ChatMode.summary: Describes the methods of communication available to a player.

items.name: Menu
items.summary: The player is restricted to chatting via a menu of chat messages.

items.name: TextAndMenu
items.summary: A player can chat via custom text messages and a menu of chat messages.

ChatPrivacyMode.summary: Describes which other users a player is permitted to exchange in-game chat messages with.

items.name: AllUsers
items.summary: A player can chat with all users in a game.

items.name: NoOne
items.summary: A player cannot chat with any other users in a game.

items.name: Friends
items.summary: A player can only chat with users in a game that are on their friends list.

ChatRestrictionStatus.summary: Describes the chat restriction status that a third-party platform reports for a user.

items.name: Unknown
items.summary: The platform's chat restriction status for the user has not yet been determined; this is the default value for all ChatRestrictionStatus properties.

items.name: NotRestricted
items.summary: The third-party platform has confirmed the user has no chat restrictions in effect.

items.name: Restricted
items.summary: The third-party platform has reported the user is restricted from chat, typically due to parental controls or platform communication settings.

ChatStyle.summary: The ChatStyle Enum is used to set the style of Chat used in a game via the Players:SetChatStyle() method.

items.name: Classic
items.summary: Displays chats in the chat user interface at the top-left corner of the screen.

items.name: Bubble
items.summary: Displays chats in a bubble above the sender's head.

items.name: ClassicAndBubble
items.summary: Has the effects of Classic and Bubble combined.

ChatVersion.summary: Determines whether TextChatService should be fully enabled or to allow the legacy system.

items.name: LegacyChatService
items.summary: Enables the legacy chat system.

items.name: TextChatService
items.summary: Enables TextChatService chat and prevents legacy chat system behavior.

ClientAnimatorThrottlingMode.summary: An Enum describing various animation throttling modes on clients.

items.name: Default
items.summary: The default animation throttling mode defined by Roblox.

items.name: Disabled
items.summary: Disables animation throttling.

items.name: Enabled
items.summary: Enables animation throttling.

CloseReason.summary: Specifies the reason for the experience server shutdown.

items.name: Unknown
items.summary: The server shut down for an unknown reason.

items.name: RobloxMaintenance
items.summary: The server shut down for maintenance.

items.name: DeveloperShutdown
items.summary: The experience developer has shut down the server, or functions bound by DataModel:BindToClose() have been called inside Studio.

items.name: DeveloperUpdate
items.summary: The experience developer has migrated the server to a new place version.

items.name: ServerEmpty
items.summary: The last player has left and the experience is empty.

items.name: OutOfMemory
items.summary: The experience has hit the memory limit for the game server.

items.name: Moderation
items.summary: The server was shut down because the experience or place was taken down for moderation.

CollaboratorStatus.summary: Describes the current editing activity of a collaborator in a Team Create session.

items.name: None
items.summary: The collaborator has no active editing context; this is the default status.

items.name: Editing3D
items.summary: The collaborator is actively working in the 3D viewport.

items.name: Scripting
items.summary: The collaborator is editing a script that is replicated to the server.

items.name: PrivateScripting
items.summary: The collaborator is editing a script that is not replicated to the server (a local or module script not visible server-side).

CollisionFidelity.summary: Determines behavior of the collision hitbox for MeshPart and PartOperation instances.

items.name: Default
items.summary: Collision model uses a voxel-based convex-hull decomposition that is relatively fast but may not be highly accurate, especially for holes, doorways, and cavities in general.

items.name: Hull
items.summary: Collision model uses the convex hull of the visual mesh.

items.name: Box
items.summary: Collision model uses a bounding box that encompasses the visual mesh.

items.name: PreciseConvexDecomposition
items.summary: Collison model uses a convex-hull decomposition of the visual mesh which is computed by a variation of an algorithm called HACD.

items.name: Tunable
items.summary: Collision model that supports precision tuning of convex decomposition fidelity.

CommandPermission.summary: Specifies the minimum security permission level required to invoke a Studio command.

items.name: Plugin
items.summary: The command is accessible to scripts running at the standard Plugin security level.

items.name: LocalUser
items.summary: The command requires the LocalUser security level, granting access to IDE-only APIs.

CompletionAcceptanceBehavior.summary: Controls how the Script Editor inserts or replaces text when an autocomplete suggestion is accepted with Enter or Tab.

items.name: Insert
items.summary: Accepting a completion with either Enter or Tab inserts the suggestion without replacing existing text after the cursor.

items.name: Replace
items.summary: Accepting a completion with either Enter or Tab replaces existing text after the cursor with the full suggestion text.

items.name: ReplaceOnEnterInsertOnTab
items.summary: Pressing Enter replaces existing text after the cursor; pressing Tab inserts without replacing text after the cursor.

items.name: InsertOnEnterReplaceOnTab
items.summary: Pressing Enter inserts without replacing text after the cursor; pressing Tab replaces text after the cursor.

CompletionItemKind.summary: Indicates the category of a script editor autocomplete suggestion, controlling its icon and display in the completion list.

items.name: Text
items.summary: Indicates the completion item represents a plain text suggestion.

items.name: Method
items.summary: Indicates the completion item represents a method on a class or object.

items.name: Function
items.summary: Indicates the completion item represents a function.

items.name: Constructor
items.summary: Indicates the completion item represents a constructor.

items.name: Field
items.summary: Indicates the completion item represents a field within a record or struct.

items.name: Variable
items.summary: Indicates the completion item represents a variable binding.

items.name: Class
items.summary: Indicates the completion item represents a class or type definition.

items.name: Interface
items.summary: Indicates the completion item represents an interface type.

items.name: Module
items.summary: Indicates the completion item represents a module.

items.name: Property
items.summary: Indicates the completion item represents a property on a class or object.

items.name: Unit
items.summary: Indicates the completion item represents a unit of measurement or a module-level value.

items.name: Value
items.summary: Indicates the completion item represents a value expression.

items.name: Enum
items.summary: Indicates the completion item represents an enum type.

items.name: Keyword
items.summary: Indicates the completion item represents a language keyword.

items.name: Snippet
items.summary: Indicates the completion item represents an insertable code snippet with tab stops.

items.name: Color
items.summary: Indicates the completion item represents a color value.

items.name: File
items.summary: Indicates the completion item represents a file reference.

items.name: Reference
items.summary: Indicates the completion item represents a reference to another symbol.

items.name: Folder
items.summary: Indicates the completion item represents a folder or directory.

items.name: EnumMember
items.summary: Indicates the completion item represents an individual enum member value.

items.name: Constant
items.summary: Indicates the completion item represents a constant value.

items.name: Struct
items.summary: Indicates the completion item represents a struct or table type.

items.name: Event
items.summary: Indicates the completion item represents an event.

items.name: Operator
items.summary: Indicates the completion item represents an operator.

items.name: TypeParameter
items.summary: Indicates the completion item represents a generic type parameter.

CompletionItemTag.summary: Determines the tags for completion items in ScriptEditorService:RegisterAutocompleteCallback().

items.name: Deprecated
items.summary: Indicates that the completion is deprecated, applying a penalty towards its score and crossing it out in the completion list.

items.name: IncorrectIndexType
items.summary: Indicates that the completion is a member and being accessed with the wrong index type (e.g.

items.name: PluginPermissions
items.summary: Indicates that the completion requires Plugin security level to access, hiding it if the client lacks this level.

items.name: CommandLinePermissions
items.summary: Indicates that the completion requires Command line security level to access, hiding it if the client lacks this level.

items.name: RobloxPermissions
items.summary: Indicates that the completion requires core script security level to access, hiding it if the client lacks this level.

items.name: AddParens
items.summary: Instructs the editor to add parentheses before the cursor after inserting the given completion, if accepted.

items.name: PutCursorInParens
items.summary: Instructs the editor to add parentheses before the cursor and move the cursor into the parentheses after inserting the given completion, if accepted.

items.name: TypeCorrect
items.summary: Indicates that the completion is type correct in the current context, granting a bonus to its score.

items.name: ClientServerBoundaryViolation
items.summary: Indicates that the completion is being accessed from the wrong side of the client/server boundary (e.g.

items.name: Invalidated
items.summary: Indicates that the completion is stale because the cursor has moved outside the item's valid replacement range, hiding it from the completion list.

items.name: PutCursorBeforeEnd
items.summary: Instructs the editor to move the cursor to just before the nearest preceding `end` keyword after inserting the given completion, if accepted.

CompositeValueCurveType.summary: Describes the type of value animated by a CompositeValueCurve.

items.name: ColorRGB
items.summary: The CompositeValueCurve will animate children of type FloatCurve named `"R"`, `"G"`, and `"B"` to animate the corresponding components of the Color3 value returned by the method CompositeValueCurve:GetValueAtTime().

items.name: ColorHSV

items.name: NumberRange

items.name: Rect

items.name: UDim

items.name: UDim2
items.summary: The CompositeValueCurve will animate children of type FloatCurve named `"ScaleX"`, `"OffsetX"`, `"ScaleY"`, and `"OffsetY"` to animate the corresponding components of the UDim2 value returned by the method CompositeValueCurve:GetValueAtTime().

items.name: Vector2
items.summary: The CompositeValueCurve will animate children of type FloatCurve named `"X"` and `"Y"` to animate the corresponding components of the Vector2 value returned by the method CompositeValueCurve:GetValueAtTime().

items.name: Vector3
items.summary: The CompositeValueCurve will animate children of type FloatCurve named `"X"`, `"Y"`, and `"Z"` to animate the corresponding components of the Vector3 value returned by the method CompositeValueCurve:GetValueAtTime().

CompressionAlgorithm.summary: A compression algorithm to use in EncodingService methods.

ComputerCameraMovementMode.summary: The camera movement mode currently in-use by the client.

ComputerMovementMode.summary: The computer movement type in-use by the client.

items.summary: The movement mode has not been explicitly set and behaves identically to `KeyboardMouse`.

items.summary: The player moves their character using keyboard keys and steers the camera with the mouse.

items.name: ClickToMove

ConfigSnapshotErrorState.summary: Describes the error state of a ConfigSnapshot object.

ConnectionState.summary: Used to determine the connection state of the client to the game server.

items.summary: The client is disconnected.

ContentSourceType.summary: The source type of a Content value.

items.name: Object

items.name: Opaque

ContextActionPriority.summary: Describes the priority of a context action.

items.name: Low
items.summary: The lowest named priority level (value 1000); an action at this level is invoked after `High` and `Medium` actions bound to the same input.

items.name: Medium
items.summary: The default priority level (value 2000); used automatically by ContextActionService:BindAction() and falls between `High` and `Low` in processing order.

items.name: High
items.summary: The highest named priority level (value 3000); an action at this level is invoked before `Medium` and `Low` actions bound to the same input.

ContextActionResult.summary: Describes whether a contextual action should sink or pass input events.

items.name: Sink
items.summary: If `functionToBind` from ContextActionService:BindAction() returns ContextActionResult.Sink, the input event will stop at that function and no other bound actions under it will be processed.

items.name: Pass
items.summary: If `functionToBind` from ContextActionService:BindAction() returns ContextActionResult.Pass, the input event is considered to have not been handled by `functionToBind` and will continue being passed to actions bound to the same input type.

ControlMode.summary: The ControlMode Enum sets how the player is controlled.

CoreGuiType.summary: Represents all available CoreGui "types" such as the Backpack and text chat window.

items.name: AvatarSwitcher

items.name: ExperienceShop

CreateAssetResult.summary: Indicates the outcome of a call to AssetService:CreateAssetAsync() or AssetService:CreateAssetVersionAsync().

items.name: PermissionDenied

CreateContentResult.summary: Indicates the result of a AssetService:CreateDataModelContentAsync() call.

items.name: UploadFailed

items.summary: The storage budget limit for DataModel-scoped content was exceeded.

items.name: Unknown

CreateOutfitFailure.summary: Indicates why a AvatarEditorService:PromptCreateOutfit() call failed.

items.name: OutfitLimitReached

CreatorType.summary: Indicates whether the currently running place is owned by an individual user or a group.

items.summary: The place is owned by a group.

CreatorTypeFilter.summary: Specifies which creator type to include when filtering catalog search results in CatalogSearchParams.

items.name: Group

items.summary: Includes items from all creator types; no filtering by creator is applied.

CurrencyType.summary: The CurrencyType Enum is used with MarketplaceService to set the currency used.

items.name: Robux
items.summary: Use Robux.

items.summary: Camera tracks the player and automatically rotates if the player walks left or right.

DataStoreRequestType.summary: Indicates the type of data store request being made.

items.name: GetAsync
items.summary: Refers to GlobalDataStore:GetAsync() and the read of GlobalDataStore:UpdateAsync().

items.name: SetIncrementAsync
items.summary: Refers to DataStore:SetAsync(), DataStore:IncrementAsync(), DataStore:RemoveAsync(), and the write of DataStore:UpdateAsync() when it returns a non-`nil` value.

items.name: UpdateAsync
items.summary: Refers to GlobalDataStore:UpdateAsync().

items.name: GetSortedAsync
items.summary: Refers to OrderedDataStore:GetSortedAsync().

items.name: SetIncrementSortedAsync
items.summary: Refers to OrderedDataStore:SetAsync() OrderedDataStore:IncrementAsync(), OrderedDataStore:RemoveAsync(), and the write of OrderedDataStore:UpdateAsync() while using an OrderedDataStore.

items.name: OnUpdate
items.summary: Refers to GlobalDataStore:OnUpdate().

items.name: ListAsync
items.summary: Refers to DataStore:ListKeysAsync() and DataStore:ListVersionsAsync().

items.name: GetVersionAsync
items.summary: Refers to DataStore:GetVersionAsync().

items.name: RemoveVersionAsync
items.summary: Refers to DataStore:RemoveVersionAsync().

items.name: StandardRead
items.summary: Refers to DataStore:GetAsync(), DataStore:GetVersionAsync(), DataStore:GetVersionAtTimeAsync(), and the read of DataStore:UpdateAsync() for DataStore.

items.name: StandardWrite
items.summary: Refers to DataStore:SetAsync(), DataStore:IncrementAsync(), and the write of DataStore:UpdateAsync() for DataStore.

items.name: StandardList
items.summary: Refers to DataStoreService:ListDataStoresAsync(), and DataStore:ListKeysAsync() and DataStore:ListVersionsAsync() for DataStore.

items.name: StandardRemove
items.summary: Refers to DataStore:RemoveAsync() for DataStore.

items.name: OrderedRead
items.summary: Refers to OrderedDataStore:GetAsync() and the read of OrderedDataStore:UpdateAsync() for OrderedDataStore.

items.name: OrderedWrite
items.summary: Refers to OrderedDataStore:SetAsync(), OrderedDataStore:IncrementAsync(), and the write of OrderedDataStore:UpdateAsync() for OrderedDataStore.

items.name: OrderedList
items.summary: Refers to OrderedDataStore:GetSortedAsync() for OrderedDataStore.

items.name: OrderedRemove
items.summary: Refers to OrderedDataStore:RemoveAsync() for OrderedDataStore.

DebugBreakModeType.summary: Controls when the debugger pauses on exceptions.

items.name: Never
items.summary: Never break on exceptions.

items.name: Always
items.summary: Break on all exceptions.

items.name: Unhandled
items.summary: Break only on unhandled exceptions.

DebuggerEndReason.summary: Reason for the end of the debugger session.

items.name: ClientRequest
items.summary: Client requested connection termination.

items.name: Timeout
items.summary: Connection timed out.

items.name: InvalidHost
items.summary: Invalid host:port combination.

items.name: Disconnected
items.summary: Connection was lost.

items.name: ServerShutdown
items.summary: Server terminated the connection because it shut down.

items.name: ServerProtocolMismatch
items.summary: Server has wrong version of protocol.

items.name: ConfigurationFailed
items.summary: Got a failure response when trying to configure the server.

items.name: RpcError
items.summary: An error occurred in the RPC layer.

DebuggerExceptionBreakMode.summary: Controls when the Luau debugger pauses script execution in response to a runtime exception.

items.name: Never
items.summary: The debugger never pauses due to a runtime exception; execution continues normally regardless of whether the exception is caught or uncaught.

items.name: Always
items.summary: The debugger pauses on every runtime exception, including those caught by `pcall` or `xpcall`.

items.name: Unhandled
items.summary: The debugger pauses only on runtime exceptions that propagate without being caught by `pcall` or `xpcall`.

items.name: C
items.summary: Call stack frame belongs to a C (native) function.

items.name: Lua
items.summary: Call stack frame belongs to a Luau function.

DebuggerPauseReason.summary: Reason that the DataModel was paused.

items.name: Unknown
items.summary: Pausing for a reason not covered by other values.

items.name: Requested
items.summary: Pause was requested by user.

items.name: Breakpoint
items.summary: Pausing on a user breakpoint.

items.name: Exception
items.summary: Pausing on error hit in the code.

items.name: SingleStep
items.summary: Pausing on an internal breakpoint set by debugger command: e.g.

items.name: Entrypoint
items.summary: Pausing at the entry on the script.

DebuggerResumeType.summary: Specifies how the debugger should resume execution after a pause.

items.name: StepInto
items.summary: Step into the next function call on the specified thread.

items.name: StepOut
items.summary: Step out of the current function on the specified thread.

items.name: StepOver
items.summary: Step over the current line on the specified thread.

items.name: Resume
items.summary: Resume execution normally without stepping.

items.name: Success
items.summary: Request has completed successfully.

items.name: Timeout
items.summary: Timed out while waiting for response.

items.name: ConnectionLost
items.summary: Connection to the debugger was lost.

items.name: InvalidResponse
items.summary: Failed to parse response.

items.name: InternalError
items.summary: Exception encountered while processing response.

items.name: InvalidState
items.summary: The request was not appropriate for the current debugger state.

items.name: RpcError
items.summary: Response was an error.

items.name: InvalidArgument
items.summary: One of the request arguments was invalid.

items.name: ConnectionClosed
items.summary: Connection closed while waiting for response.

DefaultScriptSyncFileType.summary: Controls the file extension used when Studio's script sync feature saves script instances to the filesystem.

items.name: Lua
items.summary: Script files are synced to the filesystem with a `.lua` extension.

items.name: Luau
items.summary: Script files are synced to the filesystem with a `.luau` extension.

DevCameraOcclusionMode.summary: Determines how the default camera handles objects that are in-between the camera and the camera subject.

items.name: Invisicam
items.summary: Any objects between the camera and its subject become translucent locally.

DevComputerCameraMovementMode.summary: Overwrites the player's camera movement mode setting on a computer.

items.name: Orbital

DevComputerMovementMode.summary: Sets the movement mode of players who are playing on computers.

items.name: UserChoice
items.summary: Allows players to choose their desired control scheme from the in-experience menu.

items.summary: The player's character will be controlled using the keyboard and mouse.

items.name: ClickToMove

DevTouchCameraMovementMode.summary: Overwrites the camera mode if the player is on a touch device.

items.name: UserChoice
items.summary: The camera will move based on the player's settings.

items.name: Classic
items.summary: Camera tracks the player but will not automatically rotate if the player walks left or right.

items.name: Follow
items.summary: Camera tracks the player and automatically rotates if the player walks left or right.

items.name: Orbital
items.summary: The camera has a fixed Y position, but can be rotated around the player.

DevTouchMovementMode.summary: Overrides the movement mode of players who are playing on touch-enabled devices.

items.name: UserChoice
items.summary: Allows players to choose their desired control scheme from the in-experience menu.

items.name: ClickToMove

items.name: Scriptable

items.name: DynamicThumbstick

items.name: Instances

items.name: Signals

items.name: LuaHeap
items.summary: All of the data in Luau, including everything happening in core scripts, built-in data types, etc.

items.name: Script

items.name: PhysicsCollision
items.summary: Collision detection in the Workspace.

items.name: GraphicsSlimModels

DeviceForm.summary: Describes the physical form factor of a device used during Studio device emulation.

items.name: Console
items.summary: Represents a gaming console device, such as an Xbox or PlayStation.

items.name: Phone
items.summary: Represents a mobile phone with a touchscreen.

items.name: Tablet
items.summary: Represents a tablet with a touchscreen.

items.name: Desktop
items.summary: Represents a desktop or laptop computer.

items.name: VR
items.summary: Represents a virtual reality headset.

DeviceLevel.summary: Classifies a device's hardware capability tier.

items.name: Low
items.summary: Indicates a low-end device that benefits from reduced graphics or simulation quality.

items.name: Medium
items.summary: Indicates a mid-range device that may benefit from moderate reductions in resource-intensive features.

items.name: High
items.summary: Indicates a high-end device capable of running resource-intensive features at full fidelity.

DeviceSimulatorScalingMode.summary: Controls how the Device Simulator viewport scales the simulated device resolution within the Studio window.

items.name: ScaleToPhysicalSize
items.summary: Scales the simulated viewport so that its pixels correspond to their physical size on the developer's monitor, computed from the screen DPI and an optional target DPI override.

items.name: ActualResolution
items.summary: Renders the simulated viewport at a 1:1 pixel mapping with no scaling applied.

items.name: FitToWindow
items.summary: Scales the simulated viewport uniformly to fill as much of the available Studio window as possible while preserving the device's aspect ratio.

items.name: Unknown
items.summary: The client is an unknown device.

items.name: Desktop
items.summary: The client is a desktop device.

items.name: Tablet
items.summary: The client is a tablet device.

items.name: Phone
items.summary: The client is a phone device.

items.name: TV
items.summary: The client is a TV device.

DialogBehaviorType.summary: Controls whether multiple people can use this dialog, or only one person at a time can use it.

items.name: SinglePlayer
items.summary: Only one player can interact with this dialog at a time.

items.name: MultiplePlayers
items.summary: Multiple players can simultaneously interact with this dialog.

DialogPurpose.summary: The DialogPurpose enum is used to set the icon of a Dialog.

items.name: Quest
items.summary: Shows an exclamation point ('''!''').

items.name: Help
items.summary: Shows a question mark ('''?''').

items.name: Shop
items.summary: Shows a dollar sign ('''$''').

DialogTone.summary: Sets the Dialog.Tone of a Dialog object, which influences how the dialog appears.

items.name: Neutral
items.summary: Causes the dialog to have a blue bar on its left-hand side.

items.name: Friendly
items.summary: Causes the dialog to have a green bar on its left-hand side.

items.name: Enemy
items.summary: Causes the dialog to have a red bar on its left-hand side.

DigitsRigDescriptionSide.summary: Specifies which hand side a DigitsRigDescription instance is assigned to.

items.name: None
items.summary: The DigitsRigDescription has not been assigned to a hand side and is skipped by the animation system.

items.name: Left
items.summary: The DigitsRigDescription is assigned to the left hand.

items.name: Right
items.summary: The DigitsRigDescription is assigned to the right hand.

DisplaySize.summary: This enum is used with GuiService.ViewportDisplaySize to indicate the internally-categorized rendering size of the viewport.

items.name: Small
items.summary: Viewport is categorized as small.

items.name: Medium
items.summary: Viewport is categorized as medium.

items.name: Large
items.summary: Viewport is categorized as large.

DistanceAttenuationMode.summary: Determines how an AudioEmitter attenuates (fades out) as the distance between the AudioEmitter and an interacting AudioListener increases.

items.name: Custom
items.summary: Uses the developer-supplied AudioEmitter.DistanceAttenuation curve for gain rolloff.

items.name: InverseTapered
items.summary: Volume attenuates according to a hybrid model which follows the DistanceAttenuationMode.Inverse model when close to the lower bound of AudioEmitter.DistanceAttenuationBounds and the DistanceAttenuationMode.LinearSquared model when close to the upper bound of AudioEmitter.DistanceAttenuationBounds.

items.name: Linear
items.summary: Volume attenuates between the bounds of AudioEmitter.DistanceAttenuationBounds with a linear relationship.

items.name: LinearSquared
items.summary: Volume attenuates between the bounds of AudioEmitter.DistanceAttenuationBounds with a linear-squared relationship.

items.name: Inverse
items.summary: Volume attenuates from the lower bound of AudioEmitter.DistanceAttenuationBounds in an inverse manner, mirroring how sounds attenuate in the real world.

DomainType.summary: Specifies the type of domain that a User is scoped to.

items.name: OAUTH
items.summary: The user ID is scoped to a specific OAuth application.

items.name: Width
items.summary: The X axis.

items.name: Height
items.summary: The Y axis.

DraftStatusCode.summary: Describes the state of a script draft tracked by DraftsService.

items.name: OK
items.summary: The draft is in sync with the server's base version and has no blocking conflicts.

items.name: DraftOutdated
items.summary: The server version of the script has advanced beyond the base version used when the draft was created, so the draft must be updated before it can be committed.

items.name: ScriptRemoved
items.summary: The script referenced by the draft no longer exists in the data model.

items.name: DraftCommitted
items.summary: The draft was successfully committed to the server and removed from the local sandbox.

DragDetectorDragStyle.summary: Used with DragDetector as the paradigm to generate proposed motion, given a stream of cursor rays.

items.name: TranslateLine
items.summary: 1D motion along the detector's DragDetector.Axis, by default the world **Y** axis.

items.name: TranslatePlane
items.summary: 2D motion in the plane **perpendicular** to the detector's DragDetector.Axis, by default the world **XZ** plane.

items.name: TranslatePlaneOrLine
items.summary: 2D motion in the plane **perpendicular** to the detector's DragDetector.Axis and, when the modifier is active, 1D motion along the detector's DragDetector.Axis.

items.name: TranslateLineOrPlane
items.summary: 1D motion along the detector's DragDetector.Axis and, when the modifier is active, 2D motion in the plane **perpendicular** to the detector's DragDetector.Axis.

items.name: TranslateViewPlane
items.summary: 2D motion in the plane perpendicular to the camera's view.

items.name: RotateAxis
items.summary: Rotation about the detector's DragDetector.Axis, by default the world **Y** axis.

items.name: RotateTrackball
items.summary: Trackball rotation, further customized through the DragDetector.TrackballRadialPullFactor and DragDetector.TrackballRollFactor properties.

items.name: Scriptable
items.summary: Calculates desired motion via a custom function provided through DragDetector:SetDragStyleFunction().

items.name: BestForDevice
items.summary: **TranslatePlaneOrLine** for mouse and gamepad; **TranslatePlane** for touch; **6DOF** for VR.

DragDetectorPermissionPolicy.summary: Used to control the permission level for which players can interact with a DragDetector.

items.name: Nobody
items.summary: No players can interact with the DragDetector.

items.name: Everybody
items.summary: All players can interact with the DragDetector.

items.name: Scriptable
items.summary: Invokes the function registered via DragDetector:SetPermissionPolicyFunction(), enabling/disabling the detector based on whether the function returns `true` or `false`.

DragDetectorResponseStyle.summary: Describes how the clicked object will be treated once the desired motion has been calculated.

items.name: Geometric
items.summary: For an BasePart.Anchored object both inside the running experience and in Studio edit mode, the position/orientation of the object will be updated to exactly reflect the proposed motion.

items.name: Physical
items.summary: An BasePart.Anchored object will default to **Geometric** behavior as it is not affected by forces.

items.name: Custom
items.summary: The object will not move at all, but DragDetector.DragFrame will still be updated and you can respond to drag manipulation however you'd like.

DraggerCoordinateSpace.summary: Determines the coordinate space used when dragging objects in Studio.

items.name: Object
items.summary: Dragging is performed relative to the object's local coordinate space.

items.name: World
items.summary: Dragging is performed relative to the world coordinate space.

DraggerMovementMode.summary: Controls whether DraggerService moves parts geometrically or with physics simulation during Studio drag operations.

items.name: Geometric
items.summary: Parts are moved by directly updating their position and orientation, ignoring physics and constraints.

items.name: Physical
items.summary: Parts are moved by applying physics impulses, so constraints and collisions are respected during the drag.

EasingDirection.summary: Enum used with TweenInfo.new() to control the direction Tween play in.

items.name: In
items.summary: The easing style is applied in a forward direction.

items.name: Out
items.summary: The easing style is applied in a reverse direction.

items.name: InOut
items.summary: The easing style is applied forward for the first half and in reverse for the second half.

EasingStyle.summary: Enum used with TweenInfo to control the motion of a Tween.

items.name: Linear
items.summary: Moves at a constant speed.

items.name: Sine
items.summary: Speed is determined by a sine wave for a gentle easing motion.

FilterErrorType.summary: Identifies the category of a parse or validation error produced by the Studio Explorer filter expression engine.

items.name: BackslashNotEscapingAnything
items.summary: A backslash at the end of a quoted string has nothing after it to escape.

items.name: BadBespokeFilter
items.summary: A recognized bespoke filter keyword (such as `classname:`) is missing its required value, or a `query:` expression contains an invalid query string.

items.name: BadName
items.summary: An unexpected token was encountered where a name or identifier was expected.

items.name: IncompleteOr
items.summary: Reserved error code for an incomplete `or` expression; currently not emitted by the filter engine.

items.name: IncompleteParenthesis
items.summary: An opening parenthesis `(` in the filter expression has no matching closing parenthesis `)`.

items.name: InvalidDoubleStar
items.summary: A `**` wildcard token directly follows a `*` wildcard in a dotted name path (for example, `A.*.**.X`), which is not allowed.

items.name: InvalidTilde
items.summary: A lone `~` character was found that is not part of the `~=` not-equal operator.

items.name: PropertyBadOperator
items.summary: A comparison operator other than `=` or `~=` was used with a property type that only supports equality comparisons.

items.name: PropertyDoesNotExist
items.summary: The named property does not exist on any reflected class known to the filter engine.

items.name: PropertyInvalidField
items.summary: A sub-field index (such as `.W`) was used with a vector or color property that does not have a field by that name.

items.name: PropertyInvalidValue
items.summary: The value string provided for a property comparison cannot be parsed into the expected type for that property (for example, `Locked=notabool`).

items.name: PropertyUnsupportedFields
items.summary: A sub-field index was used with a property type that does not support field access (for example, `Locked.X=true`).

items.name: PropertyUnsupportedProperty
items.summary: The named property exists but its type is not supported by the filter engine (for example, complex datatypes such as `CFrame` or `TweenInfo`).

items.name: UnexpectedNameIndex
items.summary: A `.` in a dotted name path is not followed by a valid name, number, or wildcard token.

items.name: UnexpectedToken
items.summary: A token that cannot be a value (such as an operator) appears where a value is expected after a comparison operator.

items.name: UnfinishedBinaryOperator
items.summary: An `and` or `or` binary operator appears with no right-hand operand.

items.name: UnfinishedQuote
items.summary: A quoted string was opened but not closed before the end of the filter input.

items.name: UnknownBespokeFilter
items.summary: A `name:value` token uses a keyword that is not a recognized bespoke filter type (for example, `foo:Bar`).

items.name: WildcardInProperty
items.summary: A wildcard (`*` or `**`) appears in the property portion of a dotted expression where a concrete property name is required.

items.summary: Used to compute a 256-bit (32-byte) hash digest using the BLAKE2b algorithm.

items.name: Blake3
items.summary: Used to compute a 256-bit (32-byte) hash digest using the BLAKE3 algorithm.

items.name: Md5
items.summary: Used to compute a 128-bit (16-byte) hash digest using the MD5 algorithm.

items.name: Sha1
items.summary: Used to compute a 160-bit (20-byte) hash digest using the SHA-1 algorithm.

items.name: Sha256
items.summary: Used to compute a 256-bit (32-byte) hash digest using the SHA256 algorithm.

HighlightDepthMode.summary: Controls how the Highlight effect displays with respect to other objects in the world.

items.name: AlwaysOnTop
items.summary: Allows the Highlight to display regardless if there are objects between the camera and the highlighted object.

items.name: Occluded
items.summary: Hides the Highlight if there are objects between the camera and the highlighted object.

HorizontalAlignment.summary: Used by UIGridStyleLayout.HorizontalAlignment to align the layout horizontally within its parent.

items.name: Center
items.summary: Grid is aligned to the center of its parent along the **X** axis.

items.name: Left
items.summary: Grid is aligned to the left edge of its parent.

items.name: Right
items.summary: Grid is aligned to the right edge of its parent.

HoverAnimateSpeed.summary: Specifies the animation speed of the hover highlight in Roblox Studio.

items.name: VerySlow
items.summary: 2 seconds per cycle.

items.name: Slow
items.summary: 1 second per cycle.

items.name: Medium
items.summary: 0.5 seconds per cycle.

items.name: Fast
items.summary: 0.25 seconds per cycle.

items.name: VeryFast
items.summary: 0.1 seconds per cycle.

HttpCompression.summary: Specifies the compression algorithm applied to HTTP request body sent via HttpService.

items.name: None
items.summary: No compression is applied to the request body.

items.name: Gzip
items.summary: The request body is compressed using the Gzip algorithm before being sent.

HttpContentType.summary: Specifies the value of the HTTP Content-Type header which describes the HTTP request data type.

items.name: ApplicationJson
items.summary: Represents the "application/json" Content-Type.

items.name: ApplicationXml
items.summary: Represents the "application/xml" Content-Type.

items.name: ApplicationUrlEncoded
items.summary: Represents the "application/x-www-form-urlencoded" Content-Type.

items.name: TextPlain
items.summary: Represents the "text/plain" Content-Type.

items.name: TextXml
items.summary: Represents the "text/xml" Content-Type.

HttpError.summary: Enum representing errors that can occur when making HTTP requests, unrelated to HTTP status codes returned by the server.

items.name: OK
items.summary: No error occurred; the request completed successfully.

items.name: InvalidUrl
items.summary: The request URL is malformed or otherwise invalid; depending on the platform, a bad URL might instead surface as HttpError.DnsResolve or HttpError.ConnectFail.

items.name: DnsResolve
items.summary: The hostname in the request URL could not be resolved via DNS.

items.name: ConnectFail
items.summary: The client failed to establish a TCP connection to the remote host.

items.name: OutOfMemory
items.summary: The client ran out of memory while processing the HTTP request or response.

items.name: TimedOut
items.summary: The request did not receive a response within the allowed time limit.

items.name: TooManyRedirects
items.summary: The server returned more redirects than the client is configured to follow.

items.name: InvalidRedirect
items.summary: The server returned a redirect response with an invalid or malformed Location header.

items.name: NetFail
items.summary: A general network-level failure occurred that does not fall into a more specific error category.

items.name: Aborted
items.summary: The HTTP request was aborted before it could complete.

items.name: SslConnectFail
items.summary: The TLS/SSL handshake with the remote server failed during connection establishment.

items.name: SslVerificationFail
items.summary: The server's TLS certificate could not be verified.

items.name: Unknown
items.summary: An error occurred that does not map to any other HttpError value.

items.name: ConnectionClosed
items.summary: The connection was closed by the remote end before the full response was received, typically indicating a server or network problem.

items.name: ServerProtocolError
items.summary: An HTTP/2 protocol-level error was returned by the server.

items.name: CreatorEnvironmentsNotSupportedByService
items.summary: The request was sent from a non-live environment (such as Studio) and the target service does not support creator environments.

items.name: InactivityTimeout
items.summary: A streaming request timed out because no data was transferred during the inactivity window.

items.name: TooManyOutstandingRequests
items.summary: The request was rejected because the client has exceeded its limit for concurrent or pending requests.

items.name: InvalidRangeResponse
items.summary: The server returned an invalid response to a ranged HTTP request, such as responding with a full 200 status instead of the expected 206 Partial Content.

items.name: OuterBox
items.summary: Dynamically sized collision boxes based on mesh sizes.

items.name: InnerBox
items.summary: Fixed size collision boxes, similar to the classic avatar collision.

HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.summary: HumanoidDisplayDistanceType determines how Humanoid.HealthDisplayDistance, and Humanoid.NameDisplayDistance are used in determining whether a players's name and health are visible to other players.

items.name: Viewer
items.summary: A player selecting `Viewer` on their Humanoid will see the Name and healthbar of other players if those other players are within the distance settings set in the Humanoid selecting `Viewer` (this can be thought of as the lowest priority, and will not be taken into account if other players are selecting 'Subject' or 'None').

items.name: Subject
items.summary: A player selecting `Subject` on their Humanoid will allow other players to see their Name and healthbar if those other players are within the distance settings set in the Humanoid selecting `Subject` (this can be thought of as the second highest priority).

items.name: None
items.summary: A player selecting `None` on their Humanoid will not have their Name and healthbar displayed to other players under any circumstance (this can be thought of as the highest priority).

HumanoidHealthDisplayType.summary: Controls under what circumstances the Humanoid health bar is displayed.

items.name: DisplayWhenDamaged
items.summary: The humanoid's health bar is only visible when the humanoid is not at full health (assuming `MaxHealth` is greater than zero).

items.name: AlwaysOn
items.summary: The humanoid's health bar is always visible (assuming `MaxHealth` is greater than zero).

items.name: AlwaysOff
items.summary: The humanoid's health bar is never visible.

HumanoidRigType.summary: Describes whether or not a character is using an R15 rig or the legacy R6 rig.

items.name: R6
items.summary: Indicates that a character is using the legacy R6 rig.

items.name: R15
items.summary: Indicates that a character is using an R15 rig.

HumanoidStateType.summary: Describes the physics control states within the Humanoid.

items.name: FallingDown
items.summary: The Humanoid has been tripped, and will attempt to get up in a few moments.

items.name: Ragdoll
items.summary: (Deprecated) The Humanoid has been hit by a fast moving object (uncontrolled falling).

items.name: GettingUp
items.summary: The Humanoid is getting back on their feet after FallingDown or Ragdoll.

items.name: Jumping
items.summary: The Humanoid just jumped.

items.name: Swimming
items.summary: The Humanoid is currently swimming in Terrain water.

items.name: Freefall
items.summary: The Humanoid is currently freefalling (jumped from a height or fell off a ledge).

items.name: Flying
items.summary: When set, the Humanoid won't be animated, as with the Humanoid.PlatformStand property.

items.name: Landed
items.summary: The Humanoid touched the ground after a Freefall.

items.name: Running
items.summary: Currently running while on the ground.

items.name: RunningNoPhysics
items.summary: (Deprecated) Currently running and not near other physical objects.

items.name: StrafingNoPhysics
items.summary: Not currently used with default Humanoid.

items.name: Climbing
items.summary: The Humanoid is climbing (e.g.

items.name: Seated
items.summary: The Humanoid is currently sitting in a Seat or VehicleSeat.

items.name: PlatformStanding
items.summary: The Humanoid is platformstanding.

items.name: Dead
items.summary: The Humanoid died.

items.name: Physics
items.summary: The Humanoid doesn't apply any force on its own and will not automatically transition to any other state.

items.name: None
items.summary: Unusable placeholder in case an unknown state gets triggered internally.

IKCollisionsMode.summary: Controls which parts in the workspace participate in collision resolution when WorldRoot:IKMoveTo() drives a part toward a target CFrame.

items.name: NoCollisions
items.summary: Only the part and any parts directly joined to it via joints/Constraint will be involved in the resolution; everything else in the workspace will be treated as though it doesn't exist.

items.name: OtherMechanismsAnchored
items.summary: Only the part and any parts directly joined to it via joints/Constraint will be moved during resolution, but they will collide with other objects in the workspace.

items.name: IncludeContactedMechanisms
items.summary: The part, any parts directly joined to it via joints/Constraint, and any parts which it comes into contact with during the solve will be moved during the resolution.

items.name: Default
items.summary: The default option for IKControl.

items.name: Disabled
items.summary: Disables support for constraints for IKControl.

items.name: Enabled
items.summary: Enables support for constraints for IKControl.

IKControlType.summary: Used on IKControl to specify their IKControl.Type, to change their behavior.

items.name: Transform
items.summary: It is a full 6-DoF constraint.

items.name: Position
items.summary: Aligns the IKControl.EndEffector position to that of the IKControl.Target .

items.name: Rotation
items.summary: Aligns the IKControl.EndEffector rotation to that of the IKControl.Target.

items.name: LookAt
items.summary: Moves and orients the whole chain to make the forward axis on the IKControl.EndEffector point at a position in the world specified by IKControl.Target.

IXPLoadingStatus.summary: Describes the loading state of an IXP (in-experience experiment) layer fetch operation.

items.name: None
items.summary: The default status when the IXP controller is first constructed or after layers have been cleared.

items.name: Pending
items.summary: An HTTP request to fetch layer assignments has been sent and a response is awaited.

items.name: Initialized
items.summary: The HTTP request completed successfully and layer variable values have been populated from the response.

items.name: ErrorInvalidUser
items.summary: The fetch failed because the requested subject (user) was invalid at the time of the request.

items.name: ErrorConnection
items.summary: The HTTP request to fetch layer assignments failed due to a connection error.

items.name: ErrorJsonParse
items.summary: The HTTP request succeeded but the response body could not be parsed as valid JSON.

items.name: ErrorTimedOut
items.summary: The HTTP request to fetch layer assignments timed out before a response was received.

ImageAlphaType.summary: Enum for determining if the alpha or color is locked while combining two images.

items.name: Default
items.summary: The default behavior in which neither color nor alpha values are locked.

items.name: LockCanvasAlpha
items.summary: The alpha values of the image will not be modified.

items.name: LockCanvasColor
items.summary: The color values of the image will not be modified.

ImageCombineType.summary: Enum for determining how two images are combined together.

items.name: BlendSourceOver
items.summary: Blends pixels from the source with pixels from the destination using source over alpha blending.

items.name: Overwrite
items.summary: Overwrites all pixels in the destination image with pixels from the source image.

items.name: Add
items.summary: Adds pixels from the source and pixels from the destination together.

items.name: Multiply
items.summary: Multiplies pixels from the source and pixels from the destination together.

items.name: AlphaBlend
items.summary: Blends pixels from the source with pixels from the destination based on the alpha of the source pixels.

items.name: NormalMapBlend
items.summary: Blends pixels from the source with the destination using alpha blending, then renormalizes the resulting RGB values as a tangent-space normal vector.

items.name: Subtract
items.summary: Subtracts pixels of the source from pixels of the destination.

InOut.summary: The InOut Enum is used to set where the object is on the side of its parent.

items.name: Edge
items.summary: The object is located along an edge of its parent.

items.name: Inset
items.summary: The object's located is inset from its parent's location.

items.name: Center
items.summary: The object's location is centered on it's parent.

InfoType.summary: Specifies the type of product information returned by MarketplaceService:GetProductInfoAsync().

items.name: Asset
items.summary: The product is an asset.

items.name: Product
items.summary: Product such as a Developer Product.

items.name: GamePass
items.summary: The product is a game pass.

items.name: Subscription
items.summary: The product is a subscription.

items.name: Bundle
items.summary: The product is a bundle.

InitialDockState.summary: Describes the initial docking state of a DockWidgetPluginGui.

items.name: Top
items.summary: The widget will appear docked above the game screen.

items.name: Bottom
items.summary: The widget will appear docked below the game screen.

items.name: Left
items.summary: The widget will appear docked to the left of the game screen.

items.name: Right
items.summary: The widget will appear docked to the right of the game screen.

items.name: Float
items.summary: The widget will not be docked to any side of the game screen, and instead can be freely dragged around.

InputActionType.summary: This enum is used by InputAction.Type to determine which input data type the InputAction will receive.

items.name: Bool
items.summary: The InputAction will receive boolean values from button inputs, for example `true`/`false` on press/release from inputs such as KeyCode.ButtonA or KeyCode.E.

items.name: Direction1D
items.summary: The InputAction will receive numerical values, generally from analog gamepad triggers such as KeyCode.ButtonL2 or KeyCode.ButtonR2.

items.name: Direction2D
items.summary: The InputAction will receive Vector2 values, generally from thumbstick inputs such as KeyCode.Thumbstick1 and KeyCode.Thumbstick2.

items.name: Direction3D
items.summary: The InputAction will receive Vector3 values from inputs assigned to the InputBinding.Up, InputBinding.Down, InputBinding.Left, InputBinding.Right, InputBinding.Forward, and/or InputBinding.Backward properties on child InputBinding, allowing for "3D" inputs as composite directions for the action.

items.name: ViewportPosition
items.summary: The InputAction will receive Vector2 values representing the absolute pixel (**X**, **Y**) coordinates of a pointer input in the viewport.

InputBindingType.summary: This enum is used by InputBinding.Type to determine whether the binding responds to hardware input or is driven programmatically.

items.name: Automatic
items.summary: The InputBinding responds to physical input devices (keyboard, mouse, gamepad, touch) based on its InputBinding.KeyCode or composite direction properties.

items.name: Scriptable
items.summary: The InputBinding ignores hardware input and instead receives state updates exclusively through the InputBinding:Fire() method.

InputSink.summary: Controls how a GuiObject or GuiButton absorbs pointer and activation input events relative to GUI elements beneath it.

items.name: None
items.summary: The element does not sink any input events; pointer and activation events pass through to elements beneath it.

items.name: Activate
items.summary: The element sinks activation input (button presses and taps) but allows hover, `MouseEnter`, and `MouseLeave` events to pass through to elements beneath it.

items.name: All
items.summary: The element sinks all input events, preventing them from reaching any GUI element beneath it.

InputType.summary: The InputType Enum controls the SurfaceInputs of Part.

items.name: NoInput
items.summary: Behaves like a weld and does nothing.

items.name: Constant
items.summary: Rotate at a constant velocity of BasePart `ParamB`.

items.name: Sin
items.summary: Rotate at a velocity of: `ParamA * math.sin(workspace.DistributedGameTime * ParamB)`, where BasePart `ParamA` determines the maximum speed at which the part spins, and BasePart `ParamB` determines how frequently it changes direction.

InstanceFileSyncStatus.summary: Describes the file sync status of an Instance.

items.name: NotSynced
items.summary: The Instance is not being synced or errored.

items.name: Errored
items.summary: The Instance is a sync root that has errored and stopped syncing.

items.name: SyncedAsRoot
items.summary: The Instance is being synced as the root of a sync tree.

items.name: SyncedAsDescendant
items.summary: The Instance is being synced because it is a descendant of a sync root.

items.name: AncestorErrored
items.summary: The Instance is not currently being synced because the root of its sync tree is `Errored`.

IntermediateMeshGenerationResult.summary: Indicates the type of result delivered via the intermediate-result callback during an asynchronous mesh-generation operation.

items.name: HighQualityMesh
items.summary: Signals that the intermediate mesh delivered to the callback is high-quality.

InterpolationThrottlingMode.summary: Controls whether the engine reduces the physics interpolation update rate for distant assemblies when the client is under load.

items.name: Default
items.summary: The engine automatically throttles physics interpolation for distant assemblies when client frame time is high.

items.name: Disabled
items.summary: Physics interpolation throttling is unconditionally disabled; all assemblies interpolate at the full rate regardless of client load.

items.name: Enabled
items.summary: Physics interpolation throttling is unconditionally enabled; distant assemblies have their interpolation update rate reduced even when the client is not under load.

InviteState.summary: Describes a player's call invite state.

items.name: Placed
items.summary: Call invite was placed.

items.name: Accepted
items.summary: Call invite was accepted.

items.name: Declined
items.summary: Call invite was declined.

items.name: Missed
items.summary: Call invite was missed.

ItemLineAlignment.summary: Used for UIListLayout.ItemLineAlignment and UIFlexItem.ItemLineAlignment in a flex layout to define the cross-directional alignment of siblings or the parent within a line.

items.name: Automatic
items.summary: Aligns the siblings of the UIListLayout or the specific UIFlexItem parent to the layout's UIListLayout.HorizontalAlignment or UIListLayout.VerticalAlignment, depending on its UIListLayout.FillDirection.

items.name: Start
items.summary: Aligns the siblings of the UIListLayout or the specific UIFlexItem parent to the line's **top** in a horizontal fill or the line's **left** in a vertical fill.

items.name: Center
items.summary: Aligns the siblings of the UIListLayout or the specific UIFlexItem parent to the line's **center** in either a horizontal or vertical fill.

items.name: End
items.summary: Aligns the siblings of the UIListLayout or the specific UIFlexItem parent to the line's **bottom** in a horizontal fill or the line's **right** in a vertical fill.

items.name: Stretch
items.summary: Stretches the siblings of the UIListLayout or the specific UIFlexItem parent to fill the entire cross‑direction of the line in either a horizontal or vertical fill.

JoinSource.summary: Identifies the context in which a player joined an experience via a deeplink.

items.name: CreatedItemAttribution

LexemeType.summary: Identifies the category of a token produced when the Studio Explorer filter bar lexes a filter expression.

items.name: Eof
items.summary: End-of-input token emitted when the lexer reaches the end of the filter string.

items.name: Name
items.summary: An unquoted identifier token, such as an instance name or property key in a filter expression.

items.name: QuotedString
items.summary: A string literal token delimited by single (`'`) or double (`"`) quotes, with backslash escape support.

items.name: Number
items.summary: A numeric literal token representing an integer or decimal value used in a comparison.

items.name: And
items.summary: The case-insensitive keyword `and`, used to combine filter conditions with logical AND.

items.name: Or
items.summary: The case-insensitive keyword `or`, used to combine filter conditions with logical OR.

items.name: Equal
items.summary: The equality comparison operator, matched as `=` or `==` in a filter expression.

items.name: TildeEqual
items.summary: The not-equal comparison operator (`~=`).

items.name: GreaterThan
items.summary: The greater-than comparison operator (`>`).

items.name: GreaterThanEqual
items.summary: The greater-than-or-equal comparison operator (`>=`).

items.name: LessThan
items.summary: The less-than comparison operator (`<`).

items.name: LessThanEqual
items.summary: The less-than-or-equal comparison operator (`<=`).

items.name: Colon
items.summary: The colon character (`:`), used as a separator in filter expressions such as `ClassName:PropertyName`.

items.name: Dot
items.summary: The dot character (`.`), used to navigate nested property paths in a filter expression.

items.name: LeftParenthesis
items.summary: The opening parenthesis character (`(`), used to begin a grouped subexpression in a filter.

items.name: RightParenthesis
items.summary: The closing parenthesis character (`)`), used to end a grouped subexpression in a filter.

items.name: Star
items.summary: The single wildcard character (`*`), used to match any single name segment in a filter path.

items.name: DoubleStar
items.summary: The double wildcard token (`**`), which matches any number of path segments recursively across the instance hierarchy.

items.name: ReservedSpecial
items.summary: A character that is syntactically recognized but has no defined meaning in the current filter grammar.
