items.name: MessageOutput
items.summary: The message is from the standard output channel.

items.name: MessageInfo
items.summary: The message is from the information channel.

items.name: MessageWarning
items.summary: The message is from the warning channel.

items.name: MessageError
items.summary: The message is from the error channel.

ModelLevelOfDetail.summary: Controls the level of detail for Model in experiences with instance streaming enabled.

items.name: Automatic
items.summary: Default behavior, currently equivalent to `Disabled`.

items.name: StreamingMesh
items.summary: A lower resolution "imposter" mesh (colored, coarse mesh that wraps around all child parts of the model) renders outside the streaming radius.

items.name: Disabled
items.summary: A lower resolution mesh will not be displayed.

items.name: SLIM
items.summary: A **SLIM** model (Scalable Lightweight Interactive Model) renders a composite of all child parts at progressively lower resolutions at distances based on the streaming radius.

ModelStreamingBehavior.summary: Controls how Model are sent to clients in experiences with instance streaming enabled.

items.name: Default
items.summary: Default behavior (subject to change).

items.name: Legacy
items.summary: Models are sent when their parent is sent, typically during player join.

items.name: Improved
items.summary: Models are never sent during player join.

ModelStreamingMode.summary: Controls stream in and out behavior of a model.

items.name: Default
items.summary: Default behavior (subject to change).

items.name: Atomic
items.summary: The Model and all of its descendants are streamed in/out together.

items.name: Persistent
items.summary: Persistent models are sent as a complete atomic unit soon after the player joins and before the Workspace.PersistentLoaded event fires.

items.name: PersistentPerPlayer
items.summary: Behaves as a persistent model for players that have been added using Model:AddPersistentPlayer().

items.name: Nonatomic
items.summary: When a nonatomic model is streamed, descendants are also sent, except for part descendants.

ModerationStatus.summary: Indicates the moderation review state of an avatar outfit or asset.

items.name: ReviewedApproved
items.summary: The content completed moderation review and was approved for use.

items.name: ReviewedRejected
items.summary: The content completed moderation review and was rejected.

items.name: NotReviewed
items.summary: The content has been submitted but moderation review is still pending.

items.name: NotApplicable
items.summary: Moderation review is not applicable to this content.

items.name: Invalid
items.summary: An unrecognized or error moderation status returned when the server response cannot be mapped to a known value.

ModifierKey.summary: Identifies a keyboard modifier key for use with InputObject:IsModifierKeyDown().

items.name: Shift
items.summary: The Shift key (left or right Shift key).

items.name: Ctrl
items.summary: The Control key (left or right Ctrl key).

items.name: Alt
items.summary: The Alt key (left or right Alt/Option key).

items.name: Meta
items.summary: The Meta key (the Windows key on Windows, or the Command key on macOS).

items.name: Default
items.summary: The mouse moves freely around the user's screen.

items.name: LockCenter
items.summary: The mouse is locked and cannot move from the center of the user's screen.

items.name: LockCurrentPosition
items.summary: The mouse is locked and cannot move from its current position on the user's screen at the time of locking.

MoveState.summary: Represents the state of a SkateboardPlatform.

items.name: Stopped
items.summary: Skateboard is stopped (not moving).

items.name: Coasting
items.summary: Skateboard is coasting (not actively speeding up / being pushed).

items.name: Pushing
items.summary: Skateboard is being pushed (speeding up).

items.name: Stopping
items.summary: Skateboard is stopping, but still moving.

items.name: AirFree
items.summary: Skateboard is in the air.

MuteState.summary: Describes whether a voice chat participant's microphone is actively transmitting audio.

items.name: Unmuted
items.summary: The participant's microphone is active and transmitting audio.

items.name: Muted
items.summary: The participant's microphone is muted and not transmitting audio.

NameOcclusion.summary: The NameOcclusion Enum is used to set the Humanoid.NameOcclusion property.

items.name: NoOcclusion
items.summary: Do not occlude (hide) any humanoid names.

items.name: EnemyOcclusion
items.summary: Occlude (hide) all enemy humanoid names.

items.name: OccludeAll
items.summary: Occlude (hide) all humanoid names.

NegateOperationHiddenHistory.summary: Records the CSG combination operation — Union or Intersection — that previously merged multiple NegateOperation parts, allowing the engine to restore the correct result type when those parts are later separated.

items.name: None
items.summary: Indicates no previous CSG combination operation is recorded for this NegateOperation part.

items.name: NegatedUnion
items.summary: Indicates this NegateOperation was previously produced by a Union operation applied to multiple negated parts.

items.name: NegatedIntersection
items.summary: Indicates this NegateOperation was previously produced by an Intersection operation applied to multiple negated parts.

NetworkOwnership.summary: Defines how simulation authority is determined for the Network Ownership Unit/Mechanism this part is attached to.

items.name: Automatic
items.summary: Network ownership is determined automatically by the server.

items.name: Manual
items.summary: Network ownership is set manually by the developer.

items.name: OnContact
items.summary: The first player to touch a part is given ownership of that part for the server (network).

NetworkStatus.summary: Describes the device's current network reachability state as reported by `ConnectivityService`.

items.name: Unknown
items.summary: The network connection state has not yet been determined or is unavailable on the current platform.

items.name: Connected
items.summary: The device has an active network connection.

items.name: Disconnected
items.summary: The device does not currently have a network connection.

NoiseType.summary: Specifies the noise algorithm used by a `Noise` instance's `NoiseType` property.

items.name: SimplexGabor
items.summary: Uses an OpenSimplex2 body-centered cubic (BCC) lattice with a Gabor sinusoidal kernel for anisotropic directional noise sampling.

NormalId.summary: The NormalId Enum sets which side/face of a Part is used.

items.name: Right
items.summary: The right face of a Part.

items.name: Top
items.summary: The top face of a Part.

items.name: Back
items.summary: The back face of a Part.

items.name: Left
items.summary: The left face of a Part.

items.name: Bottom
items.summary: The bottom face of a Part.

items.name: Front
items.summary: The front face of a Part.

OrientationAlignmentMode.summary: The OrientationAlignmentMode Enum is used to select the number of Attachment used in an alignment.

items.name: OneAttachment
items.summary: Use one attachment.

items.name: TwoAttachment
items.summary: Use two attachments.

OutfitSource.summary: Filters which outfits are returned by AvatarEditorService:GetOutfitsAsync() based on how they were obtained.

items.name: All
items.summary: Return all outfits regardless of whether they were created or purchased.

items.name: Created
items.summary: Return only outfits that the user created themselves (editable outfits).

items.name: Purchased
items.summary: Return only outfits that the user purchased (non-editable outfits).

OutfitType.summary: Categorizes a saved player outfit by its content type, used to filter or specify outfit type in AvatarEditorService methods.

items.name: All
items.summary: Returns outfits of every type, with no filtering applied.

items.name: Avatar
items.summary: A full-body avatar outfit.

items.name: DynamicHead
items.summary: An outfit containing a dynamic head.

items.name: Shoes
items.summary: An outfit consisting of a pair of shoes.

items.name: Makeup
items.summary: An outfit consisting of makeup items applied to the avatar's face.

OutputLayoutMode.summary: Specifies the orientation of the Output panel in Roblox Studio.

items.name: Horizontal
items.summary: Docks the Output panel horizontally along the top or bottom edge of the Studio window.

items.name: Vertical
items.summary: Docks the Output panel vertically along the left or right edge of the Studio window.

OverrideMouseIconBehavior.summary: Overrides the behavior of the mouse icon to either force that it is always shown or force that it is always hidden.

items.name: None
items.summary: The mouse icon behavior is not overridden - default behavior is used.

items.name: ForceShow
items.summary: The mouse icon is forced to always remain shown/visible.

items.name: ForceHide
items.summary: The mouse icon is forced to always remain hidden/invisible.

PackagePermission.summary: Indicates the current user's or group roleset's permission to the package.

items.name: None
items.summary: Permission data is not available for the current user or group roleset.

items.name: NoAccess
items.summary: The current user or group roleset doesn't have access.

items.name: Revoked
items.summary: The current user's or group roleset's permission is revoked.

items.name: UseView
items.summary: The current user or group roleset can download a copy of the package from Roblox.

items.name: Edit
items.summary: The current user or group roleset can download a copy of the package from Roblox and publish package changes to Roblox.

items.name: Own
items.summary: The current user or group roleset can download a copy of the page from Roblox, publish package changes to Roblox, and manage who has access to the package.

PartType.summary: Controls the Part.Shape of an object.

items.name: Ball
items.summary: A spherical shape.

items.name: Block
items.summary: A block shape.

items.name: Cylinder
items.summary: A cylinder shape oriented along the **X** axis.

items.name: Wedge
items.summary: A wedge shape with a slope on one side.

items.name: CornerWedge
items.summary: A wedge shape with slopes on two sides.

ParticleEmitterShape.summary: Specifies the geometric shape from which a particle emitter emits particles.

items.name: Box
items.summary: Emits particles from a box-shaped region.

items.name: Sphere
items.summary: Emits particles from a sphere-shaped region.

items.name: Cylinder
items.summary: Emits particles from a cylinder-shaped region.

items.name: Disc
items.summary: Emits particles from a disc-shaped region.

ParticleEmitterShapeInOut.summary: Controls the direction particles travel when emitted from a shaped ParticleEmitter.

items.name: Outward
items.summary: Particles emit directed outward away from the emitter shape surface.

items.name: Inward
items.summary: Particles emit directed inward toward the center of the emitter shape.

items.name: InAndOut
items.summary: Particles emit in both outward and inward directions from the emitter shape surface, chosen randomly per particle.

ParticleEmitterShapeStyle.summary: Controls whether a ParticleEmitter emits particles from the surface or the volume of its shape.

items.name: Volume
items.summary: Particles emit from throughout the interior volume of the emitter shape.

items.name: Surface
items.summary: Particles emit only from the outer surface of the emitter shape.

ParticleFlipbookLayout.summary: Determines the layout of the flipbook texture.

items.name: None
items.summary: Disable flipbook features and use the texture as a single static texture over the particle's lifetime.

items.name: Grid2x2
items.summary: 2×2 frames for a 4-frame animation.

items.name: Grid4x4
items.summary: 4×4 frames for a 16-frame animation.

items.name: Grid8x8
items.summary: 8×8 frames for a 64-frame animation.

items.name: Custom
items.summary: A custom grid size defined by ParticleEmitter.FlipbookSizeX and ParticleEmitter.FlipbookSizeY.

ParticleFlipbookMode.summary: Determines the type of the flipbook animation.

items.name: Loop
items.summary: Continuously play through all frames, starting back at the first frame after playing the last.

items.name: OneShot
items.summary: Play through the animation only once across the particle's lifetime.

items.name: PingPong
items.summary: Play from the first to the last frame, then in reverse from the last to the first, repeating throughout the ParticleEmitter.Lifetime of the particle.

items.name: Random
items.summary: Play the frames in a random order, blending/crossfading from one frame to the next.

ParticleFlipbookTextureCompatible.summary: Indicates whether a ParticleEmitter's flipbook texture dimensions are compatible with the selected flipbook layout.

items.name: NotCompatible
items.summary: The ParticleEmitter's flipbook texture dimensions are incompatible with the active flipbook layout (the texture must be 1024×1024); flipbook playback is suppressed.

items.name: Compatible
items.summary: The ParticleEmitter's flipbook texture dimensions are confirmed compatible with the active flipbook layout; flipbook playback proceeds normally.

items.name: Unknown
items.summary: Compatibility has not yet been determined; this is the initial state before the engine resolves the flipbook texture dimensions.

ParticleOrientation.summary: Specifies how a particle's rendered geometry is oriented.

items.name: FacingCamera
items.summary: Orients particles as billboards that face the camera.

items.name: FacingCameraWorldUp
items.summary: Orients particles toward the camera while keeping them upright on the world Y axis.

items.name: VelocityParallel
items.summary: Orients particles parallel to their direction of movement.

items.name: VelocityPerpendicular
items.summary: Orients particles perpendicular to their direction of movement.

PathStatus.summary: The success of a Path generated by PathfindingService.

items.name: Success
items.summary: Path found successfully.

items.name: ClosestNoPath
items.summary: Path doesn't exist, returns path to closest point.

items.name: ClosestOutOfRange
items.summary: Goal is out of MaxDistance range, returns path to closest point you can reach within MaxDistance.

items.name: FailStartNotEmpty
items.summary: Failed to compute path; the starting point is not empty.

items.name: FailFinishNotEmpty
items.summary: Failed to compute path; the finish point is not empty.

items.name: NoPath
items.summary: Path doesn't exist.

PathWaypointAction.summary: Describes the action to take when a PathWaypoint is reached.

items.name: Walk
items.summary: Walk action needed to reach the next waypoint.

items.name: Jump
items.summary: Jump action needed to reach the next waypoint.

items.name: Custom
items.summary: A developer-defined custom action is needed to traverse a PathfindingLink to reach the next waypoint.

PathfindingUseImprovedSearch.summary: Controls whether PathfindingService uses an improved search algorithm.

items.name: Default
items.summary: Uses the engine-default pathfinding behavior.

items.name: Disabled
items.summary: Uses the legacy pathfinding search algorithm.

items.name: Enabled
items.summary: Uses the improved pathfinding search algorithm.

PermissionLevelShown.summary: Used to set the highest permission level that APIs have to have in order to be shown in the Object Browser.

items.name: Game
items.summary: Member must have no security permissions in order to be shown.

items.name: RobloxGame
items.summary: Member must have security permissions less than or equal to **RobloxPlaceSecurity** to be shown.

items.name: RobloxScript
items.summary: Member must have security permissions less than or equal to **RobloxScriptSecurity** to be shown.

items.name: Studio
items.summary: Member must have security permissions less than or equal to **LocalUserSecurity** to be shown.

items.name: Roblox
items.summary: Member is shown no matter what security it has.

PhysicalConstraintType.summary: Specifies the type of physical joint created when importing a rigged asset.

items.name: AnimationConstraint
items.summary: Import creates AnimationConstraint instances to connect the rig's bone joints.

items.name: Motor6D
items.summary: Import creates Motor6D instances to connect the rig's bone joints.

PhysicsSteppingMethod.summary: Controls how the physics engine advances simulation time for assemblies in a Workspace.

items.name: Default
items.summary: The current default is `Adaptive`.

items.name: Fixed
items.summary: All simulated assemblies inside the workspace will advance forward at 240 Hz.

items.name: Adaptive
items.summary: The engine attempts to assign optimal simulation rates for individual assemblies of either 240 Hz, 120 Hz, or 60 Hz.

Platform.summary: Host operating system of the client.

items.name: Windows
items.summary: The client is running on a Windows Operating System.

items.name: OSX
items.summary: The client is running on OSX (Apple desktop).

items.name: IOS
items.summary: The client is running on IOS (Apple mobile).

items.name: Android
items.summary: The client is running on Android (Google mobile).

items.name: XBoxOne
items.summary: The client is running on an XBox One (console).

items.name: PS4
items.summary: The client is running on a PS4 (console).

items.name: PS3
items.summary: The client is running on a PS3 (console).

items.name: XBox360
items.summary: The client is running on an XBox 360 (console).

items.name: WiiU
items.summary: The client is running on a Wii U (console).

items.name: NX
items.summary: The client is running on an NX Operating System (Cisco Nexus).

items.name: Ouya
items.summary: The client is running on an Ouya Operating System (Android-Based).

items.name: AndroidTV
items.summary: The client is running on an Android TV.

items.name: Chromecast
items.summary: The client is running on Chromecast.

items.name: Linux
items.summary: The client is running on a Linux Operating System (desktop).

items.name: SteamOS
items.summary: The client is running on Steam.

items.name: WebOS
items.summary: The client is running on WebOS.

items.name: DOS
items.summary: The client is running on DOS.

items.name: BeOS
items.summary: The client is running on BeOS.

items.name: UWP
items.summary: The client is running on UWP.

items.name: PS5
items.summary: The client is running on a PS5 (console).

items.name: MetaOS
items.summary: The client is running on Meta OS (Meta Quest VR platform).

items.name: Web
items.summary: The client is running in a web browser.

items.name: None
items.summary: The client's operating system is unknown.

PlaybackState.summary: Describes the current state of a Tween in its Tween.PlaybackState property.

items.name: Begin
items.summary: The tween has been created, but has yet to be played.

items.name: Delayed
items.summary: The tween is waiting for the duration specified in its TweenInfo.DelayTime.

items.name: Playing
items.summary: The tween is currently in progress.

items.name: Paused
items.summary: The tween is paused in the middle of playing.

items.name: Completed
items.summary: The tween completed successfully.

items.name: Cancelled
items.summary: The tween was cancelled before completion.

PlayerActions.summary: References a movement action taken by a player.

items.name: CharacterForward
items.summary: The player moved forward.

items.name: CharacterBackward
items.summary: The player moved backward.

items.name: CharacterLeft
items.summary: The player moved left.

items.name: CharacterRight
items.summary: The player moved right.

items.name: CharacterJump
items.summary: The player jumped.

PlayerCharacterDestroyBehavior.summary: Controls destruction behavior when a player character is removed.

items.name: Default
items.summary: Uses the engine-default behavior.

items.name: Disabled
items.summary: Automatic `Destroy()` calls on character replacement and player removal are disabled.

items.name: Enabled
items.summary: The engine automatically calls `Destroy()` on old characters when they are replaced (for example, on respawn) and on `Player` objects when players leave.

PlayerChatType.summary: Determines the style of a chat message.

items.name: All
items.summary: A global message that everyone can receive.

items.name: Team
items.summary: A team message only players in the same team can receive.

items.name: Whisper
items.summary: A whispered message only the person it's whispered to can receive.

PlayerExitReason.summary: An enum that specifies the reason for **Players.PlayerRemoving** signal.

items.name: Unknown
items.summary: Catch-all for all other disconnect reasons.

items.name: PlatformKick
items.summary: User was kicked by Roblox systems, such as being blocked while in a Private Server.

items.name: CreatorKick
items.summary: Creator called **Player:Kick()**

PlayerPlatformSpenderStatus.summary: Describes a player's platform-wide spender status bucket.

items.name: Unknown
items.summary: Segment data is unavailable.

items.name: Active
items.summary: The player is an active platform spender.

items.name: OtherPayer
items.summary: The player is not an active platform spender, including players who have never spent.

PluginConnectionTargetType.summary: Describes the data model type that the remote end of a PluginConnection runs in.

items.name: Edit
items.summary: The target data model is an edit-session data model which spawned this test data model.

items.name: Test
items.summary: The target data model is a test (simulation/playtest) data model spawned from this edit data model.

PoseEasingDirection.summary: Used exclusively by Pose.EasingDirection to specify direction of the EasingStyle curve.

items.name: In
items.summary: The EasingStyle curve is reversed, with the easing becoming linear as it approaches the next keyframe.

items.name: Out
items.summary: EasingStyle curves are applied in the forward direction, from the current keyframe to the next.

items.name: InOut
items.summary: Two easing curves are applied back-to-back with the linear ends of the curves meeting in the middle.

PoseEasingStyle.summary: Specifies the interpolation curve used when blending between keyframe Pose in a KeyframeSequence.

items.name: Linear
items.summary: Poses interpolate linearly between keyframes.

items.name: Constant
items.summary: Poses do not interpolate but snap to the keyframe indicated by the PoseEasingDirection.

items.name: Elastic
items.summary: Pose interpolation overshoots like an elastic curve.

items.name: Cubic
items.summary: Deprecated - Use PoseEasingStyle.CubicV2.

items.name: Bounce
items.summary: Pose interpolation produces a bounce-like effect between keyframes.

items.name: CubicV2
items.summary: Pose interpolation is a cubic curve between keyframes based on PoseEasingDirection.

PositionAlignmentMode.summary: The PositionAlignmentMode Enum is used to select the number of Attachment used in an alignment.

items.name: OneAttachment
items.summary: Use one attachment.

items.name: TwoAttachment
items.summary: Use two attachments.

PredictionMode.summary: Enum used with RunService:SetPredictionMode() to define the prediction mode for the instance.

items.name: Automatic
items.summary: The engine will automatically decide if this instance should be predicted or not.

items.name: On
items.summary: The instance will be predicted.

items.name: Off
items.summary: The instance will **not** be predicted.

PredictionStatus.summary: Enum used with RunService:GetPredictionStatus() to check the status of a specific instance.

items.name: Authoritative
items.summary: This instance is authoritative.

items.name: Predicted
items.summary: This instance is being predicted.

items.name: None
items.summary: The instance will not be resimulated; classic simulation rules apply instead.

PredictiveStreamingMode.summary: Used with Workspace.PredictiveStreamingMode to control whether the engine streams instances predictively.

items.name: Default
items.summary: Uses the engine's current default behavior for predictive streaming.

items.name: Enabled
items.summary: Enables predictive streaming, pre-fetching content in the direction of player movement to reduce pop-in.

items.name: Disabled
items.summary: Disables predictive streaming; content is streamed based on the player's current position radius only.

PreferredInput.summary: This enum is used with UserInputService.PreferredInput to indicate the primary input type a player is likely using.

items.name: KeyboardAndMouse
items.summary: The player has connected or most recently interacted with a keyboard or mouse.

items.name: Gamepad
items.summary: The player has connected or most recently interacted with a gamepad.

items.name: Touch
items.summary: The player's device has touch capability and no other input method is available or was recently interacted with.

items.name: MicroGamepad
items.summary: The player has connected or most recently interacted with a gamepad without a thumbstick (for example, a TV remote or another limited-input gamepad), and no standard gamepad is currently connected.

PreferredTextSize.summary: This enum is used with GuiService.PreferredTextSize to indicate the player's preferred text size.

items.name: Medium
items.summary: The player prefers default text size.

items.name: Large
items.summary: The player prefers text size slightly increased beyond default.

items.name: Larger
items.summary: The player prefers text size moderately increased beyond default.

items.name: Largest
items.summary: The player prefers text size considerably increased beyond default.

PrimalPhysicsSolver.summary: Controls whether the experimental Primal Physics Solver is enabled.

items.name: Default
items.summary: Uses the engine-default physics solver state.

items.name: Experimental
items.summary: The experimental Primal Physics Solver is enabled.

items.name: Disabled
items.summary: The Primal Physics Solver is disabled.

PrimitiveType.summary: Identifies the base primitive shape of a BasePart node within a CSG operation graph.

items.name: Null
items.summary: Sentinel value indicating no valid primitive shape; used for uninitialized or invalid nodes in a CSG operation graph.

items.name: Ball
items.summary: A spherical primitive shape, corresponding to the ball/sphere geometry of a Part.

items.name: Cylinder
items.summary: A cylindrical primitive shape, corresponding to the cylinder geometry of a Part.

items.name: Block
items.summary: A box primitive shape, corresponding to the standard rectangular block geometry of a Part; the default primitive type for new Part nodes in a CSG operation graph.

items.name: Wedge
items.summary: A wedge primitive shape, corresponding to the geometry of a WedgePart.

items.name: CornerWedge
items.summary: A corner wedge primitive shape, corresponding to the geometry of a CornerWedgePart.

ProductLocationRestriction.summary: Specifies the purchase locations permitted for an avatar item.

items.name: AvatarShop
items.summary: Item is purchasable only in the Marketplace.

items.name: AllowedGames
items.summary: Item is purchasable in the Marketplace and experiences owned by the item creator.

items.name: AllGames
items.summary: (Default) Item is purchasable in the Marketplace and all experiences.

ProductPurchaseChannel.summary: Enum which works with MarketplaceService to represent how the user acquired the developer product.

items.name: InExperience
items.summary: The purchase was made inside of an experience.

items.name: ExperienceDetailsPage
items.summary: The purchase was made outside of an experience, on the **Store** tab of the experience details page.

items.name: AdReward
items.summary: The product was rewarded to the user when they watched a video ad to completion.

items.name: CommerceProduct
items.summary: The user acquired the product as a benefit of purchasing commerce merchandise from the developer of the experience.

ProductPurchaseDecision.summary: The `ProductPurchaseDecisionEnum` works with MarketplaceService to indicate the status of the sale of developer products.

items.name: NotProcessedYet
items.summary: The purchase request has been sent but not yet processed.

items.name: PurchaseGranted
items.summary: The purchase has been processed and granted to the user who initiated the purchase request.

PromptCreateAssetResult.summary: Describes the result of a AvatarCreationService:PromptCreateAvatarAssetAsync() call.

items.name: Success
items.summary: The asset was successfully created and published.

items.name: PermissionDenied
items.summary: The player explicitly declined the asset-creation consent prompt.

items.name: Timeout
items.summary: The creation attempt timed out because the player disconnected or left the experience.

items.name: UploadFailed
items.summary: The asset upload to the Roblox backend failed after validation.

items.name: NoUserInput
items.summary: The player did not interact with the creation prompt before it expired.

items.name: UnknownFailure
items.summary: The asset creation failed for an unspecified or unexpected reason.

items.name: UGCValidationFailed
items.summary: The asset failed user-generated content validation checks before upload.

items.name: ModeratedName
items.summary: The asset name or description was rejected by Roblox moderation.

items.name: PurchaseFailure
items.summary: The asset could not be created because the player had insufficient Robux.

items.name: TokenInvalid
items.summary: The creation token provided to the prompt was invalid or could not be verified.

PromptCreateAvatarResult.summary: Result codes returned by AvatarCreationService:PromptCreateAvatarAsync() indicating whether avatar creation succeeded or why it failed.

items.name: Success
items.summary: The avatar was successfully created and published to the player's account.

items.name: PermissionDenied
items.summary: The player explicitly declined the avatar creation consent prompt.

items.name: Timeout
items.summary: The avatar creation consent prompt timed out before the player responded.

items.name: UploadFailed
items.summary: The avatar assets passed validation but the server-side upload or bundle creation step failed.

items.name: NoUserInput
items.summary: The player did not interact with the avatar creation consent prompt before it closed.

items.name: InvalidHumanoidDescription
items.summary: The HumanoidDescription supplied to AvatarCreationService:PromptCreateAvatarAsync() was invalid and could not be used to create an avatar.

items.name: UGCValidationFailed
items.summary: The avatar's geometry or content failed Roblox's UGC (User-Generated Content) validation checks.

items.name: ModeratedName
items.summary: The proposed avatar name or description was rejected by Roblox moderation.

items.name: MaxOutfits
items.summary: The player has reached the maximum number of outfits allowed on their Roblox account.

items.name: PurchaseFailure
items.summary: The avatar creation attempt failed because the player did not have sufficient Robux to cover the required purchase.

items.name: UnknownFailure
items.summary: An unexpected or unclassified failure occurred during avatar creation.

items.name: TokenInvalid
items.summary: The creation token provided to AvatarCreationService:PromptCreateAvatarAsync() was not valid or did not match the current experience.

PromptExperienceDetailsResult.summary: Indicates how the player dismissed the experience details prompt shown by TeleportService:PromptExperienceDetailsAsync().

items.name: PromptClosed
items.summary: The player dismissed the experience details prompt without choosing to teleport (value `0`).

items.name: TeleportAttempted
items.summary: The player clicked the **Join** button in the experience details prompt, initiating a teleport to the advertised experience (value `1`).

PromptPublishAssetResult.summary: Deprecated result enum for the `OpenPublishResultModal` event.

items.name: Success
items.summary: The asset was published successfully.

items.name: PermissionDenied
items.summary: The user explicitly denied the consent prompt required to publish the asset.

items.name: Timeout
items.summary: The publish flow timed out, typically because the user disconnected or left the experience during the consent prompt.

items.name: UploadFailed
items.summary: The asset upload to the Roblox backend failed after consent was granted.

items.name: NoUserInput
items.summary: The user did not grant or deny the consent prompt before the window expired.

items.name: UnknownFailure
items.summary: The publish failed for an unspecified or unexpected reason.

PropertyStatus.summary: Indicates the validation state of a property as displayed in Roblox Studio's Properties panel.

items.name: Ok
items.summary: The property value is valid; no status indicator is shown in Studio.

items.name: Warning
items.summary: The property value has a recoverable issue; Studio displays a warning indicator on the instance.

items.name: Error
items.summary: The property value is invalid and cannot be resolved; Studio displays an error indicator on the instance.

ProximityPromptExclusivity.summary: Controls how a ProximityPrompt competes with other prompts for screen visibility.

items.name: OnePerButton
items.summary: One prompt will be shown per input KeyCode.

items.name: OneGlobally
items.summary: Only one prompt will be shown with this setting.

items.name: AlwaysShow
items.summary: This prompt will always show when in range and visible.

ProximityPromptInputType.summary: Identifies the input method a player is using when a ProximityPrompt is shown.

items.name: Keyboard
items.summary: The player is using keyboard and mouse input.

items.name: Gamepad
items.summary: The player is using a gamepad controller.

items.name: Touch
items.summary: The player is using a touch screen.

ProximityPromptStyle.summary: Specifies the visual style of a ProximityPrompt.

items.name: Default
items.summary: Built-in Roblox CoreScript prompt UI.

items.name: Custom
items.summary: Suppresses the built-in prompt UI so you can render a custom prompt (see ProximityPrompt.Style).

PurchaseOption.summary: Specifies the type of purchase option in a bulk purchase prompt.

items.name: TimedOption
items.summary: A timed ownership option.

items.name: Permanent
items.summary: A permanent ownership purchase option.

QualityLevel.summary: Controls the rendering quality of the game.

items.summary: The quality level of graphics is determined automatically depending on the client's setting for either game performance or graphic quality.

items.name: Level02

items.name: Level08

items.name: Level09
items.summary: Graphic quality level 9.

items.name: Level10
items.summary: Graphic quality level 10.

items.name: Level11
items.summary: Graphic quality level 11.

items.name: Level12

items.summary: Graphic quality level 16.

items.name: Level19
items.summary: Graphic quality level 19.
