R15CollisionType.summary: Collision behavior type for a R15 character.

items.name: OuterBox
items.summary: Dynamically sized collision boxes based on mesh sizes.

items.name: InnerBox
items.summary: Fixed size collision boxes, similar to the classic avatar collision.

RaycastFilterType.summary: Used in a RaycastParams object to determine how its RaycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances list will be used.

items.name: Exclude
items.summary: Every BasePart in the raycast operation will be considered **except** those that are descendants of objects in the filter list.

items.name: Include
items.summary: Only BasePart which are descendants of objects in the filter list will be considered in the raycast operation.

ReadCapturesFromGalleryResult.summary: Describes the outcome of a CaptureService:ReadCapturesFromGalleryAsync() call.

items.name: Success
items.summary: The read operation completed successfully and capture data has been returned.

items.name: NeedPermission
items.summary: The read operation failed because the experience has not been granted permission to access the user's capture gallery.

ReceiptDecision.summary: `ReceiptDecision` works with MarketplaceService to indicate the acknowledgement of receipts.

items.name: NotProcessedYet
items.summary: The receipt has not been processed yet.

items.name: Processed
items.summary: The receipt has been processed and all benefits have been granted.

ReceiptType.summary: `ReceiptType` is used to work with server-sided receipt processing.

items.name: DeveloperProduct
items.summary: Used for processing receipts from developer product purchases made with MarketplaceService:PromptProductPurchase().

items.name: RobuxTransferSender
items.summary: Used for processing receipts for the user who initiated a Robux transfer.

items.name: RobuxTransferReceiver
items.summary: Used for processing receipts for the user who received Robux via a transfer.

RecommendationActionType.summary: Describes the type of action a user took on a recommended item, used when logging action events via RecommendationService:LogActionEvent().

items.name: AddReaction
items.summary: The user added a reaction to the item, such as a "like".

items.name: RemoveReaction
items.summary: The user removed a reaction from the item.

items.name: Share
items.summary: The user shared the item.

items.name: Report
items.summary: The user created an abuse report of the item.

items.name: Comment
items.summary: The user commented on the item.

items.name: Play
items.summary: The user joined an experience through the item, or played a mini-game associated with the item.

items.name: Purchase
items.summary: The user made a purchase from the item.

RecommendationImpressionType.summary: Specifies the outcome of rendering a recommended item, passed to RecommendationService:LogImpressionEvent() to indicate whether the item was shown to the user.

items.name: View
items.summary: A complete view of the item.

items.name: NotViewable
items.summary: The item has failed to render.

RecommendationItemContentType.summary: Describes the content type of an item registered with RecommendationService.

items.name: Static
items.summary: The item is static, such as an image.

items.name: Dynamic
items.summary: The item is dynamic; for example, it is a video.

items.name: Interactive
items.summary: The item is interactive, such as a 3D model or a mini-game.

RecommendationItemVisibility.summary: Controls whether a registered recommendation item is publicly discoverable or restricted to private access.

items.name: Private
items.summary: The recommendation item is not surfaced to other players by the recommendation system.

items.name: Public
items.summary: The recommendation item is discoverable and may be surfaced to other players by the recommendation system.

RecommendationPreferenceTargetType.summary: Identifies the kind of entity that a preference signal targets when logged via RecommendationService:LogPreferenceEvent().

items.name: User
items.summary: The target is another Roblox user.

items.name: Universe
items.summary: The target is a universe.

items.name: CustomTag
items.summary: The target is a custom content tag.

RecommendationPreferenceType.summary: Identifies the type of preference action (follow, unfollow, mute, or unmute) passed to RecommendationService:LogPreferenceEvent().

items.name: AddFollow
items.summary: The user started following the target.

items.name: RemoveFollow
items.summary: The user stopped following the target.

items.name: AddMute
items.summary: The user muted the target.

items.name: RemoveMute
items.summary: The user unmuted a previously muted target.

RejectCharacterDeletions.summary: Controls whether the server rejects client attempts to delete player characters.

items.name: Default
items.summary: Uses the engine-default behavior (currently equivalent to `Enabled`).

items.name: Disabled
items.summary: The server does not reject character deletion requests from clients.

items.name: Enabled
items.summary: The server rejects client attempts to delete player characters.

RenderFidelity.summary: Determines the level of detail that solid modeled and mesh parts will be shown in.

items.name: Automatic
items.summary: Object's level of detail is dynamically controlled by its distance from the camera (see table above).

items.name: Precise
items.summary: Object is rendered in the highest fidelity regardless of its distance from the camera.

items.name: Performance
items.summary: Push performance as much as possible, trying to maintain quality if possible, and discarding appearance if that's necessary to reach performance.

RenderPriority.summary: A list of standard reserved values in BindToRenderStep.

items.name: First
items.summary: The lowest reserved priority level; callbacks run before all other standard priorities.

items.name: Input
items.summary: Runs after `First`; intended for input-processing callbacks.

items.name: Camera
items.summary: Runs after `Input`; intended for camera-update callbacks.

items.name: Character
items.summary: Runs after `Camera`; intended for character-response callbacks.

items.name: Last
items.summary: The highest reserved priority level; callbacks run after all other standard priorities.

items.name: Default
items.summary: Uses the engine-default rendering cache state.

items.name: Disabled
items.summary: Rendering cache optimizations are disabled.

items.name: Enabled
items.summary: Rendering cache optimizations are enabled.

ReplicateInstanceDestroySetting.summary: Controls how `Instance:Destroy()` calls are replicated from server to clients.

items.name: Default
items.summary: Uses the engine-default instance destroy replication behavior.

items.name: Disabled
items.summary: Uses legacy instance destroy replication behavior.

items.name: Enabled
items.summary: Uses improved instance destroy replication behavior.

items.name: Default
items.summary: Bilinear filtering of the four near pixels in the image.

items.name: Pixelated
items.summary: Nearest neighbor filtering of the closest pixel in the image.

ReservedHighlightId.summary: Identifies the built-in reserved role assigned to a Highlight via its `ReservedId` property.

items.name: Standard
items.summary: Marks a Highlight as a standard, non-reserved instance not tied to any built-in system state.

items.name: Active
items.summary: Marks a Highlight as the last-selected object in Studio.

items.name: Hover
items.summary: Marks a Highlight as the hover-state indicator, applied to an object currently under the mouse cursor.

items.name: Selection
items.summary: Marks a Highlight as the selection-state indicator, applied to a selected object in Studio.

items.name: NegatedPart
items.summary: Marks a Highlight used for CSG negated-part visualization in Roblox Studio.

RestPose.summary: Determines how the initial joint rest pose is established when importing a rigged 3D model.

items.name: Default
items.summary: Uses the first animation clip found in the source file to define the initial joint rest pose on import.

items.name: RotationsReset
items.summary: Resets all joint rotations to zero so that the imported rig starts from an identity rest pose.

items.name: Custom
items.summary: Uses a specific animation clip, identified by its index in the file, to set the initial joint rest pose on import.

ReverbType.summary: The ReverbType Enum allows you to make audio in your game sound different, depending on what "area" the sounds are in.

items.name: NoReverb
items.summary: No sound reverb.

items.name: GenericReverb
items.summary: Sound reverb is changed to a generic reverb effect.

items.name: PaddedCell
items.summary: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in a padded cell.

items.name: Room
items.summary: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in a room.

items.name: Bathroom
items.summary: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in a bathroom.

items.name: LivingRoom
items.summary: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in a living room.

items.name: StoneRoom
items.summary: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in a stone room.

items.name: Auditorium
items.summary: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in an auditorium.

items.name: ConcertHall
items.summary: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in a concert hall.

items.name: Cave
items.summary: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in a cave.

items.name: Arena
items.summary: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in an arena.

items.name: Hangar
items.summary: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in a hangar.

items.name: CarpettedHallway
items.summary: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in a carpeted hallway.

items.name: Hallway
items.summary: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in a hallway.

items.name: StoneCorridor
items.summary: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in a stone corridor.

items.name: Alley
items.summary: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in an alley.

items.name: Forest
items.summary: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in a forest.

items.name: City
items.summary: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in a city.

items.name: Mountains
items.summary: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in the mountains.

items.name: Quarry
items.summary: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in a quarry.

items.name: Plain
items.summary: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is an open plain.

items.name: ParkingLot
items.summary: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in a parking lot.

items.name: SewerPipe
items.summary: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is in a sewer pipe.

items.name: UnderWater
items.summary: Sound reverb is changed to sound like the player is underwater.

RibbonTool.summary: Identifies a Studio ribbon toolbar tool, used with Plugin:GetSelectedRibbonTool() and Plugin:SelectRibbonTool().

items.name: Select
items.summary: The **Select** tool, which selects objects in the viewport.

items.name: Scale
items.summary: The **Scale** tool, which resizes selected parts along their axes.

items.name: Rotate
items.summary: The **Rotate** tool, which rotates selected parts around the three primary axes.

items.name: Move
items.summary: The **Move** tool, which translates selected parts along the three primary axes.

items.name: Transform
items.summary: The **Transform** tool, which provides combined move, scale, and rotate handles in a single gizmo.

items.name: ColorPicker
items.summary: The **Color** tool, which opens the color picker to paint the color of selected parts.

items.name: MaterialPicker
items.summary: Deprecated ribbon **Color**/**Material** picker tool; use **Material Manager** instead.

items.name: Group
items.summary: The **Group** tool, which groups the selected objects into a Model.

items.name: Ungroup
items.summary: The **Ungroup** tool, which dissolves a selected Model and promotes its children to the parent container.

items.name: None
items.summary: Represents no ribbon tool being active.

items.name: PivotEditor
items.summary: The **Edit Pivot** tool, which repositions the pivot point of selected parts or models.

RollOffMode.summary: How Sound parented to a BasePart or Attachment attenuate (fade out) as the distance between the listener and the parent increases.

items.name: Inverse
items.summary: Volume attenuates from Sound.RollOffMinDistance in an inverse manner, mirroring how sounds attenuate in the real world.

items.name: Linear
items.summary: Volume attenuates between Sound.RollOffMinDistance and Sound.RollOffMaxDistance with a linear relationship.

items.name: LinearSquare
items.summary: Volume attenuates between Sound.RollOffMinDistance and Sound.RollOffMaxDistance with a linear squared relationship.

items.name: InverseTapered
items.summary: A hybrid model which follows the `Inverse` model when close to Sound.RollOffMinDistance and the `LinearSquare` model when close to Sound.RollOffMaxDistance.

RolloutState.summary: A three-phase rollout state used to opt in or out of engine features.

items.name: Default
items.summary: Uses the engine-wide rollout default, which changes as the feature progresses through its rollout phases.

items.name: Disabled
items.summary: Opts out of the feature regardless of the engine-wide rollout phase.

items.name: Enabled
items.summary: Opts in to the feature regardless of the engine-wide rollout phase.

RotationOrder.summary: The order of rotation axes used for Euler angles encoding of rotations.

items.name: XYZ
items.summary: X, Y, Z order.

items.name: XZY
items.summary: X, Z, Y order.

items.name: YZX
items.summary: Y, Z, X order.

items.name: YXZ
items.summary: Y, X, Z order.

items.name: ZXY
items.summary: Z, X, Y order.

items.name: ZYX
items.summary: Z, Y, X order.

RotationType.summary: Controls how a player character's body rotation is determined — relative to the camera direction or relative to the movement direction.

items.name: MovementRelative
items.summary: The character's body rotation follows the direction of movement.

items.name: CameraRelative
items.summary: The character's body rotation continuously follows the camera's look direction.

RsvpStatus.summary: Indicates a player's RSVP response to a Roblox experience event.

items.name: None
items.summary: The player has not yet responded to the event invitation; this is the default RSVP state.

items.name: Going
items.summary: The player has accepted the event invitation and confirmed they are going.

items.name: NotGoing
items.summary: The player has declined the event invitation and indicated they are not going.

RtlTextSupport.summary: Controls whether right-to-left text rendering is enabled for the experience.

items.name: Default
items.summary: Enables RTL text support using the engine's default behavior.

items.name: Disabled
items.summary: Disables RTL text support, forcing all text to render left-to-right.

items.name: Enabled
items.summary: Explicitly enables RTL text support for right-to-left scripts such as Arabic and Hebrew.

RunContext.summary: Controls the execution context of a Script, determining whether it runs as server, client, plugin, or legacy container-based code.

items.name: Legacy
items.summary: Runs with legacy container-based behavior that depends on the script type, such as LocalScript or Script.

items.name: Server
items.summary: Runs on the server.

items.name: Client
items.summary: Runs on the client.

items.name: Plugin
items.summary: Runs as a descendant of Plugin instances.

RunState.summary: Specifies the current run state of Roblox Studio's simulation.

items.name: Stopped
items.summary: The simulation is stopped.

items.name: Running
items.summary: The simulation is running.

items.name: Paused
items.summary: The simulation is paused.

RuntimeUndoBehavior.summary: Controls how ChangeHistoryService records and handles undo history during a Studio playtest session.

items.name: Aggregate
items.summary: Rejects waypoint requests during a run session; all runtime changes accumulate into a single waypoint that is reverted together when the session stops or resets.

items.name: Snapshot
items.summary: Accepts waypoint requests during a run session and captures a snapshot of each instance's position and velocity at every waypoint boundary so that physics state can be fully restored on undo.

items.name: Hybrid
items.summary: Accepts waypoint requests during a run session but excludes unsolicited physics changes (position and velocity drift from simulation) from the recorded history.

SafeAreaCompatibility.summary: Describes how descendants of a ScreenGui adapt to screens with cutouts.

items.name: None
items.summary: Do not apply compatibility transformations to any descendants of the ScreenGui.

items.name: FullscreenExtension
items.summary: If the total area of any descendant GuiObject within the ScreenGui (including any applied border or UIStroke) covers the device's safe area both horizontally and vertically, its background area will be expanded to cover the fullscreen area.

SalesTypeFilter.summary: Filters catalog search results by sales type.

items.name: All
items.summary: Returns all items regardless of sales type.

items.name: Collectibles
items.summary: Returns only collectible items (Limited and Limited Unique).

items.name: Premium
items.summary: Returns only items with Premium pricing.

items.name: TimedOptions
items.summary: Returns only items that have timed options available.

SandboxedInstanceMode.summary: Controls whether sandboxed instance mode (script capabilities) is enabled.

items.name: Default
items.summary: Uses the engine-default sandboxed instance state.

items.name: Experimental
items.summary: Sandboxed instance mode is enabled.

SaveFilter.summary: Used by DataModel.SavePlace to determine the type of save operation This enum determines which aspects of the current place are saved, based on the following options.

items.name: SaveWorld
items.summary: Saves only the world-related data.

items.name: SaveGame
items.summary: Saves only the game-related data.

items.name: SaveAll
items.summary: Saves all data, including both world and game-related information.

SavedQualitySetting.summary: Represents the user's saved graphics quality preference, stored in UserGameSettings.SavedQualityLevel.

items.name: Automatic
items.summary: Graphics quality is determined automatically based on device performance.

items.name: QualityLevel1
items.summary: Saved graphics quality level 1 — the lowest explicit quality setting.

items.name: QualityLevel2
items.summary: Saved graphics quality level 2.

items.name: QualityLevel3
items.summary: Saved graphics quality level 3.

items.name: QualityLevel4
items.summary: Saved graphics quality level 4.

items.name: QualityLevel5
items.summary: Saved graphics quality level 5.

items.name: QualityLevel6
items.summary: Saved graphics quality level 6.

items.name: QualityLevel7
items.summary: Saved graphics quality level 7.

items.name: QualityLevel8
items.summary: Saved graphics quality level 8.

items.name: QualityLevel9
items.summary: Saved graphics quality level 9.

items.name: QualityLevel10
items.summary: Saved graphics quality level 10 — the highest explicit quality setting.

ScaleType.summary: Determines how an image (of a ImageLabel or ImageButton) is scaled.

items.name: Stretch
items.summary: The image is stretched to fit within the element.

items.name: Slice
items.summary: 9-Slice scaling: slice the image into 9 regions and apply different scaling rules to each region.

items.name: Tile
items.summary: The image is tiled to fit within the element.

items.name: Fit
items.summary: The image is scaled fit within the element X or Y dimension (whichever fits first).

items.name: Crop
items.summary: The image is cropped to fit within the element.

ScopeCheckResult.summary: Indicates the outcome of an `ExperienceAuthService` scope-authorization request.

items.name: ConsentAccepted
items.summary: The player accepted the authorization prompt and a valid token was issued for the requested scopes.

items.name: InvalidScopes
items.summary: The requested scopes are not recognized or are not permitted for the calling context.

items.name: Timeout
items.summary: The scope-check request exceeded the configured timeout period before the player responded.

items.name: NoUserInput
items.summary: The authorization prompt was dismissed without any explicit player action, such as when the player disconnects or the UI is closed without a response.

items.name: BackendError
items.summary: The Roblox backend returned an error or unexpected HTTP status when exchanging the consent grant for an authorization token.

items.name: UnexpectedError
items.summary: An unexpected error occurred that is not covered by a more specific result code.

items.name: InvalidArgument
items.summary: One or more arguments passed to the scope-check call were invalid, such as an empty scope list, a null player instance, or a player who is no longer in the experience.

items.name: ConsentDenied
items.summary: The player explicitly declined the authorization prompt.

ScreenInsets.summary: Insets associated with various screen safe areas.

items.name: None
items.summary: No insets are added to the fullscreen area.

items.name: DeviceSafeInsets
items.summary: Device safe area insets are added to the fullscreen area.

items.name: CoreUISafeInsets
items.summary: Core UI insets are added to the `DeviceSafeInsets` area, resulting in an area guaranteed to be unobscured by both device screen cutouts and Roblox core UI elements like the top bar buttons.

items.name: TopbarSafeInsets
items.summary: Top bar safe area insets are added to the `DeviceSafeInsets` area, resulting in an area guaranteed to be unobscured by both device screen cutouts and Roblox core UI elements like the experience controls.

ScreenOrientation.summary: The preference of in-game screen orientation on hand-held devices.

items.name: LandscapeLeft
items.summary: A preference where the game is displayed landscape (horizontally) with the bottom of the device on the left side of the screen.

items.name: LandscapeRight
items.summary: A preference where the game is displayed landscape (horizontally) with the bottom of the device on the right side of the screen.

items.name: LandscapeSensor
items.summary: A preference where the game is displayed landscape (horizontally) with the bottom of the device on the left of right side of the screen depending on the device's orientation (the sensor determines which side allows for the game to be displayed right-side-up).

items.name: Portrait
items.summary: A preference where the game is displayed portrait (vertically) with the bottom of the device on the bottom of the screen.

items.name: Sensor
items.summary: A preference where the game is displayed depending on the best match to the device's current orientation - either landscape (left/right) or portrait.

ScreenshotCaptureResult.summary: Describes the result of a screenshot capture initiated by CaptureService:TakeScreenshotCaptureAsync().

items.name: Success
items.summary: The screenshot capture completed successfully.

items.name: OtherError
items.summary: The screenshot capture failed due to an unspecified error.

items.name: NoDeviceSupport
items.summary: The device does not support screenshot captures.

items.name: NoSpaceOnDevice
items.summary: The device does not have enough storage space to save the screenshot capture.

ScriptStoppedReason.summary: Describes why the debugger paused execution.

items.name: Breakpoint
items.summary: Execution stopped because a user-defined breakpoint was hit.

items.name: Exception
items.summary: Execution stopped because an exception was thrown (governed by the current DebugBreakModeType).

items.name: Pause
items.summary: Execution stopped because ScriptDebuggerService:Pause() was called.

items.name: Step
items.summary: Execution stopped after completing a step operation.

items.name: Entry
items.summary: Execution stopped at a script's entry point.

ScriptVariableScope.summary: Indicates the scope category of a variable returned by the debugger.

items.name: Local
items.summary: A local variable declared in the current function scope.

items.name: Upvalue
items.summary: A variable captured from an enclosing function scope.

items.name: Global
items.summary: A global variable.

ScrollBarInset.summary: This enum is used with ScrollingFrame.HorizontalScrollBarInset and ScrollingFrame.VerticalScrollBarInset to indicate whether the canvas should be inset by ScrollingFrame.ScrollBarThickness for the respective scroll bar.

items.name: None
items.summary: The canvas will never be inset for the respective scroll bar.

items.name: ScrollBar
items.summary: The canvas will only be inset if the respective scroll bar is showing.

items.name: Always
items.summary: The canvas will always be inset for the respective scroll bar, regardless of whether that scroll bar is showing.

ScrollingDirection.summary: This enum is used by ScrollingFrame.ScrollingDirection to specify the direction(s) in which scrolling is allowed.

items.name: X
items.summary: The canvas can only be scrolled along the **X** axis.

items.name: Y
items.summary: The canvas can only be scrolled along the **Y** axis.

items.name: XY
items.summary: The canvas can be scrolled along both the **X** and **Y** axes.

SecurityCapability.summary: Identifies a specific permission capability that a sandboxed script container may grant or restrict.

items.name: RunClientScript
items.summary: Indicates that a script container is permitted to execute scripts on the client (LocalScript).

items.name: RunServerScript
items.summary: Indicates that a script container is permitted to execute scripts on the server (Script).

items.name: AccessOutsideWrite
items.summary: Grants a script read-write access to instances that live outside its sandboxed container.

items.name: AssetRequire
items.summary: Deprecated.

items.name: LoadString
items.summary: Allows a script to use the `loadstring()` Luau built-in to compile and execute a string as code.

items.name: ScriptGlobals
items.summary: Allows a script to access the `shared` and `_G` shared global variable tables.

items.name: CreateInstances
items.summary: Allows a script to create new `Instance` objects using `Instance.new()`.

items.name: Basic
items.summary: Guards access to a broad set of general-purpose engine APIs that do not belong to a more specific capability category.

items.name: Audio
items.summary: Guards access to audio engine APIs such as Sound, AudioPlayer, and related classes.

items.name: DataStore
items.summary: Guards access to data store APIs such as DataStoreService and its associated objects.

items.name: Network
items.summary: Guards access to low-level networking APIs such as HttpService.

items.name: Physics
items.summary: Guards access to physics engine APIs such as Constraint classes and BasePart physics properties.

items.name: UI
items.summary: Guards access to UI engine APIs such as ScreenGui, Frame, and other GuiObject classes.

items.name: CSG
items.summary: Guards access to Constructive Solid Geometry (CSG) APIs such as UnionOperation and NegateOperation.

items.name: Chat
items.summary: Guards access to chat engine APIs such as TextChatService and related chat classes.

items.name: Animation
items.summary: Guards access to animation engine APIs such as AnimationController and related classes.

items.name: Avatar
items.summary: Deprecated.

items.name: Input
items.summary: Guards access to user input APIs such as UserInputService and ContextActionService.

items.name: Environment
items.summary: Guards access to environment and world-setting APIs such as Lighting and Atmosphere.

items.name: RemoteEvent
items.summary: Guards access to remote event and function APIs such as RemoteEvent and RemoteFunction.

items.name: LegacySound
items.summary: Guards access to the legacy Sound and pre-VoiceChatService.UseAudioApi sound stack APIs.

items.name: Players
items.summary: Guards access to Players service APIs that query or manage connected players.

items.name: CapabilityControl
items.summary: Guards access to the `Instance.Capabilities` and `Instance.Sandboxed` properties that configure script sandboxing.

items.name: Plugin
items.summary: Mirrors the legacy `Plugin` permission level, granting access to Studio plugin APIs.

items.name: LocalUser
items.summary: Mirrors the legacy `LocalUser` permission level, granting access to IDE-only and Studio-level APIs.

items.name: WritePlayer
items.summary: Mirrors the legacy `WritePlayer` permission level, granting the ability to modify player identity properties such as name and `UserId`.

items.name: RobloxScript
items.summary: Mirrors the legacy `RobloxScript` permission level, granting access to `CoreScript` APIs.

items.name: RobloxEngine
items.summary: Mirrors the legacy `RobloxEngine` permission level, granting access to internal engine-level APIs.

items.name: Unassigned
items.summary: The default capability assigned to API members that have not been explicitly assigned to any other capability category.

items.name: InternalTest
items.summary: Restricts access to non-sensitive APIs that are intentionally kept internal.

items.name: PluginOrOpenCloud
items.summary: Restricts access to APIs callable only from Studio plugin or Open Cloud Luau execution sessions.

items.name: Assistant
items.summary: Restricts access to APIs that may only be called from Studio Assistant execution contexts.

items.name: RemoteCommand
items.summary: Restricts access to APIs that are executable only from Studio's `RemoteCommandService` in Team Create sessions.

items.name: AssetRead
items.summary: Guards access to APIs that read or query asset metadata from the Roblox catalog.

items.name: AssetManagement
items.summary: Guards access to asset management APIs such as ContentProvider:PreloadAsync() and encryption-key registration.

items.name: DynamicGeneration
items.summary: Guards access to procedural and AI-driven content generation APIs such as EditableMesh and AvatarCreationService.

items.name: PlatformAvatarEditing
items.summary: Guards access to platform-level avatar editing APIs provided by AvatarEditorService.

items.name: AssetCreateUpdate
items.summary: Guards access to APIs that create or update published Roblox assets.

items.name: Capture
items.summary: Guards access to CaptureService APIs that take screenshots and record video.

items.name: SensitiveInput
items.summary: Guards access to sensitive user input APIs such as those that can read raw keyboard or mouse data beyond normal game input.

items.name: Monetization
items.summary: Guards access to in-experience purchase and monetization APIs such as MarketplaceService.

items.name: LoadOwnedAsset
items.summary: Allows a script to load assets that are owned by the experience's creator using InsertService or LuaGlobals.require().

items.name: Social
items.summary: Guards access to social APIs such as SocialService, FriendPages, and ExperienceInviteOptions.

items.name: ServerCommunication
items.summary: Guards access to server-to-server messaging APIs such as MessagingService.

items.name: Logging
items.summary: Guards access to LogService and logging-related APIs.

items.name: PromptExternalPurchase
items.summary: Guards access to APIs that initiate external (non-Roblox) purchase prompts.

items.name: Groups
items.summary: Guards access to group-related APIs such as GroupService.

items.name: Teleport
items.summary: Guards access to teleportation APIs such as TeleportService, TeleportOptions, and TeleportAsyncResult.

items.name: Consequences
items.summary: Guards access to moderation and player-consequence APIs such as Players:BanAsync() and ModerationService.

items.name: Material
items.summary: Guards access to MaterialService, MaterialVariant, and custom material APIs.

items.name: AvatarBehavior
items.summary: Guards access to APIs that control avatar locomotion and behavior at runtime.

items.name: AvatarAppearance
items.summary: Guards access to APIs that read or modify avatar appearance, such as HumanoidDescription.

items.name: LoadUnownedAsset
items.summary: Allows a script to LuaGlobals.require() asset IDs or call InsertService:LoadAsset() for assets not owned by the creator.

SelectionBehavior.summary: Customization options for gamepad selection when GuiBase2d.SelectionGroup is true.

items.name: Escape
items.summary: Prioritizes GuiObjects within the same SelectionGroup but allows the selection to move to other outside GuiObjects if no suitable button is found.

items.name: Stop
items.summary: Constrains gamepad selection to the SelectionGroup.

SelectionRenderMode.summary: Controls how selected objects are highlighted in Roblox Studio.

items.name: Outlines
items.summary: Renders selected objects using an outline drawn along each object's edges.

items.name: BoundingBoxes
items.summary: Renders selected objects using a bounding box drawn around each object's extents.

items.name: Both
items.summary: Renders selected objects with both outlines and bounding boxes simultaneously.

SelfViewPosition.summary: Defines the screen location of the current player's self view.

items.name: LastPosition
items.summary: The position of the self view when it was last closed.

items.name: TopLeft
items.summary: Top-left corner of the screen, with slight padding from the top and left edges.

items.name: TopRight
items.summary: Top-right corner of the screen, with slight padding from the top and right edges.

items.name: BottomLeft
items.summary: Bottom-left corner of the screen, with slight padding from the bottom and left edges.

items.name: BottomRight
items.summary: Bottom-right corner of the screen, with slight padding from the bottom and right edges.

SensorMode.summary: Specifies whether a ControllerPartSensor targets floor or ladder geometry, and which detection algorithm to use.

items.name: Floor
items.summary: Detects floor surfaces below the part using the modern detection algorithm; the default value of ControllerPartSensor.SensorMode.

items.name: Ladder
items.summary: Detects ladder surfaces adjacent to the part using the modern piercing-based detection algorithm.

items.name: ClassicFloor
items.summary: Detects floor surfaces below the part using the legacy raycast-based algorithm.

items.name: ClassicLadder
items.summary: Detects ladder surfaces adjacent to the part using the legacy ladder detection algorithm.

SensorUpdateType.summary: Controls when a sensor recalculates its output properties.

items.name: OnRead
items.summary: The sensor lazily recalculates its output the next time an output property is read and the output is marked dirty.

items.name: Manual
items.summary: The sensor never automatically recalculates its output; scripts are responsible for driving output updates.

ServiceVisibility.summary: Controls when a service is displayed in the Explorer window in Roblox Studio.

items.name: Always
items.summary: The service is always visible in the Explorer window.

items.name: Off
items.summary: The service is hidden from the Explorer window by default, but can still be added via the Insert Service menu.

items.name: WithChildren
items.summary: The service is visible in the Explorer window only when it has children; it can still be added via the Insert Service menu.

Severity.summary: Classifies the severity level of a Luau LSP diagnostic reported by a Script Analysis callback.

items.name: Error
items.summary: Reports a critical error that indicates a definite problem in the script.

items.name: Warning
items.summary: Reports a potential problem that can cause incorrect behavior but does not prevent the script from running.

items.name: Information
items.summary: Conveys informational context about the script without indicating a problem.

items.name: Hint
items.summary: Provides a subtle suggestion, such as a style improvement or an unused-variable notice.

ShowAdResult.summary: Result codes returned by AdService:ShowRewardedVideoAdAsync() indicating whether a rewarded video ad completed successfully or why it did not.

items.name: ShowCompleted
items.summary: The ad was successfully shown to completion.

items.name: AdNotReady
items.summary: You are trying to show a full-screen ad before the ad has fully loaded.

items.name: AdAlreadyShowing
items.summary: You are trying to show a full-screen ad while another full-screen ad is already playing.

items.name: InternalError
items.summary: An unspecified internal error occurred.

items.name: ShowInterrupted
items.summary: The ad view of the user has been interrupted.

items.name: InsufficientMemory
items.summary: The device does not have sufficient video memory available to display the ad.

SignalBehavior.summary: Determines when the engine resumes event handlers.

items.name: Default
items.summary: The default behavior; currently equivalent to `Immediate` but this will eventually change to `Deferred`.

items.name: Immediate
items.summary: Event handlers are resumed immediately when the event occurs.

items.name: Deferred
items.summary: All events are deferred and their handlers resumed at specific resumptions points each frame.

items.name: AncestryDeferred
items.summary: Equivalent to `Deferred` but only for events triggered by changes in ancestry.

SizeConstraint.summary: Used to constrain the scale of a GUI object.

items.name: RelativeXY
items.summary: The scale of X and Y are independent.

items.name: RelativeXX
items.summary: The scale of X is shared with Y.

items.name: RelativeYY
items.summary: The scale of Y is shared with X.

SlimTintMode.summary: Determines the color-coding mode used by the SLIM debug tint overlay in the Developer Console.

items.name: None
items.summary: No tint is applied.

items.name: LevelOfDetail
items.summary: Colors each mesh by its current level of detail.

items.name: DataModelState
items.summary: Colors SLIM models by whether their DataModel instances are streamed in or out.

items.name: TranscoderStatus
items.summary: Colors each SLIM model by its SlimTranscoderStatus.

SlimTranscoderStatus.summary: Describes the backend transcoding state of a SLIM model, from upload through transcoding to success or failure.

items.name: Unknown
items.summary: The transcoding status has not yet been determined.

items.name: Transcoding
items.summary: SLIM transcoding is currently in progress on the backend.

items.name: Succeeded
items.summary: Transcoding completed successfully and the SLIM assets are available for streaming.

items.name: Failed
items.summary: Transcoding did not complete successfully.

SolverConvergenceMetricType.summary: Specifies the metric used to identify the least-converged constraint when visualizing physics solver convergence.

items.name: IterationBased
items.summary: Identifies the least-converged constraint using the estimated force change from an additional, non-applied solver iteration.

items.name: AlgorithmAgnostic
items.summary: Identifies the least-converged constraint using a residual-based convergence metric supported across solver algorithms.

SolverConvergenceVisualizationMode.summary: Controls whether and at what granularity the physics solver's convergence quality is overlaid as a debug visualization in Studio.

items.name: Disabled
items.summary: No solver convergence visualization is rendered; the default state.

items.name: PerIsland
items.summary: Renders a single convergence metric label at the center of each simulation island displaying the velocity-stage and position-stage maxima, which may come from different constraints.

items.name: PerEdge
items.summary: Renders convergence metrics as text labels on each aggregated body-pair edge between assembly root bodies.

SortDirection.summary: Controls whether results are ordered from lowest to highest or from highest to lowest.

items.name: Ascending
items.summary: Orders results from lowest to highest value, or from oldest to newest entry.

items.name: Descending
items.summary: Orders results from highest to lowest value, or from newest to oldest entry.

SortOrder.summary: Used by UIGridStyleLayout.SortOrder to order the elements in the layout.

items.name: Name
items.summary: Elements are ordered by their Instance.Name in alphanumeric order.

items.name: Custom
items.summary: Elements are ordered by the function passed to UIGridStyleLayout:SetCustomSortFunction().

items.name: LayoutOrder
items.summary: Elements are ordered by GuiObject.LayoutOrder in ascending order; for example `0` will be placed before `1`.

StartCorner.summary: Used by UIGridLayout.StartCorner to decide where the first element is placed.

items.name: TopLeft
items.summary: Grid starts in top left corner.

items.name: TopRight
items.summary: Grid starts in top right corner.

items.name: BottomLeft
items.summary: Grid starts in bottom left corner.

items.name: BottomRight
items.summary: Grid starts in bottom right corner.

StateObjectFieldType.summary: Identifies the data type of a field in a deprecated `StateObject`; all values are deprecated and the enum is retained only for backward compatibility.

items.name: Boolean
items.summary: A boolean field.

items.name: CFrame
items.summary: A CFrame field.

items.name: Color3
items.summary: A Color3 field.

items.name: Float
items.summary: A floating-point number field.

items.name: Instance
items.summary: An Instance reference field.

items.name: Random
items.summary: A Random field.

items.name: Vector2
items.summary: A Vector2 field.

items.name: Vector3
items.summary: A Vector3 field.

items.name: INVALID
items.summary: An invalid or unrecognized field type.

Status.summary: This enum was used with the unfinished Status library.

StepFrequency.summary: Enum used with RunService:BindToSimulation() to indicate the frequency at which the bound function is called.

items.name: Hz60
items.summary: The bound function is called at 60 Hz.

items.name: Hz30
items.summary: The bound function is called at 30 Hz.

items.name: Hz15
items.summary: The bound function is called at 15 Hz.

items.name: Hz10
items.summary: The bound function is called at 10 Hz.

items.name: Hz5
items.summary: The bound function is called at 5 Hz.

items.name: Hz1
items.summary: The bound function is called at 1 Hz.

StreamOutBehavior.summary: Determines how content is streamed out from Player clients.

items.name: Default
items.summary: Default behavior (subject to change).

items.name: LowMemory
items.summary: Only stream out when memory is low.

items.name: Opportunistic
items.summary: Stream out content that is significantly outside of the current Workspace.StreamingTargetRadius.

StreamingIntegrityMode.summary: Determines how a user's client should handle not having enough content streamed in.

items.name: Default
items.summary: Default behavior (subject to change).

items.name: Disabled
items.summary: Simulation of the replication focus is never paused, regardless of the amount of content streamed in on the client.

items.name: MinimumRadiusPause
items.summary: All client-side simulation is paused when content is not streamed in up to the minimum radius.

items.name: PauseOutsideLoadedArea
items.summary: Simulation of the replication focus is paused when any part of its bounding box is not in a streamed-in area.

StreamingPauseMode.summary: Determines how a client should handle not having enough content streamed in to continue playing properly.

items.name: Default
items.summary: Default behavior (subject to change).

items.name: Disabled
items.summary: No change to gameplay due to streaming region availability.

items.name: ClientPhysicsPause
items.summary: Client owned physics is paused.

StrokeSizingMode.summary: Used by UIStroke.StrokeSizingMode to determine whether the stroke's UIStroke.Thickness will be measured in pixels or be relative to the parent.

items.name: FixedSize
items.summary: UIStroke.Thickness is measured in pixels.

items.name: ScaledSize
items.summary: UIStroke.Thickness is relative to minimum parent width or height.

StudioCaptureScreenshotFormat.summary: Specifies the pixel format of the image buffer stored in a StudioScreenshotCapture object.

items.name: RGBA8
items.summary: The buffer contains raw, uncompressed RGBA pixel data with 8 bits per channel (4 bytes per pixel).

items.name: PNG
items.summary: The buffer contains a complete PNG-encoded image.

StudioPlaceUpdateFailureReason.summary: Describes why a place publish or update operation failed in Roblox Studio.

items.name: Other
items.summary: The place publish or update failed for an unspecified or generic reason.

items.name: TeamCreateConflict
items.summary: The place publish failed because a Team Create server currently holds a lock on the place.

StudioScriptEditorColorCategories.summary: Color categories used to theme the Script Editor in Roblox Studio.

items.name: Default
items.summary: Fallback foreground color used for script text that does not match any more specific syntax category.

items.name: Operator
items.summary: Color applied to operator tokens such as `+`, `-`, `*`, `/`, `==`, and `..` in scripts.

items.name: Number
items.summary: Color applied to numeric literal tokens in scripts.

items.name: String
items.summary: Color applied to string literal tokens, including quoted strings and long-string literals.

items.name: Comment
items.summary: Color applied to comment tokens (single-line `--` and block `--[[ ]]` comments) in scripts.

items.name: Keyword
items.summary: Color applied to Luau reserved keywords such as `if`, `then`, `else`, `do`, `end`, `return`, and `while`.

items.name: Builtin
items.summary: Color applied to Luau built-in functions and standard library identifiers in scripts.

items.name: Method
items.summary: Color applied to method call identifiers in scripts.

items.name: Property
items.summary: Color applied to property access identifiers (tokens following a `.` operator) in scripts.

items.name: Nil
items.summary: Color applied to the `nil` literal token in scripts.

items.name: Bool
items.summary: Foreground color used to highlight boolean literals (`true` and `false`) in scripts.

items.name: Function
items.summary: Color applied to the `function` keyword token in function declarations.

items.name: Local
items.summary: Color applied to the `local` keyword token in local variable and function declarations.

items.name: Self
items.summary: Color applied to the `self` identifier token in method bodies.

items.name: LuauKeyword
items.summary: Color applied to Luau-specific type annotation keywords such as `type` and `typeof`.

items.name: FunctionName
items.summary: Color applied to the identifier that names a function in its declaration.

items.name: TODO
items.summary: Color applied to `TODO` markers found inside comments in scripts.

items.name: Background
items.summary: Main background color of the Script Editor canvas.

items.name: SelectionText
items.summary: Foreground color for text within the currently selected range in the Script Editor.

items.name: SelectionBackground
items.summary: Background highlight color for the currently selected text range in the Script Editor.

items.name: FindSelectionBackground
items.summary: Background highlight color applied to text ranges matched by a Find or Replace operation.

items.name: MatchingWordBackground
items.summary: Background highlight color applied to all occurrences of the word under the cursor when word-highlight is active.

items.name: Warning
items.summary: Color used for warning-severity diagnostic markers and underlines in scripts.

items.name: Error
items.summary: Color used for error-severity diagnostic markers and underlines in scripts.

items.name: Info
items.summary: Color used for information-severity diagnostic markers in scripts.

items.name: Hint
items.summary: Color used for hint-severity diagnostic markers in scripts.

items.name: Whitespace
items.summary: Color used to render visible whitespace characters (spaces and tabs) when that display option is enabled.

items.name: ActiveLine
items.summary: Background highlight color applied to the line that currently contains the text cursor.

items.name: DebuggerCurrentLine
items.summary: Background highlight color for the line the debugger is currently paused on.

items.name: DebuggerErrorLine
items.summary: Background highlight color for a line that caused a runtime error during a debugging session.

items.name: Ruler
items.summary: Color of the vertical column ruler line drawn at the configured character-width limit in the Script Editor.

items.name: Bracket
items.summary: Color applied to bracket characters such as `(`, `)`, `[`, `]`, `{`, and `}` in scripts.

items.name: Type
items.summary: Color applied to Luau type name tokens in type annotations and declarations.

items.name: MenuPrimaryText
items.summary: Primary text color for items listed in autocomplete and context-menu popups.

items.name: MenuSecondaryText
items.summary: Secondary text color (for example, type annotations or documentation hints) in autocomplete popups.

items.name: MenuSelectedText
items.summary: Text color of the currently highlighted item in autocomplete and context-menu popups.

items.name: MenuBackground
items.summary: Background color for autocomplete and context-menu popups in the Script Editor.

items.name: MenuSelectedBackground
items.summary: Background color of the currently highlighted item in autocomplete and context-menu popups.

items.name: MenuScrollbarBackground
items.summary: Background color of the scrollbar track inside autocomplete and context-menu popups.

items.name: MenuScrollbarHandle
items.summary: Color of the scrollbar thumb (handle) inside autocomplete and context-menu popups.

items.name: MenuBorder
items.summary: Border color for autocomplete and context-menu popups in the Script Editor.

items.name: DocViewCodeBackground
items.summary: Background color for inline code blocks rendered in the documentation viewer panel within Studio.

items.name: AICOOverlayText
items.summary: Text color for labels displayed in the AI Code Overlay panel.

items.name: AICOOverlayButtonBackground
items.summary: Background color for AI Code Overlay action buttons in their default (idle) state.

items.name: AICOOverlayButtonBackgroundHover
items.summary: Background color for AI Code Overlay action buttons when the pointer hovers over them.

items.name: AICOOverlayButtonBackgroundPressed
items.summary: Background color for AI Code Overlay action buttons while they are being pressed.

items.name: IndentationRuler
items.summary: Color of the vertical guide lines drawn at each indentation level in the script editor gutter.

StudioScriptEditorColorPresets.summary: Specifies a script editor syntax-color preset in Roblox Studio.

items.name: RobloxDefault
items.summary: Uses Roblox Studio's default script editor colors.

items.name: Extra1
items.summary: Uses the first alternate script editor color preset.

items.name: Extra2
items.summary: Uses the second alternate script editor color preset.

items.name: Custom
items.summary: Uses the creator's custom script editor colors.

StudioStyleGuideColor.summary: An enum that lists color roles used by Studio themes, passed to StudioTheme:GetColor() to retrieve the correct theme color for a given UI element in a plugin.

items.name: MainBackground
items.summary: The primary background color used by the toolbar and windows.

items.name: Titlebar
items.summary: The color of windows' title bars.

items.name: Dropdown
items.summary: The color of dropdown menus, like those found in the Properties window.

items.name: Tooltip
items.summary: The background color of tooltips, like those seen when hovering over buttons on the toolbar or properties in the Properties window.

items.name: Notification
items.summary: The background color of message box and dialog notification panels.

items.name: ScrollBar
items.summary: The color of scrollbar handles, like those seen in the Explorer window.

items.name: ScrollBarBackground
items.summary: The background color of scrollbars, like those seen in the Explorer window.

items.name: TabBar
items.summary: The background color of the tab bar, like the one where the script editor is opened.

items.name: Tab
items.summary: The color of tabs on the tab bar, like the ones opened when the script editor is opened.

items.name: FilterButtonDefault
items.summary: The default background color of filter buttons in the Script Analysis widget.

items.name: FilterButtonHover
items.summary: The background color of filter buttons in the Script Analysis widget when hovered.

items.name: FilterButtonChecked
items.summary: The background color of filter buttons in the Script Analysis widget when they are in a checked (active) state.

items.name: FilterButtonAccent
items.summary: The accent color drawn on the top and left edges of filter buttons in the Script Analysis widget.

items.name: FilterButtonBorder
items.summary: The border color of filter buttons in the Script Analysis widget.

items.name: FilterButtonBorderAlt
items.summary: The border color of filter buttons in the Script Analysis widget when they are hovered or checked.

items.name: RibbonTab
items.summary: The color of a tab on the toolbar menu.

items.name: RibbonTabTopBar
items.summary: The background color of the toolbar.

items.name: Button
items.summary: The background color of clickable buttons.

items.name: MainButton
items.summary: The background color of clickable buttons that are the primary action.

items.name: RibbonButton
items.summary: The background color of buttons on the toolbar.

items.name: ViewPortBackground
items.summary: The background color of the game viewport.

items.name: InputFieldBackground
items.summary: The background color of input fields, like those found in the Explorer window.

items.name: Item
items.summary: The background color of items listed in the Explorer and Properties windows.

items.name: TableItem
items.summary: The background color of row items in table views such as the Game Settings window.

items.name: CategoryItem
items.summary: The background color of category header items in the Properties widget.

items.name: GameSettingsTableItem
items.summary: The color of items within tables in the settings window.

items.name: GameSettingsTooltip
items.summary: The color of tooltips in the settings window.

items.name: EmulatorBar
items.summary: The color of the bar shown when the mobile emulator is active.

items.name: EmulatorDropDown
items.summary: The color of the device and physical size dropdowns in the emulator bar.

items.name: ColorPickerFrame
items.summary: The background color of the color picker.

items.name: CurrentMarker
items.summary: The color of the current-item marker, such as the blue selection indicator in the logout menu in the Light theme.

items.name: Border
items.summary: The color of borders, like those found in the Properties window.

items.name: DropShadow
items.summary: The color used for drop-shadow decorations on floating panels and menus.

items.name: Shadow
items.summary: The color of shadows rendered under floating items like dropdowns.

items.name: Light
items.summary: The light role color from the Qt widget palette, used for the lightest shading of 3D widget effects.

items.name: Dark
items.summary: The dark role color from the Qt widget palette, used for the darkest shading of 3D widget effects.

items.name: Mid
items.summary: The mid role color from the Qt widget palette, used between the button and dark shading for 3D widget effects.

items.name: MainText
items.summary: The primary text color used throughout Studio's UI.

items.name: SubText
items.summary: The color of secondary text such as status labels shown in the Team Create widget for offline users and place owners.

items.name: TitlebarText
items.summary: The text color displayed in dock widget title bars and Ribbon tabs.

items.name: BrightText
items.summary: The color of text displayed inside input fields and other high-contrast contexts.

items.name: DimmedText
items.summary: The color of placeholder or dimmed text shown in empty input fields.

items.name: LinkText
items.summary: The color of hyperlink text in Studio panels and documentation views.

items.name: WarningText
items.summary: The color of warning messages, such as those displayed in the Output window.

items.name: ErrorText
items.summary: The color of error messages, such as those displayed in the Output window.

items.name: InfoText
items.summary: The color of informational messages, such as those displayed in the Output window.

items.name: SensitiveText
items.summary: The color used to display sensitive information text, such as certain messages in the Output window.

items.name: ScriptSideWidget
items.summary: The background color of the Script Editor's side gutter, which displays fold icons and breakpoint markers.

items.name: ScriptBackground
items.summary: The background color of the Script Editor canvas.

items.name: ScriptText
items.summary: The default text color for unclassified tokens in the Script Editor.

items.name: ScriptSelectionText
items.summary: The foreground text color of the active text selection in the Script Editor.

items.name: ScriptSelectionBackground
items.summary: The background color of the active text selection in the Script Editor.

items.name: ScriptFindSelectionBackground
items.summary: The background color of text matched by the current find query in the Script Editor.

items.name: ScriptMatchingWordSelectionBackground
items.summary: The background color of all occurrences of the word under the cursor highlighted as matching selections in the Script Editor.

items.name: ScriptOperator
items.summary: The color of operator symbols in the Script Editor.

items.name: ScriptNumber
items.summary: The color of numeric literals in the Script Editor.

items.name: ScriptString
items.summary: The color of string literals in the Script Editor.

items.name: ScriptComment
items.summary: The color of comment text in the Script Editor.

items.name: ScriptKeyword
items.summary: The color of Lua reserved keywords that don't have a more specific color role in the Script Editor.

items.name: ScriptBuiltInFunction
items.summary: The color of recognized built-in global identifiers in the Script Editor, including non-function globals.

items.name: ScriptWarning
items.summary: The color of warning markers and underlines in the Script Editor.

items.name: ScriptError
items.summary: The color of error markers and underlines in the Script Editor.

items.name: ScriptInformation

TeleportMethod.summary: Identifies which TeleportService API method initiated a teleport.

items.name: TeleportToPlaceInstance

items.summary: Teleport was initiated by TeleportService:TeleportToPrivateServer(), which sends players to a reserved server using an access code.

items.name: TeleportToVIPServer

items.name: TeleportToInstanceBack
items.summary: Teleport was initiated by back-navigation, returning a player to a specific prior place instance.

items.name: TeleportUnknown

TeleportResult.summary: Describes the result of a teleport.

TextureMode.summary: Describes how the texture of a Trail or Beam behaves.

TrackerError.summary: Status and error codes reported by the face-tracking subsystem through the `TrackerError` events on `RTAnimationTracker` and `FaceAnimatorService`.

items.summary: No error; the tracker is operating normally.

items.name: NoService
items.summary: A required engine service was unavailable when the tracker attempted to connect.

items.name: InitFailed
items.summary: The tracker failed to create or initialize its tracking session.

items.name: NoVideo
items.summary: Video input is unavailable because no camera device was found or the camera was disconnected.

items.summary: A generic video error occurred during face-tracking camera input processing.

items.name: VideoNoPermission
items.summary: The user denied camera permission required for video-based face tracking.

items.name: VideoUnsupported
items.summary: Video-based face tracking is not supported on this device or platform.

items.name: NoAudio

TrackerExtrapolationFlagMode.summary: Controls how the face-tracking pipeline extrapolates animation data between camera frames on the `TrackerLodController`.

items.name: ExtrapolateFacsAndPose
items.summary: Extrapolates both FACS blend-shape values and head-pose data between camera frames.

items.name: ExtrapolateFacsOnly
items.summary: Extrapolates only FACS blend-shape values between camera frames, leaving head-pose data unchanged.

items.name: Auto
items.summary: Lets the `TrackerLodController` automatically select the extrapolation strategy based on current performance conditions.
