items.name: FaceTrackingNoFaceFound
items.summary: The tracker is running but no face has been detected in the camera feed.

items.name: FaceTrackingUnknown
items.summary: The face tracking state is indeterminate or could not be mapped to a known status.

items.name: FaceTrackingLost
items.summary: Face tracking was previously active but the face has been lost from the camera feed.

items.name: FaceTrackingHasTrackingError
items.summary: Face tracking is active but has encountered an error that prevents reliable pose estimation.

items.name: FaceTrackingIsOccluded
items.summary: A face is detected but is partially or fully occluded, reducing tracking reliability.

items.name: FaceTrackingUninitialized
items.summary: Face tracking has not yet been initialized; this is the default state before the tracker starts.

TrackerLodFlagMode.summary: Controls whether a real-time face-tracker feature (audio or video) is forced on, forced off, or left to the automatic LOD system.

items.name: ForceFalse
items.summary: Forces the associated tracker feature disabled, regardless of the current LOD state.

items.name: ForceTrue
items.summary: Forces the associated tracker feature enabled, regardless of the current LOD state.

items.name: Auto
items.summary: Defers the enabled/disabled decision to the automatic LOD system.

TrackerLodValueMode.summary: Controls how the video LOD level is selected for the face-tracking pipeline in `TrackerLodController`.

items.name: Force0
items.summary: Forces the face-tracking video pipeline to LOD level 0, the faster but less accurate processing mode.

items.name: Force1
items.summary: Forces the face-tracking video pipeline to LOD level 1, the more accurate but more resource-intensive processing mode.

items.name: Auto
items.summary: The LOD controller selects the video LOD level automatically based on real-time performance metrics.

TrackerMode.summary: Describes the combination of input sources an `RTAnimationTracker` is currently using to drive animation.

items.name: None
items.summary: No tracking inference is active; the tracker is idle or has not successfully started.

items.name: Audio
items.summary: Only audio-to-curve (lipsync) inference is active; no camera-based facial tracking is running.

items.name: Video
items.summary: Only video-to-curve facial tracking is active; audio-based lipsync inference is not running.

items.name: AudioVideo
items.summary: Both audio-to-curve lipsync inference and video-to-curve facial tracking are active simultaneously.

TrackerPromptEvent.summary: Indicates the type of prompt fired by the face tracker when a runtime condition requires user attention.

items.name: LODCameraRecommendDisable
items.summary: The LOD controller has determined that device performance is insufficient to sustain camera-based face tracking and recommends disabling camera input.

TrackerType.summary: Specifies the type of motion tracking that an `RTAnimationTracker` performs.

items.name: None
items.summary: No tracking type is selected; the tracking engine does not initialize, and attempting to start tracking with this type set raises `TrackerError.UnsupportedDevice`.

items.name: Face
items.summary: Enables face tracking from a connected video device (and optionally audio) to produce FACS blendshape weights and head-orientation data each step.

items.name: UpperBody
items.summary: Reserved for upper-body motion tracking.

TriStateBoolean.summary: A three-state boolean enumeration used by PolicyService to represent a value that is explicitly `True`, explicitly `False`, or not yet resolved (`Unknown`).

items.name: Unknown
items.summary: Indicates the condition has not yet been determined or resolved; the default value.

items.name: True
items.summary: Indicates the condition is explicitly true.

items.name: False
items.summary: Indicates the condition is explicitly false.

TweenStatus.summary: The completion status of a GuiObject tween function.

items.name: Canceled
items.summary: The tween was cancelled before completion.

items.name: Completed
items.summary: The Tween has successfully completed.

UICaptureMode.summary: Used to determine what UI elements should be captured with CaptureService.

items.name: All
items.summary: Capture all UI elements.

items.name: None
items.summary: Capture no UI elements.

UIDragDetectorBoundingBehavior.summary: Used with UIDragDetector to determine bounding behavior of the dragged UI object when UIDragDetector.BoundingUI is set.

items.name: Automatic
items.summary: Mimics **EntireObject** behavior for a UI object that's entirely contained by the UIDragDetector.BoundingUI, or else **HitPoint** for a UI object that's partially outside the UIDragDetector.BoundingUI.

items.name: EntireObject
items.summary: Bounds the entire dragged UI object within the UIDragDetector.BoundingUI.

items.name: HitPoint
items.summary: Bounds the dragged UI only by the exact hit/grab point and its respective position after translation/rotation.

UIDragDetectorDragRelativity.summary: Used with DragDetector to set the paradigm which defines the relativity of inputs/outputs from a custom drag function.

items.name: Absolute
items.summary: Designates the input and return values as the absolute target position/rotation in the space defined by UIDragDetector.DragSpace.

items.name: Relative
items.summary: Designates the input and return values as the change from the current position/rotation in the space defined by UIDragDetector.DragSpace.

UIDragDetectorDragSpace.summary: Used with DragDetector to set the paradigm which defines the space of inputs/outputs from a custom drag function.

items.name: Parent
items.summary: Designates the input and return values' space as the local space of the detector's parent GuiObject.

items.name: LayerCollector
items.summary: Designates the input and return values' space as that of the LayerCollector.

items.name: Reference
items.summary: Designates the input and return values' space as that of the UIDragDetector.ReferenceUIInstance.

UIDragDetectorDragStyle.summary: Used with UIDragDetector as the paradigm to generate proposed motion, given a stream of input position vectors.

items.name: TranslatePlane
items.summary: 2D motion in the plane of the LayerCollector.

items.name: TranslateLine
items.summary: 1D motion along the detector's UIDragDetector.DragAxis.

items.name: Rotate
items.summary: By default, rotation about the absolute center position of the detector's parent GuiObject.

items.name: Scriptable
items.summary: Calculates desired motion via a custom function provided through UIDragDetector:SetDragStyleFunction().

UIDragDetectorResponseStyle.summary: Describes how the clicked GuiObject will be treated once the desired motion has been calculated.

items.name: Offset
items.summary: Move by the UDim.Offset values of the detector's parent's GuiObject.Position value.

items.name: Scale
items.summary: Move by the UDim.Scale values of the detector's parent's GuiObject.Position value.

items.name: CustomOffset
items.summary: The UI element will not move at all, but the UDim.Offset values of the detector's UIDragDetector.DragUDim2 will still be updated and the detector's events will still fire, allowing you to respond to drag manipulation however you'd like.

items.name: CustomScale
items.summary: The UI element will not move at all, but the UDim.Scale values of the detector's UIDragDetector.DragUDim2 will still be updated and the detector's events will still fire, allowing you to respond to drag manipulation however you'd like.

UIDragSpeedAxisMapping.summary: Used with UIDragDetector.UIDragSpeedAxisMapping to determine the **X**/**Y** dimension dragging speeds.

items.name: XY
items.summary: Default setting for a detector's UIDragDetector.UIDragSpeedAxisMapping where the **X** and **Y** axis speeds are based off the **X** and **Y** UDim.Scale/UDim.Offset values respectively.

items.name: XX
items.summary: Both the **X** and **Y** axis speeds are based off the **X** axis for UDim.Scale, while the UDim.Offset values still apply to their respective axis.

items.name: YY
items.summary: Both the **X** and **Y** axis speeds are based off the **Y** axis for UDim.Scale, while the UDim.Offset values still apply to their respective axis.

UIFlexAlignment.summary: In a UIListLayout flex layout, specifies how to distribute extra space in the parent container.

items.name: None
items.summary: No flex behavior; siblings maintain their defined width or height.

items.name: Fill
items.summary: Siblings resize to fill the entire parent container, overriding their defined width or height.

items.name: SpaceAround
items.summary: Siblings maintain their defined width or height.

items.name: SpaceBetween
items.summary: Siblings maintain their defined width or height.

items.name: SpaceEvenly
items.summary: Siblings maintain their defined width or height.

UIFlexMode.summary: Used with UIFlexItem.FlexMode to define how the parent GuiObject grows or shrinks.

items.name: None
items.summary: The parent GuiObject is unaffected and neither shrinks nor grows.

items.name: Grow
items.summary: Sets an effective `1:0` grow‑shrink ratio on the parent GuiObject.

items.name: Shrink
items.summary: Sets an effective `0:1` grow‑shrink ratio on the parent GuiObject.

items.name: Fill
items.summary: Sets an effective `1:1` grow‑shrink ratio on the parent GuiObject.

items.name: Custom
items.summary: Enables the UIFlexItem.GrowRatio and UIFlexItem.ShrinkRatio properties for the UIFlexItem, allowing for relative growth or shrinking of the parent GuiObject in a ratio compared to other flex objects also under control of a UIFlexItem.

UITheme.summary: Deprecated Studio UI color theme (`Light` or `Dark`).

items.name: Light
items.summary: The light Studio UI color theme.

items.name: Dark
items.summary: The dark Studio UI color theme.

UploadCaptureResult.summary: Describes the outcome of a CaptureService:UploadCaptureAsync() call.

items.name: Success
items.summary: The capture was successfully uploaded and registered as an asset.

items.name: NeedPermission
items.summary: The experience has not been granted developer gallery read and upload permission, so the capture cannot be uploaded.

items.name: CaptureModerated
items.summary: The capture was rejected by Roblox content moderation and cannot be uploaded.

items.name: CaptureNotInGallery
items.summary: The capture no longer exists in the user's gallery and cannot be uploaded.

items.name: IneligibleCapture
items.summary: The capture is not eligible for upload to this experience, either because it is a permanent system capture or the experience permissions grant was rejected.

items.name: UploadQuotaReached
items.summary: The user has reached their daily capture upload quota and the upload was not completed.

items.name: UploadPending
items.summary: The upload is still in progress and the asset has not yet been assigned an ID; poll CaptureService:CheckUploadCaptureStatusAsync() again to check for completion.

items.name: UploadFailed
items.summary: The upload completed but a backend processing error occurred, so the capture was not saved as an asset.

UserCFrame.summary: Determines what body part is being tracked by a VR device, and what its CFrame actually is.

items.name: Head
items.summary: The `CFrame` of the user's head.

items.name: LeftHand
items.summary: The `CFrame` of the user's left hand.

items.name: RightHand
items.summary: The `CFrame` of the user's right hand.

items.name: Floor
items.summary: The `CFrame` of the center of the floor.

UserInputState.summary: This enum describes the state of an input that is currently or was recently performed.

items.name: Begin
items.summary: Occurs when an InputObject starts to interact with the experience.

items.name: Change
items.summary: Occurs each frame an InputObject has already begun interacting with the experience and part of its state is changing.

items.name: End
items.summary: Occurs when an InputObject finishes interacting with the experience.

items.name: Cancel
items.summary: A special circumstance state that indicates this input is no longer relevant, particularly with ContextActionService.

items.name: None
items.summary: A state that should never be seen in an experience; essentially just marks the end of the enum.

UserInputType.summary: Describes the type of a user input event.

items.name: MouseButton1
items.summary: The left mouse button.

items.name: MouseButton2
items.summary: The right mouse button.

items.name: MouseButton3
items.summary: The middle mouse button.

items.name: MouseWheel
items.summary: The mouse wheel.

items.name: MouseMovement
items.summary: Movement of the mouse.

items.name: Touch
items.summary: A tap on the screen from a mobile device.

items.name: Keyboard
items.summary: Key press on a keyboard.

items.name: Focus
items.summary: The client regaining focus of the Roblox window.

items.name: Accelerometer
items.summary: The accelerometer of a mobile device.

items.name: Gyro
items.summary: The Gyroscope of a mobile device.

items.name: Gamepad1
items.summary: Input from the 1st plugged in Gamepad.

items.name: Gamepad2
items.summary: Input from the 2nd plugged in Gamepad.

items.name: Gamepad3
items.summary: Input from the 3rd plugged in Gamepad.

items.name: Gamepad4
items.summary: Input from the 4th plugged in Gamepad.

items.name: Gamepad5
items.summary: Input from the 5th plugged in Gamepad.

items.name: Gamepad6
items.summary: Input from the 6th plugged in Gamepad.

items.name: Gamepad7
items.summary: Input from the 7th plugged in Gamepad.

items.name: Gamepad8
items.summary: Input from the 8th plugged in Gamepad.

items.name: TextInput
items.summary: Input of Text into a text-based GuiObject.

items.name: InputMethod
items.summary: Text input from an input method editor (IME).

items.name: None
items.summary: Unknown UserInputType.

VRComfortSetting.summary: Named presets for VR comfort assists such as vignette, smooth rotation, and third-person follow camera.

items.name: Comfort
items.summary: Most restrictive comfort preset: enables vignette, disables smooth rotation, and disables the third-person follow camera.

items.name: Normal
items.summary: Default balanced preset: enables vignette and third-person follow camera while keeping smooth rotation disabled.

items.name: Expert
items.summary: Least restrictive comfort preset: disables vignette and enables both smooth rotation and the third-person follow camera.

items.name: Custom
items.summary: Lets vignette, smooth rotation, and third-person follow camera be configured independently rather than as a fixed preset.

VRControllerModelMode.summary: Controls whether and how the player's VR hand controller models are rendered in an experience.

items.name: Disabled
items.summary: The player's VR hand controller models are not rendered.

items.name: Transparent
items.summary: The player's VR hand controller models are rendered with transparency.

VRLaserPointerMode.summary: Specifies the display mode of the VR laser pointer used to interact with the user interface.

items.name: Disabled
items.summary: The laser pointer is hidden and no pointer is rendered for any VR hand.

items.name: Pointer
items.summary: A single laser pointer is shown for the primary VR hand; this is the default value of VRService.LaserPointer.

items.name: DualPointer
items.summary: A laser pointer is shown for each VR hand simultaneously.

VRScaling.summary: Controls whether VRService automatically adjusts the perceived scale of the world in VR to match the player's avatar size.

items.name: World
items.summary: Adjusts Camera.HeadScale so that the world in VR is seen from the avatar's perspective.

items.name: Off
items.summary: Disables VR automatic scaling; set Camera.HeadScale manually if needed.

VRSessionState.summary: The lifecycle state of the active VR session, as reported by the `VRSessionState` property of VRService.

items.name: Undefined
items.summary: The VR session state is unknown or has not yet been established; the default value of `VRSessionState`.

items.name: Idle
items.summary: The VR headset is connected and ready but is not yet presenting frames to the user.

items.name: Visible
items.summary: The VR session is rendering frames visible to the user but does not yet have XR input focus; haptic feedback is available.

items.name: Focused
items.summary: The VR session has full XR input focus and is rendering visible frames; haptic feedback is available.

items.name: Stopping
items.summary: The VR session is in the process of stopping and will transition to an inactive state.

VRTouchpad.summary: Used to universally identify a VR touchpad that is used by either the left, or right hand.

items.name: Left
items.summary: Left hand touchpad.

items.name: Right
items.summary: Right hand touchpad.

VRTouchpadMode.summary: Used to identify the behavior of a specified VR touchpad.

items.name: Touch
items.summary: The touchpad is treated as ButtonB if it is the left touchpad, or ButtonA if it is the right touchpad.

items.name: VirtualThumbstick
items.summary: The touchpad will function as a gamepad joystick.

items.name: ABXY
items.summary: The touchpad will function as a means of inputting the standard ABXY gamepad input, dividing it up into 4 diagonal pie slices.

VelocityConstraintMode.summary: The velocity constraint mode property controls how the linear velocity of the attachment(s) is constrained.

items.name: Line
items.summary: The velocity component in the direction of the line is constrained to the specified value.

items.name: Plane
items.summary: The velocity components in the plane are constrained to the specified values.

items.name: Vector
items.summary: The velocity components must be equal to the vector components specified.

VerifiedLevel.summary: Specifies the level of player verification required by Player:IsVerified().

items.name: Low
items.summary: Requires the player to meet the low verification level or higher.

items.name: High
items.summary: Requires the player to meet the high verification level.

VerticalAlignment.summary: Used by UIGridStyleLayout.VerticalAlignment to align the layout vertically within its parent.

items.name: Center
items.summary: Grid is aligned to the center of its parent along the **Y** axis.

items.name: Top
items.summary: Grid is aligned to the top edge of its parent.

items.name: Bottom
items.summary: Grid is aligned to the bottom edge of its parent.

VerticalScrollBarPosition.summary: This enum is used for ScrollingFrame.VerticalScrollBarPosition to indicate vertical scroll bar positioning.

items.name: Right
items.summary: Right side of the ScrollingFrame.

items.name: Left
items.summary: Left side of the ScrollingFrame.

VibrationMotor.summary: Describes various types of haptic motor sizes and locations.

items.name: Large
items.summary: Large motor.

items.name: Small
items.summary: Small motor.

items.name: LeftTrigger
items.summary: Left trigger motor.

items.name: RightTrigger
items.summary: Right trigger motor.

items.name: LeftHand
items.summary: Left hand motor for VR devices.

items.name: RightHand
items.summary: Right hand motor for VR devices.

VideoCaptureResult.summary: Indicates whether a video capture session ended successfully or the reason it was interrupted.

items.name: Success
items.summary: Video capture ended normally without any errors.

items.name: OtherError
items.summary: Video capture stopped due to an unspecified internal error.

items.name: ScreenSizeChanged
items.summary: Video capture was interrupted because the screen dimensions changed while recording was in progress.

items.name: TimeLimitReached
items.summary: Video capture was stopped automatically because the maximum allowed recording duration was reached.

VideoCaptureStartedResult.summary: Describes the outcome of a video capture start request made through CaptureService.

items.name: Success
items.summary: Video capture started successfully.

items.name: OtherError
items.summary: Video capture failed due to an unspecified internal error.

items.name: CapturingAlready
items.summary: A video capture session is already in progress and a new one cannot be started.

items.name: NoDeviceSupport
items.summary: The device does not have the required capture capabilities.

items.name: NoSpaceOnDevice
items.summary: The device does not have sufficient storage space available to begin capturing video.

VideoDeviceCaptureQuality.summary: Specifies the capture resolution and frame rate used by a `VideoDeviceInput` when reading from a camera device.

items.name: Default
items.summary: The default capture quality.

items.name: Low
items.summary: Captures at a reduced quality to lower resource usage on constrained or mobile platforms.

items.name: Medium
items.summary: Captures at a balanced quality suitable for most use cases.

items.name: High
items.summary: Captures at the highest available quality.

VideoError.summary: Indicates the result of a video operation in the engine's video subsystem.

items.name: Ok
items.summary: The video operation completed successfully without error.

items.name: Eof
items.summary: The end of the video stream or file has been reached.

items.name: EAgain
items.summary: No data is available at this moment; the caller should retry the operation.

items.name: BadParameter
items.summary: An invalid or out-of-range parameter was supplied to the video operation.

items.name: AllocFailed
items.summary: A memory allocation required for the video operation failed.

items.name: CodecInitFailed
items.summary: The video codec failed to initialize.

items.name: CodecCloseFailed
items.summary: The video codec failed to shut down cleanly.

items.name: DecodeFailed
items.summary: The video decoder failed to decode a frame from the stream.

items.name: ParsingFailed
items.summary: Parsing the video stream or container format failed.

items.name: Unsupported
items.summary: The requested video operation or format is not supported on this platform.

items.name: Generic
items.summary: A generic or unclassified error occurred in the video subsystem.

items.name: DownloadFailed
items.summary: The video asset could not be downloaded.

items.name: StreamNotFound
items.summary: The requested video stream could not be found.

items.name: EncodeFailed
items.summary: The video encoder failed to encode a frame.

items.name: CreateFailed
items.summary: Creating a required video resource or object failed.

items.name: NoPermission
items.summary: The video operation was denied because the required permission, such as camera access, has not been granted.

items.name: NoService
items.summary: The required video service is unavailable on this device or platform.

items.name: ReleaseFailed
items.summary: Releasing a video resource failed.

items.name: Unknown
items.summary: An unknown or unrecognized error occurred; this value covers errors that have no specific classification in this enum.

VideoSampleSize.summary: The size of textures produced by VideoSampler.

items.name: Small
items.summary: Use when the video sample is displayed on roughly a quarter of the screen.

items.name: Medium
items.summary: Use when the video sample is displayed on roughly half the screen.

items.name: Large
items.summary: Use when the video sample is displayed on roughly three quarters of the screen.

items.name: Full
items.summary: Use when the video sample is displayed full screen.

ViewMode.summary: Controls which debug rendering visualization overlay is displayed in the Studio viewport via RenderSettings.ViewMode.

items.name: None
items.summary: Disables the debug rendering visualization overlay; the default value of RenderSettings.ViewMode.

items.name: GeometryComplexity
items.summary: Displays an overdraw visualization highlighting geometric complexity across rendered surfaces.

items.name: Transparent
items.summary: Displays an overdraw visualization highlighting surfaces rendered with transparency.

items.name: Decal
items.summary: Displays an overdraw visualization highlighting surfaces rendered with decals.

VirtualCursorMode.summary: Enables Virtual Cursor mode within an experience.

items.name: Default
items.summary: The Virtual Cursor is in the default state.

items.name: Disabled
items.summary: The Virtual Cursor is disabled.

items.name: Enabled
items.summary: The Virtual Cursor is enabled.

VirtualInputMode.summary: Describes the current operational state of a VirtualInputManager.

items.name: None
items.summary: The VirtualInputManager is idle and neither recording nor playing back input.

items.name: Recording
items.summary: The VirtualInputManager is actively capturing input events into a sequence.

items.name: Playing
items.summary: The VirtualInputManager is replaying a previously recorded input sequence.

VoiceChatDistanceAttenuationType.summary: Enum used for preset distance attenuation curve options in the default voice chat setup.

items.name: Inverse
items.summary: Represents a distance attenuation curve that follows the inverse-squared law.

items.name: Legacy
items.summary: Represents a linear-squared distance attenuation curve with a minimum distance of `7` and a maximum distance of `80`.

VoiceChatState.summary: Describes the connection state of a local player's voice chat session.

items.name: Idle
items.summary: The player is not connected to voice chat and no join attempt is in progress.

items.name: Joining
items.summary: A voice chat join attempt is in progress for the first time.

items.name: JoiningRetry
items.summary: A voice chat join is being retried after a previous attempt did not succeed.

items.name: Joined
items.summary: The player has successfully joined the voice chat session and is actively connected.

items.name: Leaving
items.summary: The player is in the process of disconnecting from the voice chat session.

items.name: Ended
items.summary: The voice chat session has ended normally.

items.name: Failed
items.summary: The voice chat session ended due to an error, such as a failure to join or a mid-session error.

VoiceControlPath.summary: Identifies which leg of a voice chat control-plane operation is being reported.

items.name: Publish
items.summary: Represents the outbound audio path, through which a client sends local microphone audio to the room.

items.name: Subscribe
items.summary: Represents the inbound audio path, through which a client receives remote participants' audio streams.

items.name: Join
items.summary: Represents the room-join path, through which a client establishes membership in a voice room.

VolumetricAudio.summary: Controls how the engine renders volumetric audio effects.

items.name: Disabled
items.summary: Volumetric audio is disabled; sound emanates from a single point.

items.name: Automatic
items.summary: Currently equivalent to VolumetricAudio.Disabled.

items.name: Enabled
items.summary: Volumetric audio is enabled; sound emanates from the object's volume.

WaterDirection.summary: This Enum was once used to set the direction of Terrain water.

items.name: NegX
items.summary: The negative X-axis face direction of a voxel terrain water cell.

items.name: X
items.summary: The positive X-axis face direction of a voxel terrain water cell.

items.name: NegY
items.summary: The negative Y-axis face direction of a voxel terrain water cell.

items.name: Y
items.summary: The positive Y-axis face direction of a voxel terrain water cell.

items.name: NegZ
items.summary: The negative Z-axis face direction of a voxel terrain water cell.

items.name: Z
items.summary: The positive Z-axis face direction of a voxel terrain water cell.

WaterForce.summary: The WaterForce Enum is used to work with Terrain water cells.

items.name: None
items.summary: No flow force on a legacy voxel terrain water cell; the water is still.

items.name: Small
items.summary: A low flow force level of a legacy voxel terrain water cell.

items.name: Medium
items.summary: A moderate flow force level of a legacy voxel terrain water cell, between WaterForce.Small and WaterForce.Strong.

items.name: Strong
items.summary: A high flow force level of a legacy voxel terrain water cell, one step below WaterForce.Max.

items.name: Max
items.summary: The maximum flow force level of a legacy voxel terrain water cell.

WebStreamClientState.summary: WebStreamClientState indicates the current state of a WebStreamClient object.

items.name: Connecting
items.summary: The client has sent a request to connect with the server and is waiting for a response.

items.name: Open
items.summary: The client is connected to the server, allowing for data to be streamed between the server and client.

items.name: Error
items.summary: An unrecoverable error has occured while setting up the connection orduring the connection lifetime, cutting off the stream.

items.name: Closed
items.summary: The connection has run to completion without issues, either closed naturally by the server or manually by the user.

WebStreamClientType.summary: Specifies what type of streaming to use when creating a WebStreamClient.

items.name: SSE
items.summary: Traditional Server-Sent Events (SSE) client.

items.name: RawStream
items.summary: General purpose HTTP streaming client.

items.name: WebSocket
items.summary: WebSocket client that provides a bidirectional communication channel over a TCP connection.

WeldConstraintPreserve.summary: Controls which WeldConstraint are included in the recommendation table returned by GeometryService:CalculateConstraintsToPreserve().

items.name: All
items.summary: All WeldConstraint will be returned in the recommended table.

items.name: None
items.summary: WeldConstraint will be ignored and not returned in the recommended table.

items.name: Touching
items.summary: Only WeldConstraint that connect touching parts in the performed operation will be returned in the recommended table.

WhenUserFirstPlayed.summary: Describes when a player first played the current experience, represented as a bucket.

items.name: Unknown
items.summary: Segment data is unavailable.

items.name: Days0To30
items.summary: The player first played the experience within the last 30 days.

items.name: Days31To90
items.summary: The player first played the experience between 31 and 90 days ago.

items.name: Days91To180
items.summary: The player first played the experience between 91 and 180 days ago.

items.name: Days181To365
items.summary: The player first played the experience between 181 and 365 days ago.

items.name: Days366Plus
items.summary: The player first played the experience more than 365 days ago.

WhisperChatPrivacyMode.summary: Describes which other players a player allows to initiate a whisper (direct) chat with them in an experience.

items.name: AllUsers
items.summary: The player allows any other player in the experience to initiate a whisper chat with them.

items.name: NoOne
items.summary: The player does not allow any other player to initiate a whisper chat with them.

WrapLayerAutoSkin.summary: Controls how automatic bone weight transfer from the body is applied to a WrapLayer accessory's mesh.

items.name: Disabled
items.summary: No automatic skinning transfer is applied; the accessory uses its authored skinning data as-is, and an unskinned mesh will not deform with the character.

items.name: EnabledPreserve
items.summary: Applies automatic skinning transfer only when the mesh has no existing skinning data; otherwise the authored weights are kept.

items.name: EnabledOverride
items.summary: Unconditionally overrides all skinning weights by running the cage-based skinning transfer algorithm, regardless of whether the mesh was originally skinned.

WrapLayerDebugMode.summary: The Studio-only property for quickly visualizing and debugging meshes with inner cage and outer cages.

items.name: None
items.summary: This debug rendering mode does nothing.

items.name: BoundCage
items.summary: This debug mode visualizes corresponding cage mesh vertices bound to an underlying WrapTarget.

items.name: LayerCage
items.summary: This debug mode shows the resulting layer mesh as a whole.

items.name: BoundCageAndLinks
items.summary: The same as BoundCage but also visualizes how bound vertices were moved.

items.name: Reference
items.summary: This debug mode shows the original inner cage mesh as it was created.

items.name: Rbf

functions.name: offset

functions.name: graphemes

functions.name: nfcnormalize

functions.name: nfdnormalize

debug.summary: This library provides functions useful for debugging and profiling code.

functions.name: traceback
functions.summary: Returns a string of undefined format that describes the current function call stack.

functions.name: traceback
functions.summary: Returns a string of undefined format that describes the current function call stack.

functions.name: info
functions.summary: Traverses the entire stack of current thread and returns a string containing the call stack of target level details.

functions.name: info
functions.summary: Traverses the entire stack of current thread and returns a string containing the call stack of target function details.

functions.name: info
functions.summary: Traverses the entire stack of target thread and returns a string containing the call stack of target level details.

functions.name: profilebegin
functions.summary: Starts profiling for a label.

functions.name: profileend
functions.summary: Stops profiling for the most recent label that debug.profilebegin() opened.

functions.name: getmemorycategory
functions.summary: Returns the name of the current thread's active memory category.

functions.name: setmemorycategory
functions.summary: Assigns a custom tag to the current thread's memory category.

functions.name: resetmemorycategory
functions.summary: Resets the tag assigned by debug.setmemorycategory() to the automatically assigned value (typically, the script name).

functions.name: dumpcodesize
functions.summary: Displays a table of native code size of individual functions and scripts.

functions.name: abs
functions.summary: Returns the absolute value of `x`.

functions.name: acos
functions.summary: Returns the arc cosine of `x`.

functions.name: asin
functions.summary: Returns the arc sine of `x`.

functions.name: atan
functions.summary: Returns the arc tangent of `x` in radians.

functions.name: atan2
functions.summary: Returns the arc tangent of `y`/`x` (in radians) while using the signs of both parameters to find the quadrant of the result.

functions.name: ceil
functions.summary: Returns the smallest integer larger than or equal to `x`.

functions.name: clamp
functions.summary: Returns a number between `min` and `max`, inclusive.

functions.name: cos
functions.summary: Returns the cosine of `x`, assumed to be in radians.

functions.name: cosh
functions.summary: Returns the hyperbolic cosine of `x`.

functions.name: deg
functions.summary: Returns the angle `x` (given in radians) in degrees.

functions.name: exp
functions.summary: Returns the value `e`^`x`.

functions.name: floor
functions.summary: Returns the largest integer smaller than or equal to `x`.

functions.name: fmod
functions.summary: Returns the remainder of the division of `x` by `y` that rounds the quotient towards zero.

functions.name: frexp
functions.summary: Returns `m` and `e` such that `x` = `m`\*`2`^`e`.

functions.name: isfinite
functions.summary: Returns true if `x` is a finite number.

functions.name: isinf
functions.summary: Returns true if `x` is positive or negative infinity and false otherwise.

functions.name: isnan
functions.summary: Returns true if `x` is not a number (NaN) and false otherwise.

functions.name: ldexp
functions.summary: Returns `x`\*`2`^`e` (`e` should be an integer).

functions.name: lerp
functions.summary: Returns the linear interpolation between `a` and `b`.

functions.name: log
functions.summary: Returns the logarithm of `x` using the given base.

functions.name: log10
functions.summary: Returns the base-10 logarithm of `x`.

functions.name: map
functions.summary: Returns the value of `x` mapped from one range to another.

functions.name: max
functions.summary: Returns the maximum value among the numbers passed to the function.

functions.name: min
functions.summary: Returns the minimum value among the numbers passed to the function.

functions.name: modf
functions.summary: Returns two numbers: the integral part of `x` and the fractional part of `x`.

functions.name: noise
functions.summary: Returns a Perlin noise value.

functions.name: pow
functions.summary: Returns `x`^`y`.

functions.name: rad
functions.summary: Returns the angle `x` (given in degrees) in radians.

functions.name: random
functions.summary: Returns a random number within the range provided.

functions.name: randomseed
functions.summary: Sets `x` as the seed for the pseudo-random generator.

functions.name: round
functions.summary: Returns the integer with the smallest difference between it and the given number.

functions.name: sign
functions.summary: Returns `-1` if `x` is less than `0`, `0` if `x` equals `0`, or `1` if `x` is greater than `0`.

functions.name: sin
functions.summary: Returns the sine of `x`, assumed to be in radians.

functions.name: sinh
functions.summary: Returns the hyperbolic sine of `x`.

functions.name: sqrt
functions.summary: Returns the square root of `x`.

functions.name: tan
functions.summary: Returns the tangent of `x`, assumed to be in radians.

functions.name: tanh
functions.summary: Returns the hyperbolic tangent of `x`.

properties.name: e

properties.name: huge
properties.summary: Returns a value larger than or equal to any other numerical value (about 2<sup>1024</sup>).

properties.name: nan

properties.name: phi
properties.summary: The value of the golden ratio.

properties.name: pi
properties.summary: The value of pi.

properties.name: sqrt2
properties.summary: The value of the square root of 2.

properties.name: tau

string.summary: Provides generic functions to manipulate strings.

functions.name: byte
functions.summary: Returns the internal numerical codes of the characters `s[i], s[i+1], ..., s[j]`.

functions.name: char
functions.summary: Receives zero or more integers and returns a string with length equal to the number of arguments, in which each character has the internal numerical code equal to its corresponding argument.

functions.name: find
functions.summary: Looks for the first match of pattern in the string `s` and returns the indices of `s` where the occurrence starts and ends.

functions.name: format
functions.summary: Returns a formatted version of its variable number of arguments following the description given in its first argument, which must be a string.

functions.name: gmatch
functions.summary: Returns an iterator function that returns the next captures from pattern over the string `s` each time it's called.

functions.name: gsub
functions.summary: Returns a copy of `s` in which all or the first `n` occurrences of the pattern are replaced with the given replacement.

functions.name: len
functions.summary: Returns the length of a string.

functions.name: lower
functions.summary: Returns a copy of a string with all uppercase letters changed to lowercase.

functions.name: match
functions.summary: Looks for the first match of `pattern` in the string `s`.

functions.name: pack
functions.summary: Returns a binary string containing the provided arguments.

functions.name: packsize
functions.summary: Returns the size in bytes of any string packed with a given description.

functions.name: rep
functions.summary: Returns a string that is the concatenation of `n` copies of the string `s`.

functions.name: reverse
functions.summary: Returns a string that is the string `s` reversed.

functions.name: split
functions.summary: Splits a string into parts based on the defined separator character(s), returning a table of ordered results.

functions.name: sub
functions.summary: Returns the substring of `s` that starts at `i` and continues until and including `j`.

functions.name: unpack
functions.summary: Extracts the values packed in the provided binary string.

functions.name: upper
functions.summary: Returns a copy of a string with all lowercase letters changed to uppercase.

bit32.summary: A library of functions to perform bitwise operations.

functions.name: arshift
functions.summary: Returns a number after its bits have been arithmetically shifted to the right by a given displacement.

functions.name: band
functions.summary: Returns the bitwise AND of all provided numbers.

functions.name: bnot
functions.summary: Returns the bitwise negation of a given number.

functions.name: bor
functions.summary: Returns the bitwise OR of all provided numbers.

functions.name: btest
functions.summary: Returns a boolean describing whether the bitwise and of its operands is different from zero.

functions.name: bxor
functions.summary: Returns the bitwise XOR of all provided numbers.

functions.name: byteswap
functions.summary: Returns the given number with the order of the bytes swapped.

functions.name: countlz
functions.summary: Returns the number of consecutive zero bits in the 32-bit representation of the provided number starting from the left-most (most significant) bit.

functions.name: countrz
functions.summary: Returns the number of consecutive zero bits in the 32-bit representation of the provided number starting from the right-most (least significant) bit.

functions.name: extract
functions.summary: Extract a range of bits from a number and return them as an unsigned number.

functions.name: replace
functions.summary: Return a copy of a number with a range of bits replaced by a given value.

functions.name: lrotate
functions.summary: Returns a number after its bits have been rotated to the left by a given number of times.

functions.name: lshift
functions.summary: Returns a number whose bits have been logically shifted to the left by a given displacement.

functions.name: rrotate
functions.summary: Returns a number after its bits have been rotated to the right by a given number of times.

functions.name: rshift
functions.summary: Returns a number whose bits have been logically shifted to the right by a given displacement.
